jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Our client is an elite growth consultancy specialising in helping digital agencies scale through automated, high-converting client acquisition systems. They are seeking a self-driven remote Outbound Lead to take full ownership of their cold-email engine. In this role, you will rebuild and elevate the outbound system to a world-class standard. You will be running cold-email operations directly for done-for-you clients while coaching done-with-you agency clients to master their own campaigns.

Key Responsibilities & Ownership

  • Full Engine Ownership:Oversee end-to-end cold-email operations, including lead prospecting, data enrichment, sending infrastructure, campaign messaging, and follow-up sequences.
  • Deliverability Infrastructure:Take complete charge of domain setups, inbox distribution, warm-up protocols, authentication, and maintaining high inbox placement rates.
  • Tech Stack Optimisation:Audit the existing software stack, retain effective tools (including n8n for automation), and implement better solutions where needed.
  • Performance Metrics:Drive and optimise core KPIs—reply rates, positive responses, and booked sales calls—identifying bottlenecks and deploying fixes independently.
  • Client Delivery & Coaching:Execute outbound campaigns for client accounts while providing expert coaching and guidance to clients who manage their own outbound setups.

Your First 90 Days

  • Conduct a thorough audit of the current cold-email ecosystem and present an honest blueprint for what to keep or rebuild.
  • Deploy a reliable sending and deliverability infrastructure built to highest industry standards.
  • Establish clean, real-time reporting on the key performance numbers that drive pipeline growth.

Requirements

  • Hands-On Expertise:Deep, current technical knowledge of modern cold-email systems, deliverability mechanics, and automation tools.
  • True Ownership Mindset:You act as a builder rather than a task-follower, proactively diagnosing and fixing broken workflows under pressure.
  • Coaching & Communication:Ability to break down complex technical outbound concepts and effectively teach non-experts how to execute.
  • Tool Proficiency:Strong proficiency with n8n, CRM databases, enrichment platforms, and domain/inbox management tools.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is a high-level strategic leader responsible for creating exceptional experiences across customer service and operational support processes. This role optimizes service experiences by combining operational subject matter expertise with process innovation and technology implementation. This position leads a team of high-level consultants, problem solvers, data analysts, and super users of key technology solutions. This position leads the vision, prioritization, execution, and continuous evolution of innovation, technology, and processes across customer service and revenue cycle. This position must be an expert at the technologies used to deliver exceptional experiences and be deeply familiar with the databases and data flows that make those experiences possible. This position leads cross functional teams of leaders in IT, HR, Marketing, finance, and operations to execute their vision of service optimization. They lead and participate in governance, communicating and aligning with executive leadership, and work as one team.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Leads and mentors a multidisciplinary team of high-performing subject matter experts, including consultants, analysts, and technology super users. Provides strategic direction, clears blockers, solves problems, teaches and guides their team through the scenarios they might face. Foster a one team environment by creating a culture of innovation, accountability, and high reliability in service delivery. Will intake new project request and manage the workload of team members.

2. Drives service optimization initiatives through process improvement, automation, and streamline workflows to reduce costs and eliminate non-value-added tasks. Facilitates customer experience expectations between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical partners. Maintain communication with business stakeholders across Revenue Cycle, service lines, call center, and operations such as hospital services, BMG, BUMG, MD Anderson, Banner Imaging, Banner Physical Therapy, Banner Urgent Care, etc. Work with technical partners such as IT, data warehouse and infrastructure teams to ensure that applications meet all needs and that resources are aligned.

3. Owns the vision and execution of a complex operational roadmap of upcoming features and enhancements. Must work with all stakeholders in order to prioritize and forecast work to meet all needs. Oversees the allocation of resources to ensure that the work is completed in the right sequence. Ensures solutions are scalable, consistent, and aligned with the needs of Sofia and other key personas.

4. Leverage existing knowledge and experience to serve as a strategic liaison between business and technical teams, holding both accountable for the various technologies, including the build and maintenance of new and existing platforms as well as data governance, architecture, security, data synchronization, refresh cycles and analytic definitions. Partners with leaders in IT, HR, Finance, and Operations to align technology deployment with service optimization goals and ensure seamless execution of outlined strategies.

5. Provides subject matter expertise in-service optimization data sets and databases. Serves as business owner over proper flow of data between tools such as CRMs, EHRs, online scheduling, provider data management, financial and revenue systems, various health plan resources, and self-service tools. Can pull, analyze, manipulate, and troubleshoot data from multiple sources and systems. Oversees data integration and flow to ensure accurate, secure, and actionable insights.

6. Establishes and enforces standards, policies, procedures, application use and end-to-end process documentation. Ensures implementation, storage, maintenance, and adherence to department and company standards as well as compliance with regulatory requirements.

7. Oversees the preparation of business cases and proposals for new technologies and process improvements. Reviews technical documentation to ensure alignment with business requirements, data integrity, and long-term sustainability. Identifies, investigates, tracks, and resolves complex project deliverables ensuring the solution is timely and of acceptable quality. Collaborates with key stakeholders to design, develop and implement scorecards and dashboards metrics to monitor ongoing progress.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must possess strong technical and business knowledge as typically obtained through completion of a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field and at least seven to ten years of experience in the customer or operations technology field.

Strong experience in managing technical products, using databases, customer relationship management data, email/text automation, or electronic health record systems is a must.

Must possess excellent communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts into digestible terms for business and leader consumption. Must be comfortable with public speaking in front of large audiences. Must demonstrate the ability to deal effectively with conflict and manage relations that balance system needs and entity priorities.

Ability to develop a clear, realistic, and actionable vision, as well as provide results-oriented strategic and systems leadership, and ability to effectively and credibly interact with and influence internal and external contacts.

Excellent problem solving, analytical skills; detail oriented with the ability to oversee projects from origin through execution.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Master’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Advanced analytic capabilities using SQL or other query language is a plus. Ability to manage large data sets in platforms such as Business Objects, Teradata, Tableau, or other tools is a plus.

Certifications in platforms such as Salesforce highly desired. Other certifications in business processes such as Lean, Six Sigma, Scrum, or Agile is a plus.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

jobs.description:
About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.
But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.
Position Summary:

The Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity Consultant assesses the security posture and maturity of OT environments for clients across manufacturing, energy, utilities, and other critical infrastructure sectors. This role involves conducting stakeholder interviews, reviewing OT documentation, evaluating security practices against industry frameworks, and developing maturity assessment reports with remediation recommendations. The Consultant presents findings and strategic guidance to clients while working with Project Managers, Directors, and Delivery teams to manage project scope and timelines.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain current knowledge of OT security standards, regulatory developments, and industry trends through ongoing professional development and relevant certifications
  • Support and guide OT risk and security discussions with technical teams, operations staff, and executive stakeholders
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and review OT-related policies, procedures, architecture documentation, and compliance records to understand organizational OT environments and priorities
  • Assess client environments against OT security practices and compliance posture against IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NIST CSF, NERC CIP, NIS2 Directive, EU Cyber Resilience Act, C2M2, and other relevant OT standards and frameworks
  • Develop maturity assessment and benchmarking reports identifying OT security gaps, current state findings, and prioritized remediation recommendations
  • Develop sequenced remediation roadmaps with prioritized activities, timelines, and implementation guidance to address identified OT security gaps
  • Advise clients on OT security program structure, governance frameworks, organizational roles and responsibilities, and recommended policies and procedures
  • Present assessment findings, risk analysis, and strategic recommendations to clients and their leadership through executive briefings and detailed reports
  • Support other Cyber Risk Advisory consulting engagements when necessary to maintain team capacity

What You'll Bring

  • At least 4 years of working experience in operational technology security, OT risk assessment, or related infrastructure security roles
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience demonstrating OT security expertise
  • Direct experience in OT environments such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other critical infrastructure sectors
  • Hands-on experience with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems
  • Knowledge of control system technologies, industrial automation architectures, and OT-specific networking environments
  • Expertise in OT security assessment frameworks including IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and industry-specific requirements such as NERC CIP
  • Understanding of emerging OT regulatory requirements including NIS2 Directive, EU Cyber Resilience Act, and other sector-specific directives
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities
  • Strong oral and written communication skills when presenting technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points

  • GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional) certification
  • CISM certification
  • CISSP certification
  • GRID (GIAC Response and Industrial Defense) certification
  • GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) certification
  • C2M2 (Cybersecurity Capability Maturity Model) assessment experience
  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) assessment and implementation experience
  • Incident response experience in OT or critical infrastructure environments
  • Business continuity or disaster recovery experience in OT environments
  • Experience with safety-critical systems and understanding of functional safety standards (IEC 61508, ISO 10218)
  • Technical writing experience for policy and procedure development
  • Cloud platform experience relevant to OT environments or industrial IoT implementations

Why You’ll Want to Join Us

At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office.
Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.
At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. jobs.description:
Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt Hilfsorganisationen und macht soziales Engagement wirtschaftlich schlagkräftig und systemisch wirksam. Unsere Initiative verbindet Verbände, entwickelt professionelle, leistungsfähige und zukunftsfähige Organisationsstrukturen und baut bundesweit eine Plattform für gesellschaftliche Wirkung auf.

Zur organisatorischen und operativen Unterstützung unseres Vorstands suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine strukturierte, kommunikative und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Verbandskoordinator:in.

In dieser zentralen Schnittstellenfunktion entlastest du den Vorstand im Tagesgeschäft, koordinierst verbandsinterne Themen und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen, Termine, Aufgaben und Beschlüsse zuverlässig zusammengeführt und nachgehalten werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Vorstand, der Geschäftsführung, den Fachbereichen sowie weiteren Verantwortlichen innerhalb der DEHIB-Organisation zusammen.

Hinweis

Die Tätigkeit ist ehrenamtlich, unvergütet und begründet kein Arbeits- oder Beschäftigungsverhältnis. Die Rolle richtet sich insbesondere an organisationsstarke Persönlichkeiten, die ihre Erfahrung in Koordination, Assistenz, Projektorganisation oder Verbandsarbeit einbringen und den Vorstand einer wachsenden Non-Profit-Organisation wirkungsvoll unterstützen möchten.

Der zeitliche Einsatz liegt bei ca. 4 bis 6 Stunden pro Woche. Die Zusammenarbeit ist vollständig remote und unbefristet bzw. langfristig angelegt.

Aufgaben

  • Organisatorische und operative Unterstützung des Vorstands im laufenden Tagesgeschäft
  • Koordination, Vor- und Nachbereitung von Vorstands-, Gremien- und Abstimmungsterminen einschließlich Agenda und Unterlagen
  • Dokumentation von Besprechungsergebnissen sowie zuverlässige Nachverfolgung von Aufgaben, Fristen und Beschlüssen
  • Steuerung des Informationsflusses zwischen Vorstand, Geschäftsführung, Fachbereichen und weiteren internen Ansprechpersonen
  • Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Pflege von Präsentationen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Übersichten und verbandsbezogenen Dokumenten
  • Unterstützung bei der Priorisierung, Koordination und Umsetzung vorstandsnaher Projekte und Sonderthemen
  • Weiterentwicklung effizienter Abläufe, Vorlagen und digitaler Arbeitsstrukturen für die Zusammenarbeit des Vorstands
  • Übernahme allgemeiner Koordinations- und Verwaltungsaufgaben sowie vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der DEHIB-Organisation

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische, verwaltungsbezogene oder vergleichbare Ausbildung bzw. ein entsprechendes Studium
  • Praktische Erfahrung in Assistenz, Koordination, Projektmanagement, Verbandsarbeit oder einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationsvermögen sowie ein strukturierter, verbindlicher und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsstil
  • Erfahrung im Vereins-, Verbands- oder Non-Profit-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office bzw. Microsoft 365, insbesondere Outlook, Word, PowerPoint und Teams
  • Hohe Diskretion, Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein im Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine klare und wertschätzende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation

Benefits

Gestaltung & Verantwortung

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung professioneller Strukturen und Abläufe für die Vorstandsarbeit des DEHIB.
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung in einer zentralen Koordinations- und Vertrauensfunktion.
  • Direkte und enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vorstand.
  • Möglichkeit, die Zusammenarbeit und Entscheidungsfähigkeit einer wachsenden Organisation nachhaltig zu stärken.

Exklusives Netzwerk

  • Zugang zu einem wachsenden Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Non-Profit-Organisationen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmer:innen, Führungskräften und Expert:innen unterschiedlichster Fachrichtungen.
  • Möglichkeit, das eigene berufliche Netzwerk nachhaltig auszubauen.

Persönliche & fachliche Entwicklung

  • Möglichkeit, Vorstandsunterstützung mit Verbandskoordination, Projektorganisation und Organisationsentwicklung zu verbinden.
  • Vertiefung deiner Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Leitungs- und Entscheidungsgremien.
  • Umfassender Einblick in strategische, organisatorische und operative Themen einer wachsenden Non-Profit-Organisation.

Unterstützung durch den DEHIB

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vorstand, der Geschäftsführung und den relevanten Fachbereichen.
  • Fachlicher Austausch innerhalb eines interdisziplinären Expert:innen-Netzwerks.
  • Zugriff auf das Know-how der angeschlossenen Organisationen und Kooperationspartner.

Sichtbarkeit & Reputation

  • Verantwortungsvolle Funktion an einer zentralen Schnittstelle einer bundesweit tätigen Organisation.
  • Wertvolle Referenz für Vorstandsunterstützung, Verbandskoordination und Organisationsentwicklung im Non-Profit-Umfeld.
  • Qualifiziertes Ehrenamtszeugnis und Tätigkeitsnachweis.

Flexibilität

  • Vollständig remote organisierte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung bei einem Umfang von ca. 4 bis 6 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Unbefristet und langfristig angelegte ehrenamtliche Rolle.
  • Moderne digitale Zusammenarbeit über Microsoft 365.

Sinn & Wirkung

  • Aktiver Beitrag zum Aufbau einer nachhaltigen und professionellen Ehrenamtsorganisation.
  • Stärkung einer wirkungsvollen Vorstands- und Verbandsarbeit als Grundlage für weiteres Wachstum.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen möchten.

Ein Anschreiben ist gerne gesehen. Daraus sollte hervorgehen, welche Erfahrungen du in der Assistenz, Koordination, Projektorganisation oder Verbandsarbeit mitbringst, wie du auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick behältst und weshalb dich eine ehrenamtliche Mitarbeit als Verbandskoordinator:in beim Deutschen Hilfsbund motiviert.

jobs.description:
About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

About the Opportunity:

We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our growing revenue organization. In this role, you'll own the technical relationship across the entire customer lifecycle, pre-sale through post-sale.

You'll be the technical partner behind our most strategic enterprise accounts, from first conversations through production scale. Working alongside Account Executives, you'll lead technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts, then carry that same solution through onboarding, workflow design, integration, and ongoing optimization. You'll be your customers' trusted technical advisor at every stage of their Label Studio Enterprise journey.

Label Studio is a deeply technical product, used by Data Scientists and ML Engineers as core infrastructure for their work. To succeed here, you'll need a real understanding of data labeling and the role it plays in model performance. You'll work directly with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and MLOps teams to architect solutions that hold up in production.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with Account Executives on strategic deals, leading technical discovery, tailored demos, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concepts that prove out Label Studio Enterprise against real customer data and workflows.
  • Drive technical onboarding, guiding customers through installation, secure configuration, and best-practice deployment across cloud, on-prem, or hybrid environments.
  • Architect integrations between Label Studio and customer AI/ML workflows, pipelines, storage, and enterprise systems.
  • Build custom solutions (scripts, plug-ins, and APIs) to extend Label Studio for unique customer requirements.
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for your accounts, resolving advanced issues and collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Support.
  • Deliver enablement, workshops, and documentation that make customer teams self-sufficient on the platform.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer engineering, data, and AI/ML teams, supporting adoption, expansion, and long-term value.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or similar) for a highly technical product, ideally enterprise SaaS or ML/AI platforms. Experience on both sides of the sale is ideal.
  • You've built a data labeling pipeline yourself, whether that's data annotation, labeling workflows, or the broader ML lifecycle. You can explain how it works to an engineer and to a VP without changing much.
  • Hands-on work integrating SaaS platforms with ML pipelines. You've deployed models to production, or done the engineering to get datasets ready for data science teams.
  • Fluency in Python, REST APIs, and infrastructure tools (Linux/Unix, Docker; Kubernetes a plus). You've built against multiple client APIs and SDKs. JavaScript, CSS, and HTML are a plus.
  • A track record of running technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts during the sales cycle, then owning onboarding, implementation, troubleshooting, and custom development after the close.
  • Enough business sense to go with the technical depth. You can take a customer's problem and hand it back to them as a value proposition they actually recognize, and you can see an objection coming before it lands.
  • Executive presence and sharp writing, with the range to move between Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and technical executives.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple complex accounts and competing priorities.

We are hiring for this role across North America. Base Salary is targeted between $122,500 - 143,500 USD (based on experience and skills). This role also qualifies for variable compensation; anticipated On-Target Earnings if an employee is meeting objectives are $175,000 - $205,000 USD. This range is provided by market data and is in good faith. Final offer details are determined by several factors including candidate experience, expertise as well as applicable industry knowledge, and may vary from the pay ranges listed above. We also offer stock options, comprehensive health benefits, and a strong team culture rooted in transparency and collaboration. Join us!

jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of HR Programmes

Location: UK, Remote (some travel to HALO’s international programmes required)

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Reports To: HR Director

Direct Reports: IHRMs

Key Internal Contacts/Relationships: Head of HR Operations, HR Operations Team, Talent Acquisition Team, Head of Talent & Performance, ER, Programme Directors and Programme Managers, CFO, Finance, UK/HQ Functional Leads, Central support functions, ExCo (as required)

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Suppliers

Job Purpose: To provide senior strategic HR partnership to HALO's international programmes, supporting programme leaders to manage workforce, employee relations, safeguarding and organisational capability issues effectively across complex operating environments, while ensuring alignment with organisational policies, values and legal obligations. The role provides an auditable route for escalation of complex or sensitive employment, conduct or safeguarding issues. The role holder ensures that people decisions affecting international programme staff are proportionate, timely and grounded in operational reality, while safeguarding independence from programme management and maintaining consistent standards of HR support across regions.

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

About the role:

The role covers all HR partnering activity for HALO's country programmes. It operates across multiple jurisdictions and employment frameworks and within varied funding models, including grant funded and fixed period contractual arrangements.

The role does not hold line management accountability for country (national) teams. Authority is exercised through professional judgement, influence and established governance, including determining escalation and acting as the senior HR adviser on complex people, safeguarding and workforce matters across HALO's programmes.

Responsibilities:

Strategic People Partnership:

  • Act as the senior HR partner to programme leadership on workforce, employee relations, leadership and organisational capability matters.
  • Support programme leaders to design and apply employment and contracting arrangements that are proportionate to programme duration, funding terms and operational need.
  • Provide senior level HR advice that supports programme leaders to operate effectively in complex, resource constrained environments.
  • Oversee workforce planning and contracting approaches suited to different operating contexts, ensuring structures remain flexible enough for programmes to scale capacity up and down as operational need changes.

Employee Relations and Safeguarding:

  • Act as the senior HR partner to programme leadership on complex people, safeguarding and duty of care matters, providing expert, decision-focused advice that supports timely and proportionate resolution, but with programme leadership retaining ownership of decisions and outcomes.
  • Support programme leaders to anticipate and address people challenges arising in fragile, high-risk and resource-constrained operating environments.
  • Maintain oversight of significant people and safeguarding matters across programmes, ensuring consistency of approach, proportionality of response and appropriate escalation in line with organisational standards.
  • Ensure that significant people and safeguarding considerations are appropriately communicated to Executive and Board stakeholders, with clear articulation of context, options and mitigations.

Policy Application and Standards:

  • Interpret and apply global HR policies within diverse local and legal contexts, exercising professional judgement where policy intent, donor conditions and operational reality intersect.
  • Support programme leadership to understand and meet their legal, safeguarding and people-management obligations across multiple jurisdictions, balancing compliance with operational effectiveness.

Assurance and Risk:

  • Support the delivery of the HR assurance programme through reviews of workforce practices, employee relations, safeguarding, duty of care and people management arrangements across programmes.
  • Provide professional judgement on programme-level workforce risks, control effectiveness and compliance with organisational standards, identifying themes, emerging risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Support programme leadership to implement agreed corrective actions and strengthen people management practices following assurance reviews.

Leadership and Capability Development:

  • Strengthen people management capability across programmes through coaching/mentoring, advice and support on complex workforce, employee relations matters, training, performance, development and succession planning.
  • Support programme leaders to apply organisational people policies and processes confidently and consistently.
  • Manage and develop the Regional HR network, ensuring consistent regional support, visibility of ER and safeguarding matters, and early intervention on emerging issues.
  • Ensure HALO’s values and standards are reflected consistently in people decisions and leadership behaviour across programme teams.

Interface with HR Operations:

  • Act as the primary interface between programme teams and HR Operations, ensuring workforce challenges, operational realities and programme feedback inform the continuous improvement of HR policies, systems and processes, and supporting the consistent application of organisational standards across programmes.
  • Work jointly with the Head of HR Operations to maintain common standards, shared escalation routes and a joined-up approach to case handling across the organisation.

General:

  • Uphold HALO’s core values and standards, promoting its ethos and mission statement.
  • Ensure familiarity with and adherence to all HALO policies and procedures, especially the code of conduct and safeguarding

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional travel to programmes globally

Requirements

Technical / Professional:

  • Significant leadership experience, including in international, multi-jurisdictional or complex operating environments.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing remote teams effectively across multiple countries or regions.
  • Experience providing senior level advice to non-HR leadership and operating with autonomy in ambiguous or fast-moving situations.
  • Ability to calibrate HR responses appropriately, distinguishing between complex, high-risk cases and matters that can be resolved pragmatically and proportionately.
  • Deep expertise in employee relations, safeguarding and managing complex people issues in international environments.
  • Strong understanding of UK employment law and law across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Advanced professional judgement in ambiguous, high-risk environments.
  • Ability to translate complex risk into clear, decision focused advice.
  • Strong understanding of embedding a safeguarding assurance framework.

Behavioural / Leadership:

  • High credibility and gravitas with senior operational leaders.
  • Influential without authority; confident challenger.
  • Calm, measured and values-led under pressure.
  • Strong ethical judgement and organisational awareness.
  • Ability to develop and lead HR teams across multiple jurisdictions.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience working within a not-for-profit / global matrix organisation.
  • International employment law knowledge

Benefits

  • 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 statutory holidays
  • Non-contributory life assurance
  • Private medical insurance
  • Pension contributions matched by HALO up to 5%
  • Emergency medical insurance while travelling overseas
  • Flexible working policy

Please submit a CV (no more than 2 pages) and a cover letter (no more than 1 page) outlining how your experience matches the key skills and competencies required by 24th September 2026. Applications without a cover letter tailored to this position will not be considered.

We reserve the right to amend the closing date depending on the number of applications received.

The HALO Trust is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

The HALO Trust is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

The HALO Trust is committed to ensuring that it provides a safe and trusted environment which safeguards and promotes the welfare and wellbeing of anyone who comes into contact with, or is part of, the Charity, with a zero-tolerance approach to behaviours which challenge this.

This is a paid freelance and remote position

ScreenRant is the #1 entertainment website and publishes breaking news and exclusives on blockbuster movies, TV shows, comic books, books, and other forms of entertainment.

As a worldwide leader, ScreenRant operates at a rapid pace and is always looking for experienced and passionate contributors who can create original high-quality content in a timely manner.

We are currently expanding our books coverage and looking for generalist book fans who can tackle big, broad recommendation lists and keep readers on top of what to read next.

Please note: this is not a book reviewer position. We do not publish reviews at this time. The bulk of this work - roughly 80% - is recommendation and ranking lists, with the remainder made up of book news and features. If your goal is to write critical reviews of individual titles, this role is not the right fit.

Your Responsibilities

  • Write list and feature articles in ScreenRant's house style following the training and peer mentorship period.
  • Cover current and upcoming book releases and book news.
  • Stay on top of new releases across multiple genres.

jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission: To achieve Sleek’s Australian revenue targets by renewing services across the existing clientele, driving cash collection through upsell and upgrades, and delivering a seamless, high-satisfaction customer experience throughout the renewal lifecycle.

Outcomes:

Renewal Rate and CSAT Targets

  • Consistently achieve monthly renewal rate targets across the Australian client base
  • Maintain and improve CSAT scores, ensuring customer trust and satisfaction throughout each renew

Customer Investigation & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct detailed, end-to-end investigations into customer interactions with Sleek
  • Work cross-functionally with accounting, corpsec, product, and data teams to drive resolution and support seamless renewals

Cash Collection via Renewal, Upsell & Upgrades

  • Achieve monthly cash collection targets by driving renewals and identifying upsell and upgrade opportunities
  • Proactively identify and act on revenue expansion opportunities within the existing customer base

Pipeline Management & Monthly Targets

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of the book of business; manage the pipeline in a data-driven manner using CRM and reporting tools
  • Prioritise ticket resolution and proactive outreach to consistently achieve monthly KPIs

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Best Practice

  • Partner with accounting, corpsec, product, and data teams to improve renewal processes and the end-to-end customer experience
  • Proactively share best practices with the wider Customer Success team; contribute to a culture of continuous improvement

Must-have experience:

To do this, you will have a minimum of 8 years experience in Renewals, or Customer Success management roles and you will be located in the Philippines.

  • Demonstrated track record of achieving renewal rate and cash collection targets in a B2B SaaS or services environment
  • Experience managing a customer pipeline in a data-driven way: CRM hygiene, pipeline reporting, and forecasting
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with product, finance, and operations teams to resolve customer issues
  • Strong written and spoken English; ability to communicate clearly with Australian-market clients

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking & Target Focused: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, keeping in view our business goals and being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness, build empathy, trust and great working relationships. Strong language proficiency in English is required

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One Way Video Interview / Screening call with TA

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short, one-way video interview. Depending on the results, candidates may then progress to a ~30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to explore their experience and discuss the role in more detail..

Technical round
A ~60-minute session with the Hiring Manager, including a live case study and roleplay—acting as if you’re already in the role—to test your role fitment. They will also discuss your last 1–2 roles to explore your background in more detail.

Behavioural fit assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a member of the leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Responsibilities:

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • PhD, Master’s, or Bachelor’s degree in a physical science field, ideally analytical chemistry, or closely related sciences.
  • ≥ 12 years in analytical chemistry of small molecule testing. Biologics and similar large molecule experience will not contribute to the experience total.
  • Experienced with early development activities including IND-enabling development.
  • Adept with API and impurity testing. Individuals with drug product only experience will not be considered.
  • Preferred direct experience supervising outsourced biological sample analysis (i.e., plasma concentration analysis) using LC-MS/MS in compliance with GLP and FDA/EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation guidelines.
  • Expertise in analytical technologies including LC, GC, NMR, MS, XRPD, and other relevant methodologies used for elucidation and purity determination.
  • Well-informed of FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines for drug substance manufacturing and quality assurance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to influence and build credibility at all levels.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for interacting with employees and leaders across various levels and functions.

Celcuity is a commercial biotechnology company pursuing development of targeted therapies for treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. REVTORPYK is approved to treat adults with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting.

The Phase 3 VIKTORIA-2 trial is evaluating gedatolisib in combination with palbociclib and either fulvestrant or letrozole for the first-line treatment of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.

Gorilla Commerce has successfully implemented PLM as the system of record for product specifications, BOMs, materials, suppliers and costing, and the platform is live across the sourcing organization. This role owns it from here — closing the residual data gaps that follow any implementation, raising the standard of governance, and maturing the platform through its next phases of capability.

The scope is broad but well supported. Sourcing teams own day-to-day data entry and maintenance following go-live. A dedicated analyst supports bulk uploads, reconciliation and heavy data work. IT leads the technical build of the PLM–ERP integration. This role sets the standards, makes the system decisions, and directs the work.

There is genuine white space here. An 18-month roadmap is defined — stronger specification and BOM structure, packaging and artwork governance, warning-label and claims data — and the person in this role will shape how it is prioritized, sequenced and delivered.

The role can be based globally and works core US Eastern hours to stay aligned with the VP and the wider team, with some flexibility for Asia-based sourcing partners.

This is not a data-entry or system-administration role. It is a product-data ownership role focused on structure, governance, adoption and system maturity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

System Ownership & Configuration

  • Own the day-to-day health, configuration and evolution of the PLM platform.

  • Act as the internal authority on how PLM should be structured and used across parent and SKU hierarchy, specifications, BOMs, materials, supplier and factory records, quotes and costing.

  • Determine whether an issue is best solved through configuration, data architecture, process design or vendor development.

  • Own integration keys and mappings between PLM and the ERP.

Product Data Governance & Integrity

  • Own product data quality as an ongoing discipline rather than a periodic cleanup.

  • Establish validation standards, naming conventions and audit routines that prevent errors upstream.

  • Reconcile PLM against ERP master data and resolve discrepancies at root cause.

  • Close residual implementation gaps across product hierarchy, suppliers and factories, BOMs, color/size and supplier quote data.

Workflow, Change & Version Control

  • Design and govern state models, approval workflows and revision control.

  • Define how specification and BOM changes are requested, approved, tested and released.

  • Assess downstream impact of data and configuration changes before release.

  • Establish clear decision rights across this role, functional owners, IT and leadership.

Adoption, Training & Process Discipline

  • Drive adoption across a distributed sourcing organization as a core deliverable of the role.

  • Build and maintain SOPs, training materials and onboarding for new users.

  • Move remaining product workflows off spreadsheets and email and into PLM.

  • Identify recurring process failures and resolve the root cause rather than the symptom.

Vendor Partnership & Roadmap

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with the PLM software vendor.

  • Manage tickets, requirements, testing and feature scoping independently, escalating commercial matters to the VP.

  • Own the business-side PLM roadmap and translate business needs into practical system and process solutions.

  • Sequence future capability including deeper Level 2 and 3 BOM structure, packaging governance and claims data.

Integration Support

  • Support the IT-led PLM–ERP integration through requirements definition, mapping validation and UAT.

  • Diagnose whether issues originate in source data, PLM configuration, integration logic or the ERP.

  • Keep integration keys complete and accurate across all active SKUs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 5+ years in PLM, product data management or product operations, including direct ownership of a PLM or comparable product-data platform.

  • Strong grasp of product hierarchy, multi-level BOMs, specifications and revision management.

  • Experience maintaining product data integrity against an ERP, including reconciliation and integration keys.

  • Experience designing or governing approval workflows and version control.

  • Advanced Excel and confident handling of large product datasets.

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

Preferred

  • Experience through a PLM implementation or major system rollout.

  • Vendor management experience with software providers.

  • Experience in Centric PLM would be a plus.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, integration mapping and UAT.

  • Python, SQL or Power Query for data reconciliation and automation.

  • Exposure to packaging, artwork or compliance documentation data.

  • Background in consumer products, retail, sourcing, manufacturing, apparel, footwear or hardlines.

Competencies

  • High ownership and accountability

  • Strong systems and structured-data thinking

  • Comfortable acting as a data gatekeeper

  • Independent problem solver — brings recommendations, not questions

  • Clear communicator across time zones and functions

  • Builds processes and standards that scale

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

  • PLM is live, but no single person owns its structure, standards and evolution.

  • Product data underpins sourcing, costing, compliance, quality and planning.

  • Residual implementation gaps need closing — and preventing.

  • Adoption determines whether the platform delivers its value.

  • This role exists to own PLM end to end, raise data standards, drive adoption and deliver the roadmap.

jobs.title: Open-Source Intelligence Mentor CZ
jobs.excerpt: XPUPXPUP vznikla z jednoduché potřeby: nemohli jsme najít dostatek profesionálů s odpovídajícími digitálními dovednostmi – tak jsme se rozhodli je vychovat sami.
jobs.description:
XPUP

XPUP vznikla z jednoduché potřeby: nemohli jsme najít dostatek profesionálů s odpovídajícími digitálními dovednostmi – tak jsme se rozhodli je vychovat sami.
To, co začalo v roce 2018 jako komunitní iniciativa v Tbilisi, se proměnilo v globální vzdělávací platformu s více než 30 000 absolventy.

Naše programy tvoří experti z praxe, jsou zaměřené na skutečné potřeby trhu a vedené v prostředí spolupráce, zvídavosti a růstu.

V roce 2023 jsme se spojili s Tether, abychom naši misi rozšířili do celého světa – zpřístupnit praktické a kariérně posilující vzdělávání všem, kdo chtějí růst.

Dnes budujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketérů, designérů, vývojářů a tvůrců, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale i dopad.

Naše hodnoty jsou jednoduché a žité: lidé na prvním místě, zvědavost, kvalita a zodpovědnost.

A jsme teprve na začátku.

Přehled role

Do společnosti XPUP hledáme zkušeného odborníka na OSINT a korporátní bezpečnost, který se připojí k našemu týmu jako lektor kurzu OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence). Vaším úkolem bude připravovat a vést interaktivní workshopy, sdílet reálné zkušenosti z praxe a provázet studenty během celého studia. Pomůžete jim osvojit si dovednosti potřebné k tomu, aby dokázali sbírat, analyzovat a vyhodnocovat informace z otevřených zdrojů profesionálně, eticky a v souladu s právními normami.

Open-source intelligence je dnes klíčovou disciplínou v korporátní bezpečnosti, due diligence i vyšetřování. Tento kurz studentům poskytne praktické dovednosti potřebné k efektivní práci s OSINT a SOCMINT nástroji – od sběru dat ze sociálních sítí a veřejných registrů přes analýzu Dark Webu až po pokročilou síťovou rekognoskaci a geolokaci. Prostřednictvím praktických cvičení a reálných scénářů se studenti naučí pracovat s moderními nástroji i AI automatizací, porozumí etickým a právním hranicím OSINT a osvojí si zásady bezpečné a zodpovědné práce s informacemi.

Main Responsibilities

  • Sdílet se studenty své odborné znalosti a zkušenosti z praxe.

  • Připravovat a vést poutavé prezenční i online workshopy podle připravené osnovy, která propojuje teorii, praktické ukázky a interaktivní cvičení.

  • Podporovat, motivovat a provázet studenty během celého vzdělávacího procesu.

  • Vytvářet inspirativní, otevřené a podporující prostředí, které podněcuje aktivní zapojení, spolupráci a sdílení zkušeností.

  • Průběžně sledovat nové trendy v oblasti moderního pracovního prostředí a začleňovat aktuální poznatky, technologie a osvědčené postupy do výuky.

Requirements

  • Zkušenost na pozicích jako Corporate Security Specialist, Threat Intelligence Analyst, Forensics Specialist, Senior OSINT Consultant, Due Diligence Analyst nebo Intelligence Officer.

  • Ideálně 5–10 a více let praxe v oblasti korporátní bezpečnosti, kybernetické bezpečnosti, vyšetřování nebo analytických rolí.

  • Zkušenost ze specializovaných bezpečnostních a vyšetřovacích agentur, společností Big4 (Forensics/Risk Advisory), kybernetických bezpečnostních firem, advokátních kanceláří (litigation support) nebo z pozic analytika u zpravodajských či policejních složek je výhodou.

  • Silná znalost OSINT a SOCMINT, včetně sběru a analýzy dat z otevřených zdrojů, sociálních sítí, veřejných rejstříků a mezinárodních obchodních registrů.

  • Zkušenost s OPSEC a přípravou pracovního prostředí – operační bezpečnost, minimalizace digitální stopy, bezpečné nastavení prostředí a správa krycích identit.

  • Znalost výzkumu v Dark Webu a Deep Webu, včetně sítě TOR, skrytých služeb, monitoringu úniků dat, unikajících přihlašovacích údajů a stealer logů.

  • Zkušenost s síťovou a datovou rekognoskací – výzkum DNS a certifikátů, práce s nástroji Shodan a Censys, analýza metadat a vizuální geolokace z fotografií a videí.

  • Znalost moderních nástrojů a AI, včetně automatizace vyhledávání pomocí AI, web scrapingu/skriptování a nástrojů pro vizualizaci dat či link analýzu.

  • Aktivní zapojení v mezinárodních bezpečnostních nebo vyšetřovacích asociacích (např. ASIS, WAD) nebo v relevantních komunitách zaměřených na cyber threat intelligence je výhodou.

  • Dobrá znalost právních a etických hranic OSINT, včetně GDPR, ochrany osobních údajů a rozdílu mezi legálním sběrem informací a nelegálním hackingem.

  • Ideálně zkušenost s přednášením nebo výukou – vystupování na konferencích o kybernetické bezpečnosti, publikování výzkumu nebo vedení workshopů/školení pro firemní či státní klienty.

Co nabízíme

  • Přátelské a podnětné pracovní prostředí.

  • Samostatnost a kreativní svobodu při vedení kurzů.

  • Neomezený přístup ke všem kurzům XPUP (a slevy pro rodinné příslušníky).

  • Atraktivní referral program.

  • Příležitost pomáhat budovat novou generaci lidí, kteří rozumí datům a umí je využít v praxi.

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building alarge and complex product ecosystemthat serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a moderncheckout experience and customizable widgets(each a standalone SPA),donor, organization, and partner portals,admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

Gift Cart is one of Fundraise Up's fastest-growing giving surfaces — it lets donors support multiple causes in a single checkout, giving nonprofits a new way to present their programmes and deepen donor engagement beyond a standard donation form. It's already live and scaling across organisations running everything from humanitarian aid to symbolic animal adoptions.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Gift Cart end-to-end: strategy, discovery, and delivery. You'll shape the roadmap, drive adoption, and grow the metrics that matter — average order value, multi-designation rate, and reliability — while safeguarding the payment and ledger correctness, risk posture, and operability that a financial product demands. This is a full-lifecycle role: you'll go from strategic thinking to engineering-ready specs to launch, working closely with engineering, risk, and design along the way.

If you enjoy owning a product from "why does this matter" through to "it's live and working," this is built for that.

What You’ll Own

  • Define the Gift Cart strategy and translate it into a roadmap — with clear priorities and reasoning behind every decision.
  • Communicate with customers and CSMs regularly, and analyze data together with the analytics team — to find growth opportunities and make informed decisions.
  • Write specifications that engineers can build from — with detailed requirements and edge cases covered.
  • Take features from idea to launch, working closely with design and engineering at every step.
  • Track product health and growth: conversion, average gift size, error rates — and understand what's driving them.
  • Prepare CSMs and Sales for every launch so they're always in context ahead of time.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned — on priorities, timelines, and changes in plans.

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product area end-to-end — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Ability to build a strategy and roadmap for 12–24 months — and clearly explain the reasoning behind your decisions.

Anovium is a technology consultancy that transforms operations through intelligent innovation. - Thrives on transforming complex business challenges into elegant solutions
- Values both technical excellence and practical business outcomes
- Brings a partnership mentality to client relationships
- Has a genuine interest in logistics, transportation, or healthcare technology

If and when problems arise, you will encourage the team and clients to weigh different approaches and methods before rushing to apply bandages.

What You'll Do

  • Orchestrate Delivery. You’ll be taking ownership of deliveries in alignment with product goals and customer satisfaction.

Who You Are

  • Adaptable and Dynamic. You are able to manage different projects and people, shifting priorities as new information and situations arise.
  • An Expert in Group Dynamics. Diversity is a strength, as long as it's recognized. You can reach people from different schools of thought and work styles and get them on the same page.
  • Organized. Very Organized. You’re that person who everyone says is always on the ball, and you're able to leverage modern toolsets to ensure it.
  • Analytical and quantitative. You have the patience to understand technical challenges and motivation to keep up with current industry trends and pitfalls to better understand risk/reward scenarios. This allows you to make timely decisions and recommendations.
  • Emotionally Intelligent. Your EQ is high and your interpersonal skills are strong.
  • A Creator of Value. You’re obsessed with the creation and delivery of value.
  • Successful in Fast-Paced Environments. Anovium has an environment of high iteration. At times, this can cause uncertainty. You aren’t held back by the fear of being wrong or making a mistake, and you are comfortable managing team members operating with the same freedom to make mistakes and learn.
  • A Strong Leader. You’re passionate. You take pride in your ability to empathetically lead teams to a shared goal. You forge alignment among stakeholders and teams through common reason and firm decision-making.
  • Candid but Respectful. You are capable of helping others confront uncomfortable truths. You admit mistakes and openly disagree while explaining why.

Excited but Not a 100% Fit?

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you're excited about this role and have a strong background in sales, business development, or account management, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Controller to lead accounting operations, financial reporting, compliance, internal controls, and finance team performance.

This is a senior, hands-on accounting leadership role with ownership across month-end and year-end close, GAAP/IFRS reporting, audit readiness, internal controls, treasury and cash management, budgeting support, team leadership, and ERP/process improvement.

You’ll work closely with executive leadership and FP&A to maintain accurate financials, strengthen accounting operations, and translate financial data into actionable business insights.

If you combine deep technical accounting expertise with strong leadership skills and can balance financial control with strategic decision support, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Month-End & Year-End Close

  • Own monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes
  • Drive a 5-business-day month-end close
  • Review and approve:
    • Journal entries
    • Accruals
    • Balance sheet reconciliations

    • Profit & Loss Statements
    • Balance Sheets

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare accurate GAAP and/or IFRS-compliant financial statements

    • Board reporting
    • Investor reporting

Internal Controls, Audit & Compliance

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Partner with FP&A and leadership on annual budgets and forecasts
  • Analyze financial performance against plans
  • Support scenario planning and capital allocation decisions
  • Provide accounting and financial insights for strategic initiatives
  • Help leadership understand financial risks, opportunities, and trade-offs

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and working capital
  • Maintain visibility into short- and long-term cash requirements
  • Support cash planning and treasury operations
  • Oversee debt compliance and credit facilities
  • Help maintain financial stability as the organization grows

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage accountants and finance team members
  • Delegate responsibilities and establish clear priorities
  • Review team outputs for accuracy and completeness
  • Develop team capabilities and strengthen accounting discipline
  • Establish high standards for:
    • Accuracy
    • Timeliness
    • Documentation
    • Accountability
  • Build a high-performing and reliable accounting function

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies across accounting and reporting workflows
  • Lead or support ERP implementations and system improvements
  • Automate repetitive accounting and reporting processes
  • Develop and improve financial SOPs
  • Strengthen scalability as transaction volume and organizational complexity increase
  • Improve financial visibility through better systems, reporting, and controls

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • 2+ years of accounting leadership or supervisory experience
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and/or IFRS
  • Proven experience owning month-end and year-end close
  • Strong financial statement preparation and reporting experience
  • Experience designing or maintaining internal controls
  • Experience supporting or managing external audits
  • Hands-on experience with ERP/accounting systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
    • QuickBooks Enterprise
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets proficiency
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Comfortable leading teams remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • CPA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent professional qualification
  • Previous experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Finance Manager
  • ERP implementation or accounting system migration experience
  • M&A integration experience
  • Multi-entity or consolidated accounting experience
  • Background in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional Services
    • Real Estate
  • Experience with BI and reporting platforms such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker

Tools & Technology

NetSuite | SAP | Oracle | QuickBooks Enterprise | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Take full ownership of financial accuracy and reporting
  • Can lead a finance team while remaining hands-on when needed
  • Understand both the technical and operational sides of accounting
  • Proactively identify financial risks and control weaknesses
  • Can translate complex financial information into clear executive insights
  • Build scalable processes instead of relying on manual workarounds
  • Hold yourself and your team to high standards for accuracy and deadlines
  • Are comfortable partnering directly with senior leadership
  • Approach financial controls as a way to improve both accuracy and business decision-making

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing close progress, reconciliations, cash position, and outstanding accounting items.

Throughout the day, you’ll review financial statements and journal entries, analyze variances, collaborate with FP&A and executive leadership, respond to audit or compliance requirements, and provide guidance to accounting team members.

You’ll also work on longer-term improvements such as ERP optimization, automation, internal controls, and accounting SOPs.

In short: you own the financial control environment—ensuring leadership has accurate numbers, reliable processes, and clear financial visibility.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Month-end close completed within 5 business days
  • Accurate and timely financial statements

  • 100% on-time compliance and required filings
  • Strong balance sheet reconciliation accuracy
  • Reliable cash flow and liquidity visibility
  • Improved accounting workflow efficiency

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct collaboration with executives and senior leadership

  • Meaningful accounting team leadership responsibility
  • Opportunity to improve ERP systems, controls, and accounting processes
  • Fully remote environment

Apply today and take ownership of a finance function where accuracy, leadership, and strategic financial visibility directly impact business growth.

Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Remote
Annual salary:USD 150,000 - USD 180,000
Type: Full-time
Reports to: General Counsel

About the Role

We're hiring our firstSr Manager/Director, Legal Operationsto serve as the front door of Legal at Nex Playground and to design and build the operational infrastructure the company will need over the next 18 months and beyond.The role may be leveled at Sr Manager or Director based on the candidate’s experience and demonstrated scope. Reporting directly to the General Counsel, you will be the first dedicated legal operations hire in the company. You will work in partnership with the GC and business leaders to define our target operating model, and build the systems, processes, and technology that let Legal, and the business it supports, move fast.

This is a builder's role with real breadth. You'll lead the rollout of our first contract lifecycle management (CLM) system, stand up corporate governance rhythms, own legal aspects of our international entities, and build the playbooks and templates. You'll also spend real time in the weeds triaging requests, coordinating signatures, and being the person the rest of the company calls first, while building the systems that reduce how much of that falls on you over time.

The work is heavily corporate and commercial: retail and distribution agreements, vendor and supply chain contracts, brand licensing deals, NDAs, and the corporate housekeeping that comes with a fast-growing, increasingly international hardware + software company.

What You'll Do

Legal Intake & Contract Operations

  • Be the front door of Legal: own intake for all incoming legal requests, triage and route them appropriately, track status, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Lead implementation of our first CLM system (Spotdraft or Ironclad), including workflow design, templates, approval routing, finance and e-signature integration, and reporting.
  • Build our formal contract lifecycle from the ground up: drafting support, redlining coordination, approvals, execution, and repository/renewal tracking for NDAs, vendor agreements, retail and distribution contracts, and brand licensing agreements.
  • Design a template and playbook library for our highest-volume agreement types, in partnership with the GC and Commercial Counsel, so the business can self-serve on lower-risk requests.
  • Establish signature and approval workflows, including delegation of authority guidelines, e-signature administration (e.g., DocuSign), and coordination of notarization where needed.
  • Own Nex's employment-related form library (offer letters, standard employment agreements, contractor agreements, separation agreements, and similar templates), keeping them current and legally sound. People/HR populates and issues these day-to-day; you own the underlying template and update it as law or company policy changes.

Corporate Governance & Entity Management

  • Support corporate governance motions: track board and committee meeting materials, minutes, and written consents in partnership with the GC and CFO.
  • Maintain the corporate minute book, equity documentation, and corporate records, and coordinate with Finance/People on cap table accuracy and equity administration touchpoints (option grants, 409A timing).
  • Manage legal aspects of Nex's growing family of international entities: formations, dissolutions, foreign qualifications, registered agents, and local corporate filings as we expand into new markets.
  • Own trademark and brand licensing docketing: track licensor obligations, renewal deadlines, and brand compliance requirements across our partnership and licensing agreements, and maintain our internal trademark portfolio calendar.
  • [Manage the corporate insurance program (general liability, product liability, cyber, D&O): track renewals, coordinate broker relationships, and issue certificates of insurance for retail and distribution partners.]

Cross-Functional & Compliance Support

  • Administer vendor and outside counsel relationships: onboarding, billing oversight, budget tracking, and performance check-ins across the legal team's matters. You own the administrative layer; each attorney directs substantive strategy on their own active matters.
  • Build the legal team's knowledge management and document repository and establish a records retention policy.
  • Stand up legal metrics and reporting: request volume, cycle times, contract turnaround, and outside counsel spend, to give leadership visibility into how Legal is performing.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to speed up contract review, intake triage, and self-service for common requests.
  • Partner cross-functionally to understand client needs and workflows and build processes that make Legal a fast, trusted partner to the business.
  • [Coordinate documentation for hardware compliance and trade requirements as needed - customs paperwork, safety/regulatory certification records, and import/export documentation - alongside outside counsel, Commercial Counsel, and Product/Supply Chain.]
  • [Support the operational side of Nex's privacy program (e.g., data mapping, vendor DPA tracking, policy version control) in partnership with, and under the substantive direction of, Product Counsel, who owns the privacy program.]
  • Support the operational execution of Nex’s Trust & Safety program, including policy lifecycle management, program and project management, risk and issue tracking, governance processes, metrics and reporting, documentation, vendor management, and cross-functional coordination, in partnership with and under the substantive direction of the Trust & Safety leader and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 5-7+ years of experience in legal operations, corporate/contracts paralegal work, or a similar operational role - ideally including time at a high-growth startup or consumer products/hardware company.
  • A genuine builder's mentality: you've stood up processes, systems, and governance rhythms where none existed, not just optimized an existing playbook.
  • Hands-on experience administering a CLM or similar workflow system (Ironclad, SpotDraft, DocuSign CLM, or comparable); direct Spotdraft or Ironclad experience is a strong plus.
  • Experience supporting corporate governance (board materials, minutes, entity management) at a private company, ideally including multi-entity or international structures.
  • Comfort working across a genuinely broad scope - intake triage, contract drafting support, governance, entity management, insurance, and vendor management - without needing a narrow lane.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle high-volume day-to-day requests and longer-term build projects at the same time.
  • Excellent judgment, discretion, and comfort handling sensitive and confidential business, board, and customer information.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills and the instinct to make Legal's processes easy for the rest of the company to follow.
  • Curiosity about applying AI tools to legal operations work, and a bias toward pragmatic, scrappy solutions over heavyweight process.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in consumer hardware, consumer electronics, gaming, or toy/kids' products.
  • Familiarity with retail and distribution contracting, brand/IP licensing agreements, or international expansion and entity setup.
  • Experience supporting a fundraise, board of directors, or investor reporting cadence at a venture-backed company.
