What Success Looks Like

  • The business has one clear front door for legal requests, with predictable turnaround times.
  • Nex's first CLM system is live, with templates and workflows covering the highest-volume agreement types.
  • Corporate governance, entity management, and trademark docketing run on a reliable calendar instead of being reconstructed reactively.
  • Outside counsel spend and performance are visible and managed, not a black box.
  • The GC and attorneys spend materially less time on administrative and process work than they did before this role existed.

We Offer

  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

jobs.description:
Fractional Lead Marketing Manager (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech business developing technology designed to improve access to financial services for businesses operating internationally.

The company is entering an important stage of its development and is building out its leadership and functional capability as it moves towards greater commercial readiness and growth.

As part of this next phase, the business is looking for a Fractional Lead Marketing Manager who can take meaningful ownership of its developing marketing function.

This is not a traditional marketing-management position within an established department.

You will be joining an early-stage organisation where positioning, messaging, channels, content and marketing processes are still developing. You will therefore need to be equally comfortable thinking strategically and personally executing the work required to turn that strategy into activity.

The opportunity is particularly suited to an ambitious marketing professional who is ready for broader functional ownership, enjoys building rather than inheriting, and wants the opportunity to demonstrate their ability within an early-stage FinTech environment.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter. Within your cover letter, you must answer each of the mandatory qualifying questions below.

  1. What experience do you have within B2B marketing, FinTech, financial services or another complex technology environment?
  2. Please provide an example of a marketing strategy, campaign or go-to-market initiative that you personally helped create and execute. What did you personally do and what was the outcome?
  3. What experience do you have developing positioning, messaging and content for complex B2B products or services?
  4. Please provide an example of marketing activity that you personally executed rather than delegated to a team or agency.
  5. What experience do you have generating measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified pipeline, customer engagement, partnerships, adoption or revenue?
  6. What experience do you have working within an early-stage or resource-conscious organisation where you were required to operate without a large established marketing team or budget?
  7. Do you have experience within FinTech, payments, banking, lending, trade finance or another regulated financial-services environment? Please explain.
  8. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this level of involvement alongside your other professional commitments?

These questions are mandatory and form part of our initial assessment process. Applications that do not provide a clear answer to every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not be considered further in the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help build and lead the company's developing marketing capability, including:

  • Developing and executing the marketing plan
  • Refining market positioning, messaging and value proposition
  • Supporting go-to-market activity
  • Creating and coordinating content across relevant channels
  • Developing the company's digital and professional market presence
  • Supporting thought leadership and founder-led marketing
  • Developing communications for different audiences and stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial, partnership and customer-facing initiatives
  • Helping translate complex financial and technical concepts into clear external narratives
  • Identifying appropriate marketing channels and testing their effectiveness
  • Developing appropriate campaign and content calendars
  • Establishing marketing metrics and reporting
  • Using data and market feedback to improve activity
  • Helping determine future marketing resource and capability requirements as the organisation grows

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity. You should expect to personally execute activity rather than simply develop strategy for others to deliver.

What We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Strong B2B marketing experience
  • Experience taking meaningful ownership of marketing activity
  • Strong positioning and messaging capability
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Experience creating and executing marketing plans
  • Strong commercial instincts
  • Experience working with senior leaders or founders
  • Confidence marketing technically or financially complex propositions
  • Experience operating within early-stage or high-growth environments
  • The ability to prioritise effectively when resources are limited
  • The willingness to remain hands-on while taking increasing functional ownership
  • The ability to make meaningful impact within approximately 6–8 hours per week

Experience within FinTech, financial services, payments, banking, B2B technology or another regulated environment would be particularly valuable.

We are more interested in demonstrable capability, ownership and results than job title or corporate seniority.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week within an early-stage FinTech venture.

It is designed for someone who understands the nature of participating in an early-stage business and is comfortable with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional package at this stage.

The role can therefore be undertaken alongside other compatible professional commitments.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

  • Maintain and update the Property Management Software and digital tools to ensure information remains accurate at all times.

TOOLS

  • Maintenance IQ — Required

  • Google Workspace / Microsoft Office
  • Resident Communication Portals

WHAT WE VALUE MOST

  • You proactively follow up on resident requests instead of waiting for residents to ask again.
  • You keep work orders moving until they are resolved.

jobs.title: Director, GTM Enablement
jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

CoLab’s go-to-market org is scaling across sales, BDR, and customer success. This role exists to make sure that growth is backed by real capability, not just headcount.

The short version: you’re a thought partner to GTM leadership who turns half-formed observations into programs that move numbers.

Here’s what that looks like in practice. An executive team member says, “I think our BDRs need a sharper point of view on personas and messaging.” You take it from there. You figure out where the gap actually is, write the messaging yourself, design the program, roll it out alongside BDR leadership with real checkpoints, measure whether it’s landing, and then hand ongoing management over so the program doesn’t live and die with you.

Or: stage two conversion is softer than it should be. You pull the data yourself or with RevOps, form a hypothesis or two, go audit the calls in Gong, and come back with a specific fix and a plan to roll it out.

Nobody is going to hand you a spec. The value you add lives in the distance between a vague concern and a program that worked.

The Team You’ll Build

  • Technical Enablement Specialist (hiring in the near term) — owns industry enablement, discovery and demo certification, and new product enablement
  • Field Enablement Coach (planned) — call review and scoring at scale, plus individual coaching

You’ll set the strategy for both roles and make sure they’re structured to be effective. You’ll also do this work yourself. You need to be able to sit down with a stack of Gong calls and find the pattern, not just direct someone else to.

Working Across the Org

Enablement here isn’t a sales-only function. You’ll build programs that hold together across sales, BDR, customer success, marketing, and RevOps, which means a lot of your job is convening the right people and driving a rollout that everyone actually executes.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you’ll have audited the current state of enablement across the funnel, identified where reps are actually struggling using data and direct conversations, and shipped at least one program that addresses a gap you found.

By six months, new GTM hires are ramping measurably faster, there’s a repeatable onboarding program that doesn’t depend on you running it personally, and your technical enablement specialist is productive and pointed at the right problems.

By twelve months, enablement is a function the GTM org relies on rather than tolerates. You can point to specific programs and specific movement in the metrics they were built to affect, across both pre-sale and post-sale teams. Just as importantly, managers are sustaining those programs themselves.

What You’ll Own

  • Act as a thought partner to GTM leadership, taking early signals and turning them into diagnosed problems and shipped programs
  • Diagnose performance gaps using funnel data, call review, rep feedback, and partnership with RevOps
  • Build and own onboarding for new GTM hires, with a clear focus on reducing time to ramp
  • Write messaging and positioning that reps can actually use, working with marketing and technical SMEs
  • Design and deliver programs across the full lifecycle: pipeline generation, discovery, stage conversion, deal progression, onboarding, retention, and expansion
  • Roll out every program in collaboration with function owners, with structured checkpoints and measurement built in from the start rather than bolted on after
  • Equip sales, BDR, and CS managers to reinforce and sustain programs long after launch
  • Build and lead the enablement team, and set the strategy for technical enablement and field coaching
  • Measure the impact of everything against rep performance and business outcomes, and kill what isn’t working

What We’re Looking For

You’ve earned credibility with sellers. You understand what good enablement looks like because you’ve lived through the bad kind. You know what moves the needle in a deal, and you have strong opinions about designing programs people actually use.

You come with ideas and run with them. You don’t wait for a brief. You hear a problem in a pipeline review, form a point of view on it, and come back with a plan and a first version. We’ll give you real autonomy here and we expect you to use it.

You’re diagnostic. You don’t guess where the problem is. You go find it, whether that means pulling apart funnel data with RevOps or listening to twenty calls until the pattern shows up.

You can write. Not just package what marketing hands you. You can build positioning and messaging from scratch and make it sharp enough that a rep will actually say it out loud on a call.

You build things that outlive your attention. Your programs get handed to the managers who own the teams, with enough structure that they can run and reinforce them without you in the room.

You’ve led people. You’ve managed or developed a team before, and you know the difference between doing the work and building a group that can do it without you.

You’re comfortable with complexity. You don’t need to be a technical expert, but you can dig into a technical product, partner with SMEs, and translate what you learn into something a rep can use on a call tomorrow.

You Might Be Coming From

There’s more than one good path into this role. A few we’d be glad to see:

  • Sales leadership. You’ve run a team as a Director or Manager of Sales. You know exactly where reps stall because you’ve watched it happen, and you’d rather fix it at the system level than one pipeline review at a time. If you’re a sales leader who wants to move into enablement, we think that’s a strong move, not a step sideways.
  • Teaching, training, or instructional design. You understand how adults actually learn and retain things, and you’ve paired that with enough commercial exposure to hold your own in a room full of quota carriers.
  • An enablement role you’ve outgrown. You’ve built programs that worked and you want a bigger canvas, a team, and a seat closer to the strategy.

Qualifications

  • 6–8+ years across some combination of sales, sales leadership, enablement, or training and instructional design, ideally with B2B SaaS exposure
  • Enough time in or alongside a revenue team to have credibility with reps from day one
  • Experience managing or developing people
  • A track record of designing and delivering programs that produced measurable performance improvements
  • Hands-on experience with conversation intelligence tools like Gong or Chorus, and the ability to turn call review into a specific coaching plan
  • Comfort working with funnel data directly, whether alongside RevOps or on your own
  • Strong understanding of sales process and methodology, and fluency with full-funnel metrics
  • Experience enabling post-sale teams, or a clear appetite for it
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills

If this role interests you but you don’t match every line above, we’d still like to hear from you. Very few people check every box, and we’d rather see what you actually bring than screen you out on a list.

340B Program ManagerRemote | Full-Time

Who We Are

NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.

What We Are Looking For

At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:

  • Mission Always: Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
  • Be a Pioneer: Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
  • Do the Right Thing the Right Way: Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
  • Stronger Together: Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

We are also a fast-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.

About the Role

The 340B Program Manager is responsible for the oversight, administration, and ongoing compliance monitoring of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for assigned Covered Entity (CE) clients supported by NuvemRx. This position supports a variety of 340B-eligible organizations, including Federally Qualified Health Centers, Disproportionate Share Hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, and other eligible provider organizations.

The 340B Program Manager ensures program compliance with HRSA guidance, federal regulations, manufacturer requirements, and internal operational standards. This role oversees compliance monitoring activities, audit readiness, operational workflows, and program documentation while serving as a key liaison between clients and internal operational teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

What You'll Do

Program Administration & Compliance

  • Manage and oversee day-to-day administration of assigned 340B programs to ensure compliance with HRSA guidance and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and compliance resource for assigned Covered Entities regarding 340B program operations, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct routine compliance reviews, internal audits, account monitoring, reconciliations, and operational assessments to identify potential risks or compliance concerns.
  • Monitor program activity, data integrity, accumulations, replenishment activity, and operational workflows to ensure compliant program administration.
  • Support and manage 340B ESP submission activities and manufacturer inquiry resolution processes as needed.
  • Develop, maintain, and update policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support compliant 340B program operations.

Audit Readiness & Risk Management

  • Support preparation for HRSA audits, manufacturer audits, payer reviews, and internal compliance assessments, including documentation collection, audit support, and corrective action tracking.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready documentation related to compliance monitoring, operational activities, and client program management.
  • Analyze program data and operational performance to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, compliant savings optimization, and risk mitigation.

Client Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Covered Entity leadership, pharmacy operations, finance, wholesalers, manufacturers, contract pharmacies, and third-party administrators (TPAs) to support compliant and effective program operations.
  • Participate in client meetings, compliance discussions, operational reviews, onboarding activities, and strategic program initiatives.
  • Provide education and operational guidance to clients and internal stakeholders regarding 340B program requirements and best practices.

What You Bring

Core Capabilities

  • Deep working knowledge of the 340B Drug Pricing Program, including HRSA guidance, compliance requirements, and program operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex compliance workstreams simultaneously, with high accuracy and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data, identify trends, and surface actionable insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both frontline pharmacy staff and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing 340B programs for FQHCs, DSH hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, or other covered entities.
  • Familiarity with 340B third-party administrators (TPAs), ESP submissions, and manufacturer compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting HRSA audits or internal compliance assessments.
  • Background in pharmacy operations, healthcare compliance, or healthcare administration.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and 340B software platforms.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • You are a compliance-minded professional who takes ownership of program integrity without being prompted.
  • You are energized by complex regulatory environments and find purpose in keeping programs airtight for clients that serve vulnerable patient populations.
  • You proactively identify risks before they become problems and bring a clear, recommended path forward.
  • You build trust with clients through consistent expertise, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • You thrive in a role that requires both deep subject matter expertise and strong cross-functional collaboration.

Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible PTO
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • 401(k) with match
  • Life and disability coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Mission-driven team
  • WFH stipend

Compensation

The expected base compensation for this role is $80,000-85,000 per year.

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, location, and internal equity.

Our client, a growing alternative-financing company, is seeking a Director of Strategic Partnerships & Origination to expand its professional referral network and generate lower-middle-market financing opportunities, typically ranging from $1M–$25M.   • Proven business development, origination, or relationship-management experience within commercial finance or an adjacent financial-services field.

  • Background in private credit, commercial banking, M&A/advisory, investment banking, ABL, factoring, SBA lending, equipment finance, or a related area.

  • Experience with lower-middle-market transactions, ideally $1M–$25M.

  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

jobs.excerpt: A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH USWe're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others.
jobs.description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary

As a Technical Community Support with SmartSimple’s Essential Support team at Foundant, you'll be the voice of customer support and a critical link between our clients and internal teams. You’ll provide prompt, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to help mission-driven organizations succeed with our software. This role combines troubleshooting expertise with a passion for customer success, operating as a technical problem-solver and customer advocate who helps organizations achieve their missions more efficiently and effectively.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

  • Respond to and triage inbound support tickets, applying initial diagnosis and prioritization based on severity and SLA.
  • Troubleshoot common SmartSimple configuration, workflow, and reporting issues, resolving independently where possible.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Subject Matter Experts with clear documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain accurate, timely ticket notes and status updates in the ticketing system (powered by Zendesk) to support reporting on KPIs and knowledge continuity.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Test fixes provided by the Engineering team and incorporate them into client systems.
  • Advocate new platform features and assist clients in adopting these through upgrades, configuration changes, or training. Provide instruction and documentation to ensure the technical success of these initiatives.  
  • Facilitate relationships across client success, internal teams, and departments to strengthen partnerships.
  • Contributor to continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Support.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities and process improvement discussions.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for ticket volume, response time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Some travel may be required (estimated less than 10%).
  • Other duties as assigned.

WhatYou’llNeed:

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Sciences, Mathematics (STEM) field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, or SaaS support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly; prior exposure to SaaS, CRM, or grants management tools is a plus.
  • Solid troubleshooting instincts - able to isolate a problem, test hypotheses, and document findings.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing a queue of concurrent tickets.
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically, while providing consistent and high levels of client satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud and SaaS terminology.
  • Fundamental knowledge of databases and SQL - able to read basic queries, understand table relationships, and assist with simple data troubleshooting.
  • Field data storage concepts - understanding of data types, field mappings, and how data is stored and retrieved in database systems.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge - able to read and understand HTML/CSS code, troubleshoot formatting issues.
  • JavaScript fundamentals - able to recognize JavaScript syntax, understand basic functions and logic, and troubleshoot workflow automations.
  • Workflow automation concepts - understanding of conditional logic, triggers, actions, and how automated workflows function in SaaS.
  • Integration protocols and SSO (Single Sign-On) - familiarity with how external systems connect via integrations, including SMTP, SFTP, API connections, and authentication methods.
  • Data analytics fundamentals - able to interpret reports, understand data visualizations, and assist with report troubleshooting and configuration.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with SaaS, SmartSimple or similar technology platforms.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform such as Zendesk.
  • Exposure to the nonprofit, philanthropic, or grants management sector.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

AgriSompo North America is a part of AgriSompo, Sompo International’s global agriculture platform. This platform is an integrated underwriting, technology and distribution platform delivering innovate insurance and reinsurance solutions to agriculture partners worldwide. Sompo International, AgriSompo’s parent company, is a global organization driven by its core values, a carrier that holds promise, trust and the commitment to protect. Through operating subsidiaries, Sompo International writes agriculture, casualty and other specialty, professional lines, property, marine/energy and aviation lines of insurance and catastrophe, property, casualty, professional lines and specialty lines of reinsurance.

As a leading provider of crop insurance and other agricultural risk management tools, we recognize that our success is derived directly from those whose contributions matter most: our people. AgriSompo North America has major offices in Lenexa, Kansas and Des Moines, Iowa as well as regional offices around the country. A shared commitment to integrity, accountability, collaboration and agility define our culture, and we strive to create exceptional value for our clients and shareholders and maintain AgriSompo North America as a desirable place to work.

Job Description

Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a WFRPClaims Specialist in our West Region team.

As a Whole Farm Revenue Protection (WFRP) Claims Specialist will provide exceptional customer service to agents and producers by accurately and efficiently auditing and verifying WFRP Claims. You'll serve as an expert in areas of WFRP claims procedure and auditing. The WFRP Claims Specialist will also provide research and verification of claims/policy data, troubleshoot identified problems or issues, and train other staff as needed in the area of WFRP Claims.

Location: This position may be based remotely in Washington, California, Illinois, Texas, Florida, Kentucky, or Oregon,with consideration also given to candidates located in other U.S. state. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environmentwhere our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity:

What you’ll be doing:

  • Audit, review, and process WFRP claims accurately and timely in accordance with policy requirements, standard operating procedures, and regulatory guidelines

  • Research and resolve complex claims, policy, and system issues, including PASS errors, with limited supervision

  • Serve as a resource on WFRP claims procedures, policy interpretation, and related underwriting and claims processes

  • Partner with underwriters, adjusters, compliance staff, agents, and producers to resolve questions and support effective claim handling

  • Apply working knowledge of WFRP, MPCI, FCIC, NCIS, RMA, and related manuals, handbooks, and policy documentation to support claim decisions

  • Support continuous improvement by identifying system issues, assisting with training development, and helping implement process enhancements

  • Maintain knowledge of regional crops, farming practices, and internal procedures to support strong claims performance

  • Adapt to changing priorities, systems, and business needs while maintaining strong research quality and timely execution.

  • Travel as needed, up to 25%

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of MPCI or WFRP crop insurance experience preferred

  • Advanced knowledge of FCIC MPCI and WFRP policies, with the ability to interpret policy provisions and supporting documentation

  • Knowledge of IRS federal tax forms, company policies and procedures, and related claims or underwriting systems preferred

  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat

  • Strong analytical, mathematical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work well across all levels inside and outside the organization

  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently and as part of a team

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, adapt to change, and work effectively through complex issues

Physical Requirements & Work Conditions

  • Ability to stand or sit constantly/continuously.

  • Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.

  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading; visual inspection involving small defects, small parts, and/or operation of machines (including inspection); using measurement devices; and/or assembly or fabrication parts at distances close to the eyes.

Environmental Conditions

jobs.description:
Como Pessoa Pesquisadora de Produto de Métodos Mistos, você moldará nossos produtos de língua de sinais alimentados por IA, desde a concepção até como eles aprendem com o mundo real — conectando experiência do usuário, dados comportamentais e avaliação de modelos em um sistema de aprendizado unificado. Seu trabalho influenciará diretamente as decisões de produto, a qualidade do modelo e a confiança do usuário para as comunidades surdas e com deficiência auditiva. A maioria das organizações trata pesquisa, análise e feedback como funções separadas. O resultado é um insight fragmentado, aprendizado lento e oportunidades perdidas. Estamos adotando uma abordagem diferente. Você fará parte de uma equipe multifuncional de Insights trabalhando na intersecção de IA/ML, desenvolvimento de produtos e acessibilidade. Fazemos parceria estreita com Produto, IA/ML, Design e a comunidade Surda — porque os usuários não são apenas participantes; eles são essenciais para construir sistemas melhores.

Trabalhamos todos os dias com gente muito talentosa focada no mesmo propósito: tornar o mundo um lugar mais acessível e justo para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos a colaboratividade e temos um gigante espírito de equipe, mesmo à distância, temos muita proximidade com todos e todas. Venha compartilhar conhecimento e impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas no Brasil e em todo o planeta. Venha ser HandTalker!

Então se você quer fazer parte dessa missão de quebrar barreiras de comunicação entre pessoas surdas e ouvintes através da tecnologia no mundo inteiro, trabalhe conosco e conheça mais daHand Talk!

  • Faça parte de um time AAA.

  • Trabalhe lado a lado com alguns dos empreendedores sociais mais reconhecidos no Brasil e no mundo.
  • Tenha o protagonismo na sua carreira em um ambiente com projetos desafiadores.
  • Um ambiente altamente desafiador e colaborativo.
  • Possibilidade de aprendizado e crescimento acelerado, com oportunidade de implementar projetos que serão cases de sucesso no mundo digital.

Visite nosso blog, canal no Youtube, redes sociais ou dá um Google aí que também vai achar muita coisa bacana sobre a Hand Talk!

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Projetar e executar pesquisas de métodos mistos de ponta a ponta em múltiplas frentes de trabalho de produtos de IA.
  • Traduzir questões ambíguas de produtos e modelos em planos de pesquisa claros e acionáveis — abrangendo descoberta, testes de conceito e avaliação de experiência.
  • Estudar como os usuários surdos vivenciam a comunicação em contextos reais, utilizando métodos moderados e não moderados.
  • Elaborar pesquisas e métricas de experiência que possam ser acompanhadas ao longo do tempo; estabelecer relatórios recorrentes que acumulem aprendizado, e não estudos isolados.
  • Definir sinais comportamentais e requisitos de instrumentação em parceria com as equipes de Produto e Engenharia.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de IA/ML e Insights para definir os critérios de sucesso (o que significa um "bom resultado") — contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de frameworks de medição da qualidade da interpretação e da eficácia da comunicação.
  • Implementar sistemas de feedback e cadências de acompanhamento para recursos recém-lançados; garantir que os insights orientem continuamente as decisões de produtos e modelos.
  • Comunicar os resultados de forma clara por meio de entregáveis focados e direcionados à tomada de decisões.
  • Colaborar de forma multifuncional com as equipes de Produto, IA/ML, Design e partes interessadas (stakeholders) da comunidade para formular perguntas que conectem os sinais de experiência à melhoria dos modelos.
  • Manter práticas de pesquisa que sejam respeitosas, transparentes e significativas para os participantes.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • 6–8+ anos de experiência em pesquisa aplicada em ambientes de produto ou tecnologia
  • Forte experiência em pesquisa qualitativa (moderada + não moderada), design e análise de pesquisas, e análise básica comportamental ou de produto
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com diversos métodos e selecionar a abordagem certa para o problema em questão
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e trabalho com métricas de produto e experiência
  • Conforto na construção de sistemas de medição leves (rastreamento, painéis, relatórios)
  • Fortes habilidades destorytellinge comunicação
  • Inglês avançado para conversação

Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Curiosidade, colaboratividade, estrutura e orientação para a ação
  • Confortável trabalhando em ambiguidade e em ambientes de estágio inicial
  • Foco no impacto — não apenas na produção (output)
  • Experiência trabalhando com comunidades onde confiança e sensibilidade cultural são importantes
  • Forte compromisso com práticas de pesquisa inclusivas e éticas

﻿Diferenciais:

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Sunco.com is a leading online lighting retailer headquartered in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, we are proud to be one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We deeply value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture and are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day. With our new state-of-the-art distribution center in Georgia, we continue to expand our reach and enhance our ability to serve our customers with excellence and efficiency. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that is lighting the way to a brighter future.

What We Do

We light up the world, literally. Customers have chosen Sunco to provide millions of LED lights and trust us for our exceptional customer service, eco-conscious product expertise, and unmatched value.

About the role

We’re looking for a talented Video Editor to join Sunco’s Marketing team and support the growth of our video content pipeline. This role will focus on editing both short-form and long-form videos for ads, social media, tutorials, and brand storytelling.

You’ll collaborate closely with content managers, writers, designers, and videographers to bring video concepts to life while maintaining Sunco’s brand standards and performance goals.

What you'll do

  • Collaborate with content managers, writers, designers, and videographers to develop video concepts, edit plans, and basic storyboards.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos for ads, promotions, tutorials, and brand storytelling using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar tools.
  • Create platform-native edits and variations for Amazon, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Vimeo, and other channels—optimizing for format, length, hooks, and calls to action.
  • Ensure consistency in branding, messaging, tone, and visual style across all video content.
  • Add graphics, subtitles, simple motion design, and basic animations to improve clarity and engagement.
  • Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup, including music, sound effects, and voice balancing, while following licensing and brand guidelines.
  • Optimize video files, thumbnails, titles, and metadata for SEO and discoverability.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, creator best practices, and competitor content, and suggest new formats or creative tests.
  • Organize and maintain video assets, project files, and exports for efficient collaboration and reuse.
  • Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and partner teams while maintaining quality and timelines.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously, communicating clearly about progress and risks.
  • Partner with internal and external videographers or agencies when needed, providing clear briefs and edit requirements.
  • Work regular hours that substantially overlap with 8:00 am – 5:00 pm Pacific Time and attend scheduled meetings.
  • Support other video and content-related tasks as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in film production or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating end-to-end edits for digital channels, especially advertising.
  • Experience editing content from a variety of sources, including product footage, lifestyle shoots, UGC, and screen recordings.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, with moderate experience in 2D motion graphics.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, visual storytelling, composition, and motion design.
  • Familiarity with sound design basics, including sound effects, dialogue cleanup, music selection, and audio mixing.
  • Experience tailoring content for social media and marketplace platforms, especially short-form formats.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a distributed, multicultural team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Passion for staying current with video trends, tools, and best practices.
  • Experience with product, ecommerce, or B2B video campaigns is a plus.
  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  • Ability and willingness to work hours that substantially overlap with 8:00 am – 5:00 pm Pacific Time.

Key Attributes:

  • High level of integrity and dedication to quality.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong commitment to process improvement and operational excellence

Additional Requirements:

  • Availability to work between 8 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time
  • Reliable internet access and a private remote workstation.

    • Kindly ensure that your resume is submitted in English, as applications with resumes in other languages will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking an SEO (Search Engine Optimization)/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Specialist to conduct recurring technical SEO assessments and strengthen the technical health of a large, multi-property federal digital enterprise. In addition to core technical SEO, this role will help the organization adapt its content and information architecture for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), ensuring content is structured, discoverable, and citable across AI-powered answer surfaces (e.g., AI Overviews, conversational assistants, and voice-activated search) as well as traditional search engines. You'll dive into site speed, indexing, structured data, and schema markup work, and partner closely with content, UX, and engineering teams to build SEO/GEO best practices into every stage of the content lifecycle.

This project supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $75,000 – $85,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct monthly technical SEO audits across the client's digital properties, identifying issues such as broken links, indexation errors, slow-loading pages, and content delivery problems.

  • Optimize content for generative/AI answer engines (e.g., Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT search, Copilot) by structuring content for extractability and monitoring how the client's content is surfaced or cited in AI-generated answers.

  • Coordinate organic SEO/GEO strategy with the media messaging team to align keyword targeting and messaging across paid search (SEM), programmatic advertising, and owned-channel content (websites, blogs, newsletters).

  • Include on-site search functionality as part of daily monitoring of key pages and functions, and support quarterly content certification reviews to ensure content stays accurate, relevant, and discoverable.

  • Perform page speed optimization, address Core Web Vitals gaps, and recommend enhancements to reduce load time and improve mobile responsiveness.

  • Maintain and optimize XML sitemaps, robots.txt configurations, and crawlability settings.

  • Implement schema markup (JSON-LD), structured metadata, and microdata patterns to improve search visibility and content classification.

  • Enhance internal linking strategies and ensure taxonomy alignment for improved information architecture.

  • Support voice-search readiness through structured content improvements and search-friendly page architecture.

  • Validate search behavior, indexing patterns, and crawl logs to improve visibility and user discoverability.

  • Collaborate with developers, content teams, and UX staff to ensure technical SEO requirements are incorporated into releases.

  • Create and deliver SEO training materials, workshops, documentation, and best-practice guides to support workforce adoption.

  • Track key technical SEO KPIs and produce actionable insights for leadership.

  • Monitor algorithm updates and assess impacts to the client's digital properties.

  • Ensure technical SEO improvements align with federal, DoD, and accessibility requirements.

  • Establish and monitor goals, objectives, performance requirements, standards, and accountability with metrics to meet project requirements as well as Bixal standards.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Technology, or a relatedfield.

  • At least 5 years of experience performing technical SEO for enterprise websites, or equivalent combinationof education and/or experience.

  • This position must hold an active Secret clearance or higher, in support of a federal government contract.

  • Experience conducting technical audits using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, or equivalent.

  • Experience optimizing page speed, improving site structure, and applying schema markup.

  • Experience optimizing email/newsletter platforms (e.g., GovDelivery or similar) and subscription-based content for search visibility and discoverability.

  • Working knowledge of generative/AI search behavior (e.g., how Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity source and cite web content) and how to optimize content for LLM-based retrieval, in addition to traditional SEO tools.

  • Experience authoring structured content and FAQs for conversational and voice interfaces.

  • Understanding of search engine marketing (SEM) and paid media concepts

  • Experience collaborating with content, UX, and development teams on cross-functional SEO initiatives.

  • Experience developing documentation, training materials, or workshops for internal stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of SEO diagnostics, indexing signals, structured data, canonical rules, and website performance tuning.

  • Proficiency with SEO tools including Google Search Console, Lighthouse, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights.

  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript behavior, and CMS-driven platforms.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and mobile optimization best practices.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data.

  • Excellent oral and written communication and training abilities with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Attention to detail and commitment to precision in site diagnostics and documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent SEO initiatives and deadlines.

  • Collaborative mindset for working across content, UX, engineering, and PMO teams.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting federal, DoD, or large enterprise content ecosystems.

  • Familiarity with API-driven search services, metadata governance, and taxonomy standards.

  • Understanding of headless CMS or component-based content architectures.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

Position Summary

The Data Analyst collects, integrates, manages, and analyzes complex data to support strategic decisions. This position transforms data from multiple business systems into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and forecasts that help leadership understand business performance and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

Job Objectives

  1. Build predictive models to drive strategic growth.
  2. Design and manage performance monitoring systems.
  3. Deliver data-driven insights to address business challenges/opportunities.

Essential Job Duties

  • Partner with executives and department leaders to identify business questions, analytical needs, performance indicators, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop sales, revenue, demand, customer-acquisition, and marketing-performance forecasts.
  • Collect, integrate, and reconcile data from sales, marketing, website, customer, product, financial, and operational systems.
  • Develop and maintain automated dashboards, reports, scorecards, and executive-level performance summaries.
  • Use appropriate technologies to extract, clean, transform, validate, and analyze large and complex datasets.
  • Analyze marketing performance, including customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, channel profitability, return on advertising spend, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Analyze sales and customer behavior, including purchasing patterns, retention, repeat purchases, product affinity, customer segmentation, and lifetime value.
  • Build tools that help leadership evaluate potential changes in pricing, advertising investment, customer acquisition, conversion, and retention.
  • Investigate discrepancies between reporting systems and recommend solutions to improve data accuracy and consistency.
  • Work with technical teams and third-party vendors to implement new data sources, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
  • Present complex analyses through clear reports, visualizations, presentations, and recommendations for nontechnical audiences.
  • Train stakeholders to interpret dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical findings accurately.
  • Prioritize analytical projects according to potential business impact, urgency, data availability, and required resources.
  • Establish and follow standards for data governance, access, security, privacy, retention, and responsible data use.
  • Assist in standardizing definitions and reliable sources of truth for revenue, orders, customers, products, marketing performance, and other key business metrics.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Five or more years of professional experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
  • Preferred Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, economics, information systems, business analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and maintaining relational databases, data models, or cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines that move and transform data between business systems.
  • Advanced data-cleaning, reconciliation, scrubbing, and manipulation skills.
  • Experience with at least one business-intelligence or data-visualization platform, such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, forecasts, or analytical models that influenced business decisions.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined analytical projects and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to recognize data-quality issues and determine whether available data can support a valid conclusion.

  • Marketing and sales analytics

This position has no direct reports but collaborates with team leads in the Marketing, Customer Experience, and Operations departments.

jobs.title: Project Scheduler
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Project Scheduler to join our team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Project Scheduler to join our team.

Position Description

We are seeking a disciplined and analytical Project Scheduler to be embedded within Oklo capital project teams and support the delivery of advanced energy and infrastructure projects. This role will develop, maintain, and analyze the integrated project schedule across engineering, licensing, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning. The Project Scheduler will provide an objective schedule perspective, challenge assumptions constructively, and ensure that forecast dates, logic, and progress reflect the project's execution reality.

The Project Scheduler will partner closely with the Project Manager, Project Controller, Project Sponsor, functional leads, and external vendors to establish executable plans, identify critical and near-critical paths, evaluate schedule impacts, and support timely recovery decisions. This role interfaces directly with EPCs and other vendors to integrate external schedules, validate progress, and hold schedule contributors accountable for timely and high-quality status information. The Project Scheduler will work in close coordination with the Portfolio Planner to apply common schedule coding, calendars, milestone definitions, and quality standards. This role reports into the Sr. Director of Project Budgeting and Controls with day-to-day integration within assigned project teams.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Integrated Schedule Development and Baseline Management: Develop and maintain logic-driven integrated project schedules, including activities, durations, dependencies, assumptions, constraints, planning packages, milestones, and interfaces with external schedules. Support baseline establishment and controlled re-baselining in accordance with governance requirements.
  • Recurring Status and Forecasting: Lead regular schedule status cycles with project teams and external contributors. Incorporate actual progress and forecast updates while validating logic, durations, remaining work, completion criteria, and projected dates.
  • Critical Path and Risk Analysis: Analyze critical and near-critical paths, total and free float, schedule sensitivity, and emerging risks. Distinguish true completion drivers from secondary delays and communicate potential impacts early.
  • Recovery and Scenario Planning: Develop what-if analyses, recovery plans, acceleration options, and schedule compression scenarios. Quantify the milestone and critical-path implications of proposed decisions, changes, and mitigation actions.
  • Cross-Functional and Vendor Integration: Coordinate schedule interfaces across engineering, licensing, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, vendors, and other external stakeholders. Facilitate planning workshops and schedule review meetings.
  • Cost and Schedule Integration: Partner with Project Controls and Finance to align schedule progress, forecast dates, cost forecasts, cash flow, and project performance reporting. Support objective assessments of physical progress and earned value where applicable.
  • Reporting and Decision Support: Produce milestone reports, look-ahead plans, schedule narratives, dashboards, and executive-ready insights. Clearly communicate schedule variance, drivers, risks, recovery opportunities, and decisions required.
  • Schedule Quality and Governance: Perform routine health checks and data validation, resolve missing or unrealistic information with status owners, and maintain compliance with Oklo scheduling standards, coding structures, and change-control processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience developing, maintaining, and analyzing integrated project schedules for complex technical or capital projects
  • Experience supporting integrated schedules with at least 25 active schedule contributors or status owners across multiple disciplines
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining schedules in Microsoft Project
  • Strong understanding of critical path methodology, schedule logic, float, forecasting, progress measurement, baseline management, and change control
  • Experience facilitating recurring schedule status and planning meetings with cross-functional technical teams
  • Ability to challenge schedule assumptions constructively and translate detailed analysis into clear recommendations
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

Bonus Qualifications:

  • PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP) or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Experience supporting engineering, nuclear, energy, industrial, EPC, or other large capital projects
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project and familiarity with Primavera P6 or Oracle Primavera Cloud
  • Experience with DCMA schedule assessment principles or equivalent schedule quality metrics
  • Experience integrating cost, schedule, risk, and earned-value data
  • Startup or high-growth company experience

Competencies

We are looking for a Project Scheduler that is:

  • Comfortable being embedded within project teams while maintaining objective schedule integrity
  • Able to build strong partnerships with technical teams and hold contributors accountable for timely, high-quality information
  • Disciplined in separating schedule facts, assumptions, risks, and management targets
  • Proactive in surfacing critical-path threats and recovery opportunities before they become project issues
  • Confident facilitating planning discussions across stakeholders with competing priorities
  • Clear and concise when communicating schedule impacts to technical teams and senior leadership
  • Detail-oriented, data-driven, and committed to schedule quality
  • Adaptable in a fast-paced environment where priorities and project maturity evolve quickly
  • Excited by Oklo's mission to deploy advanced fission power plants
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $90,000-$130,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Job Title: Medical Billing & Claims Specialist

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Daylight Time (final schedule might change)

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $5 - $7 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Our client is a well-established U.S.-based allergy and immunology medical practice seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Medical Billing & Claims Specialist to support its existing in-house billing team.

This role is primarily focused on claims posting, claims management, denial management, and billing support. You will work with a steady volume of medical claims and help ensure they are processed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with established billing procedures.

The ideal candidate has at least 2–3 years of hands-on medical billing experience, with strong experience in both claims posting and claims management for medical procedures. You should be comfortable investigating denied claims, handling complex billing scenarios, and following claims through resolution and payment.

Training will be provided for the practice's systems, ModuleMD and RXNT, so candidates with strong medical billing experience using other platforms are also encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Posting & Management

  • Post and process medical claims accurately and efficiently
  • Manage claims related to medical procedures from submission through resolution
  • Review claims for completeness and accuracy before processing
  • Maintain accurate posting and billing records
  • Manage a consistent daily volume of claims while maintaining quality and accuracy
  • Track claim status and follow up on outstanding claims
  • Help ensure claims are processed according to established billing and compliance requirements

Denial Management & Follow-Up

  • Review and work denied or rejected claims
  • Identify reasons for denials and take appropriate corrective action
  • Resubmit or follow up on claims as necessary
  • Work toward successful claim overturns and reimbursement
  • Document denial actions and claim follow-up accurately
  • Identify recurring billing or denial issues when appropriate

Medical Billing Support

  • Provide billing support to the existing in-house billing team
  • Assist with complex billing scenarios, including situations involving multiple patient reimbursements
  • Review payer information and billing documentation as needed
  • Maintain organized and accurate billing records
  • Follow established compliance and confidentiality requirements
  • Assist with additional billing-related responsibilities as assigned

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on factors such as:

  • Number of claims accurately processed and posted
  • Accuracy of claims posting
  • Productivity and ability to manage the expected daily claims volume
  • Number and percentage of denied claims successfully overturned or paid
  • Quality and accuracy of billing documentation
  • Consistency in meeting established claims-processing goals

The practice is targeting strong productivity in claims processing, with an expectation of working toward at least 80 claims posted per day and approximately 85–90% successful resolution/payment of worked claims, where applicable.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of medical billing experience
  • Hands-on claims posting experience is required
  • Strong experience managing claims for medical procedures is required
  • Experience working denied and rejected claims through resolution
  • Strong understanding of the medical billing and claims lifecycle
  • Ability to investigate claim issues and determine appropriate next steps
  • Experience handling complex billing scenarios
  • Strong understanding of billing accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality requirements
  • Ability to manage a high volume of claims while maintaining accuracy
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Able to work independently and consistently meet productivity expectations
  • Clear and professional written and spoken English
  • Reliable, accountable, and comfortable working as part of an established billing team

Preferred Experience

  • Experience using ModuleMD
  • Experience using RXNT
  • Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice
  • Experience working with specialty medical billing
  • Experience managing high-volume claims
  • Demonstrated success working denied claims and obtaining reimbursement

ModuleMD and RXNT experience is preferred but not required. Training will be provided, and experienced medical billers who have worked with other billing, practice management, or EHR systems are encouraged to apply.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.
