Job Description

Job Title: Patient Account Representative

Department: MARS Early Out

Schedule: Monday – Friday 7:00AM - 7:00PM (hours vary depending on team assignment, only one night until 7 pm is required)

Location: Telework

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

Summary

Coordinates with patients through telephone communications to address and resolve self-pay balances on behalf of the medical facility. Responds to patient inquiries regarding account status, billing concerns, payment options, and financial assistance programs while providing exceptional customer service and maintaining patient confidentiality. Assists in educating patients on available resources and payment solutions to support positive financial outcomes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Answer and appropriately handle inbound patient calls.
  • Connect with patients via outbound calls regarding outstanding balances.
  • Respond to patient billing and statement inquiries.
  • Offer and establish payment plans to help patients manage outstanding balances.
  • Offer financial assistance and other available resources for patients unable to meet standard payment guidelines.
  • Obtain detailed and accurate information necessary to relay to the medical facility for further review and resolution.
  • Review accounts for delinquent payments and initiate final letters when applicable.
  • Follow client-specific standard operating procedures and established company guidelines.
  • Shadow experienced personnel to enhance job knowledge and assist with training and development.
  • Participate in and successfully complete all company-required training programs, continuing education courses, compliance training, and professional development activities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Analytical - Synthesizes complex or diverse information; collects and researches data; uses intuition and experience to complement data.

Continuous Learning - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; seeks feedback to improve performance; pursues training and development opportunities; strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; shares expertise with others.

Job Knowledge - Competent in required job skills and knowledge; exhibits ability to learn and apply new skills; keeps up to date on current developments; requires minimal supervision; displays understanding of how job relates to others.

Use of Technology - Demonstrates required skills; adapts to new technologies; troubleshoots technological problems; uses technology to increase productivity; keeps technical skills up to date.

Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; responds promptly to customer needs; responds to requests for service and assistance; meets commitments.

Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts verbally; expresses ideas and thoughts in written form; exhibits good listening and comprehension; keeps others adequately informed.

Cooperation - Establishes and maintains effective relations; exhibits tact and consideration; offers assistance and support to co-workers; works cooperatively in group situations; works actively to resolve conflicts.

Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; participates in meetings.

Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; gives and welcomes feedback; contributes to building a positive team spirit; puts success of team above own interests; able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; edits work for spelling and grammar; varies writing style to meet needs; presents numerical data effectively; able to read and interpret written information.

Conflict Resolution - Encourages open communications; confronts difficult situations; maintains objectivity; keeps emotions under control; uses negotiation skills to resolve conflicts.

Diversity - Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; promotes a harassment-free environment.

Ethics - Treats people with respect; keeps commitments; inspires the trust of others; works with integrity and principles; upholds organizational values.

Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; supports organization's goals and values; benefits organization through outside activities; supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; manages competing demands; changes approach or method to best fit the situation; able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.

Achievement Focus - Sets and achieves challenging goals; demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; measures self against standard of excellence; recognizes and acts on opportunities.

Personal Appearance - Dresses appropriately for position; keeps self well groomed.

Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time; ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; arrives at meetings and appointments on time.

Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; takes responsibility for own actions; keeps commitments; commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals.; completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.

Initiative - Volunteers readily; undertakes self-development activities; seeks increased responsibilities; looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; asks for and offers help when needed.

Innovation - Displays original thinking and creativity; meets challenges with resourcefulness; generates suggestions for improving work; develops innovative approaches and ideas.

Judgment - Displays willingness to make decisions; exhibits sound and accurate judgment; supports and explains reasoning for decisions; includes appropriate people in decision-making process.

Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; uses time efficiently; sets goals and objectives.

Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; looks for ways to improve and promote quality; applies feedback to improve performance; monitors own work to ensure quality.

Quantity - Meets productivity standards; completes work in timely manner; strives to increase productivity.

Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; determines appropriate action beyond guidelines; reports potentially unsafe conditions ; uses equipment and materials properly.

jobs.excerpt: Come join a company who is a key leader in the industry scaling the next core commerce infrastructure and on the path from $100M to $500M!
jobs.description:
Come join a company who is a key leader in the industry scaling the next core commerce infrastructure and on the path from $100M to $500M! Founded in 2012, Salsify helps brand manufacturers, distributors, and retailers in over 80 countries collaborate to win on the digital shelf. As the market leader globally, our products are shopper-centric, frictionless, and create memorable commerce experiences. Our products provide a competitive edge through experiences that improve brand trust, amplify product differentiation and assortments, increase conversion rate, improve profit margins, and speed time to market.

Learn how the world’s largest brands, including Mars, L'Oreal, Coca-Cola, Bosch, and GSK, as well as retailers and distributors such as E.Leclerc, Carrefour, Metro, and Intermarché use Salsify everyday to stand out on the digital shelf.

At Salsify, we strive to embody an equitable, diverse, and inclusive company culture. We are united across countries, levels, tenures, and a host of other dimensions of diversity. We understand that while work is just one aspect of who we are, a truly inclusive culture accounts for the full authenticity of every single human being that works here.

About the Opportunity

Salsify's value compounds when we sit naturally inside the tools and platforms our customers and prospects already use and trust. This role's job is to make that true, to make Salsify the natural center of the B2B Manufacturing and Distribution ecosystem rather than a standalone decision buyers have to be sold on separately.
Concretely, this role builds, manages, and nurtures the relationships and market presence that turn ecosystem reach into sourced and co-sell ARR. They won't answer every open question alone, they'll own pieces of it and work with the wider go-to-market team to drive the rest toward resolution, including: which SIs we need relationships with to support aggressive growth, how we build awareness with new ones, which ISVs are worth investing in and how we classify the depth of those relationships, and how we get full value out of partners who aren't already our most active ones.
What Success Looks Like
This is a senior level role, based in the United States, with regular travel to partner offices and industry events. Works in close partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Industry Strategy. The person in this seat is judged on:
  • The strength and reach of the relationships they hold - with SI and ISV leaders, with industry associations and buying groups, with analysts, and with partner-side sellers who choose to bring Salsify into their deals because they trust this person specifically.
  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline that those relationships convert into.
  • How fast partner deals move relative to non-partner deals, because that speed is the proof the trust is real.
  • Whether partners come back - repeat co-sell motions, not one-off wins.
  • Market and category credibility - whether conversations with this person leave partners, prospects, and analysts understanding the Industrials PXM category better and understanding why Salsify sits at its center.
What You'll Own
Relationships and ecosystem development
  • Build and personally hold senior relationships with strategic SI, ISV, and technology partners across the sector.
  • Identify and recruit the partners we don't have yet, and make the case for why partnering with Salsify is worth their time. This takes real sales instinct, since you're selling the partnership itself before there's any pipeline to point to.
  • Own the partner's experience of Salsify end to end: recruitment, onboarding, enablement, and the ongoing care that keeps a relationship warm between deals.
  • Represent Salsify in the rooms that matter - on stage, on webinars, at partner HQs, at industry events, and social side of those events (the dinner, the hallway conversation).
Strategic ownership of the partner ecosystem for B2B Manufacturing and Distribution
  • Help set the point of view on who we go after and why. The ICP and channel motion for this sector are still being proven out, so this isn't a role that executes someone else's fully-formed strategy, it's a role that helps write it, backed by evidence from the field.
  • Build the partner classification framework (onboarding stage, integration depth, commercial terms) that lets us tell a strong partner from a merely-signed one.
  • Pull in the right people to round out a partnership - Product or Services for integration depth, Partner Marketing for co-sponsorship, Sales for the account-level connections, Enablement to get the commercial team fluent in the partnership's value.

What You Bring

  • A network you're bringing with you, not building from scratch. You should already be known - at least to some degree - among partners, prospects, analysts, and the industry associations or buying groups in this space. That's the single hardest thing to hire for and the thing this role most needs on day one.
  • 5+ years in partner programs, alliance management, channel, or business development, ideally in SaaS, enterprise software, industry roles, or another technology ecosystem.
  • Genuine comfort in front of a room - stage, webinar, or a partner's own office - and a willingness to travel for it.
  • Some sales background, or sales instinct, since part of the job is selling partners on partnering with us.
  • A track record of setting or shaping go-to-market strategy, not just executing a playbook someone else wrote.
  • Strong program and stakeholder management across regions and functions.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and test-and-learn.
  • Working fluency with Salesforce, marketing automation, and reporting tools.
At Salsify, we maintain 3 core principles as part of our Compensation Philosophy:
  • We pay market rates, which are competitive and equitable
  • We pay based on performance and proficiency, not tenure
  • We adjust proactively; when the market moves, we do too
The posted compensation range reflects the base salary for this position. In addition to base salary, some eligible roles may also have a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Salsify employees receive equity in the form of stock options. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more. Offers to join Salsify are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate’s work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.
US National Pay Range
$104,550—$123,000 USD

Salsify loves a good success story and it would be our privilege to help write yours! We recognize that talent and potential come in all forms and that years of experience does not guarantee on-the-job effectiveness or leadership potential. Our hiring process involves recognizing a person’s achievements, subject matter expertise, and passion, not just check marks next to a job description. If you have an interest in our roles please do not hesitate to apply - we would be happy to speak with you!

A member of Talent '' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.

Salsify’s mission is to empower brand manufacturers to win on the digital shelf.

Helping brand manufacturers to win online is what we do. Our culture is who we are. We are empowered. We are positive thinkers. We take action. We care deeply. These values have driven Salsify’s growth and earned the company numerous top workplace awards.

We are headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts and have hubs in Lisbon (Portugal) and Sydney (Australia). If you are excited to work in a fast-paced environment with a team that values agility, curiosity and passion, we want to hear from you!

As part of the hiring process, we may be conducting reference checks with your provided contacts.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for information on the personal data we process in connection with your application.

An Inclusive Place To Work

Salsify does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Studies have found that people of color and women do not apply to jobs if they do not meet all the requirements. At Salsify we are committed to empowering a diverse workforce. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Accommodations

Salsify is committed to an inclusive hiring process, and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact .

We take your security seriously. When applying for a position with us, please be aware of the following:

Official Communication ChannelsAll legitimate communications from our team, including interview requests and job offers, will only come from an email address ending in @salsify.com. We will never use generic email addresses (like Gmail or Yahoo) or ask you to communicate through unofficial channels.

Verify Job Postings
Always verify the legitimacy of any Salsify job posting by checking our official website's careers page. If a position is not listed there, it is not a genuine Salsify opening.

Secure Application Process
We use secure applicant tracking systems and encrypted communication channels to protect your sensitive information and documents throughout the application process.

No Payments Ever Required
Legitimate employers, including Salsify, will never ask for upfront payments for applications, training, or equipment. Any request for payment is a clear sign of a scam.

Personal Information Requests
Sensitive personal information, such as bank details or social security numbers, will only be requested after a formal job offer has been made and exclusively through secure, verified channels.By being aware of these protocols, you can help us ensure a safe and secure application experience.

Job Summary

Horace Mann is seeking an experienced and strategic Director Solution Developmentto lead the software engineering and support team within IT.

This leader will play a pivotal role in ensuring the stability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of digital platforms, balancing business priorities while driving technical excellence. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, deep understanding of business needs, and exceptional decision-making skills to evaluate and prioritize requests that maximize business value. The candidate will lead the team's adoption of agentic AI-assisted development to enhance productivity and creativity.

This role requires someone who is highly organized, confident in making firm prioritization decisions, and skilled in communicating trade-offs to stakeholders. The director must be able to navigate competing demands, align technology work with strategic goals, and create a structured approach to digital system support and incremental enhancements.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Prioritization & Business Alignment

  • Evaluate and prioritize incoming requests based on business impact, urgency, and technical feasibility.
  • Set clear expectations with stakeholders, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Communicate trade-offs transparently, advocating for business value over reactive task execution.
  • Develop a structured framework for prioritization that ensures mission-critical support needs are met while also advancing small enhancements that drive continuous improvement.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team responsible for support, defect resolution, and small system enhancements.
  • Ensure cross-team collaboration, fostering a shared understanding of priorities, dependencies, and technical solutions.
  • Create and uphold accountability structures to ensure work is completed efficiently and with high quality.
  • Drive a culture of ownership, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
  • Champion and personally drive the team's use of agentic AI tools to boost team creativity, efficiency, and skill development.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Establish and refine processes for managing digital defects, incidents, and enhancement requests, ensuring smooth workflows and minimal disruption.
  • Improve and implement best practices for ticketing, resolution timelines, and stakeholder communication.
  • Analyze trends in defects and enhancement requests to identify opportunities for proactive improvements and efficiency gains.
  • Drive continuous innovation by incorporating emerging trends and tools, including agentic AI, into project workflows.

Technical & Business Understanding

  • Serve as the bridge between technology teams and business stakeholders, ensuring both sides understand priorities, constraints, and impacts.
  • Maintain a strong technical grasp of digital systems, workflows, and potential challenges, ensuring informed decision-making.
  • Provide guidance on best practices for system stability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Communication & Expectation Management

  • Set firm but fair expectations with business stakeholders, ensuring they understand how and why prioritization decisions are made.
  • Provide regular updates on progress, challenges, and key outcomes related to support and enhancements.
  • Communicate realistic timelines, risks, and trade-offs when managing requests.

Qualifications:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in IT leadership, with a focus on managing digital operations, technical support, and system enhancements.
  • Proven track record of making strategic prioritization decisions that drive business value.
  • Strong background in technical support, bug resolution, and application enhancement.
  • Experience implementing agentic AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and driving team-wide adoption in engineering workflows.

Skills & Competencies:

Technical & Business Expertise

  • Strong understanding of digital applications, software development lifecycles, and IT support models.
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical priorities and vice versa.
  • Familiarity with modern ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps) and IT service management best practices.
  • Hands-on proficiency with agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex — not just chat-based AI assistants — to enhance development workflows.
  • Fluency in prompt and context engineering — structuring instructions, memory, and tool access so an agent behaves reliably — and experience building reusable tooling (custom skills or commands, hooks, MCP integrations) around agentic coding assistants, not just ad hoc prompting.
  • Understanding of the cost and reliability tradeoffs of agentic workflows at team scale — token usage, model selection, and when a task needs a human in the loop versus full autonomy.

Decision-Making & Prioritization

  • Ability to assess competing priorities and make firm, strategic decisions.
  • Skilled in identifying high-impact improvements while maintaining system stability.
  • Experience in building structured prioritization frameworks for IT support and enhancement requests.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to set clear expectations and communicate priorities firmly yet diplomatically to stakeholders.
  • Experience in negotiating and influencing senior leaders on digital priorities and trade-offs.
  • Insists on verifying AI-generated work against real evidence — tests passing, logs, the actual deployed state — rather than accepting confident-sounding output at face value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading IT support and continuous improvement teams in a large enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), ITIL frameworks, and Agile methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of metrics-driven decision-making and process optimization.
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification (or equivalent process-improvement credential) preferred.

Salary Range: $105,200 - $147,950

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction.
jobs.description:
Life is too short to work with jerks.

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. Our ecosystem is rooted in our five core values: Relentless Positivity, Growth Obsessed, Get it Done, Helpful Spirit, and Solution Driven.

We are not just coworkers, but a community, working tirelessly towards 'Spreading the Smile' to our members, agents, and each other. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

Summary

NCD is seeking a Licensed InsuranceSalesAgent to join our Member Care team. In this fully remote role,you'llspeak directly with prospective members about our ancillary and supplemental insurance products, including dental, vision, accident, and disability coverage, guiding them frominitialinterest to enrollment.You'llwork from a compliance-driven script with required disclosures, while still building the kind of rapport that makes a prospect want to say yes.

This role is built for someone who thrives on a phone, handles objections without getting rattled, and treats a "no" today as a "not yet" to follow up on tomorrow. If you know how to stay compliant without sounding like a robot, andyou'remotivated by hitting numbers day after day, this role was built for you.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Sales Calls and Enrollment
  • Speak with prospective members about ancillary and supplemental insurance products (dental, vision, accident, disability, etc.), walking them through coverage options and enrolling them in the right plan.
  • Compliance and Script Adherence
  • Follow required disclosures and a compliance-driven script on every call, while keeping the conversation natural and conversational rather than scripted-sounding.
  • Objection Handling
  • Address prospects who hesitate, ask to "think about it," or request something in writing, keeping the conversation moving toward a decision without being pushy.
  • Pipeline and Follow-Up Management
  • Maintain a system for tracking prospects whodon'tbuy on the first call and following up consistently until they convert or close out.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Must-Have Skills and Experience

  • Currently licensed to sell insurance, with active licensure in good standing meeting NCD's stateminimumrequirements (below).
  • Proven experience selling ancillary or supplemental insurance products (dental, vision, accident, disability, etc.), witha track recordof hitting a sales quota or close rate consistently.
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM CST, consistently.
  • Reliable home internet and a quiet, private workspace suitable for taking calls.
  • Resilience and self-motivation to stay productive on high-volume, high-rejection days.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Bilingualproficiencyin English and Spanish.
  • Experience in supplemental health, dental, vision, or insurance sales specifically.

State Licensure Requirements

  • Must have an active Life and Health license.
  • Priority will be given to those with licenses in the following states:California, Florida, Texas, New York,Georgia,New Jersey, North Carolina, Nevada, Massachusetts, Arizona, Illinois, Pennsylvania, Oregon, Missouri, Virginia, and Colorado.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 to 180 Days

Within the first90 days, you havelearned aboutNCD's products, script, and compliance requirements, andyou'recomfortable handling common objections while staying on message.You'rebuilding your own rhythm for the day and starting to see your close rate stabilize.

Within180 days, you are consistently hitting quota, managing a full pipeline of follow-ups without anything slipping through the cracks, and the team has confidence that you can carry a full book of prospects independently.

NCD Benefits

  • Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Opportunity for professional development
  • Work from home allowance and support
  • Positive work environment
  • Remote, office-based flexibility within the United States of America

Equal Opportunity

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

jobs.excerpt: Responsible for the accurate and timely evaluation, management, and adjudication of Long Term Care claims from initial notification through claim resolution.
jobs.description:
Responsible for the accurate and timely evaluation, management, and adjudication of Long Term Care claims from initial notification through claim resolution. This role involves analyzing medical, contractual, and vocational information to determine eligibility for benefits, making informed decisions on claim approvals or denials, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. The position requires effective communication with claimants, employers, and medical professionals while delivering a high-quality customer experience and supporting financial performance and customer retention. You must have current working experience with Long Term Care specific claims adjudication.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Hourly Wage: $24.00 - $27.00, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Evaluate, adjudicate and manage Long Term Care claims throughout the claim lifecycle, partnering with management to make informed decisions based on claim facts, policy provisions, and supporting documentation.
  • Gather, analyze, and document claim information to determine eligibility, ongoing liability, and benefit payments while ensuring accurate financial calculations and compliance with contract terms.
  • Maintain strong relationships and communication with claimants, employers, brokers, medical professionals, and internal partners to support effective claim resolution and a high-quality customer experience.
  • Document claim actions and decisions thoroughly and communicate determinations, status updates, and benefit changes clearly through written correspondence and direct outreach.
  • Ensure compliance and industry awareness by adhering to ERISA and applicable federal/state regulations while staying current on industry trends, legislation, and internal processes.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Seasoned Long Term Care Claims adjudication and analyzation skills
  • Proven ability to analyze and interpret insurance policies and regulations to support accurate Long Term Care claim decisions and benefit calculations.
  • Deliver strong customer service and communication through clear verbal and written interactions with claimants and stakeholders.
  • Apply analytical thinking and decision-making skills to manage claims effectively while developing greater independence and critical thinking.
  • Maintain organization, accuracy, and timeliness with strong attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and adaptability in a changing environment.
  • Utilize technical and professional skills including basic medical terminology, Microsoft Office and internal systems, and the ability to manage claims over extended durations while ensuring fair and consistent claim handling.
  • You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • College degree or equivalent industry experience

We value unique experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at . Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Worldwide Alliances and Channels team is responsible for developing and managing a global community of partners that helps ambitious businesses with industry-leading payments and financial infrastructure solutions and services. These partnerships help Stripe unlock market opportunities and accelerate user growth across segments, from startups to enterprise companies.

What you’ll do

We are looking for an enthusiastic Partner Development Manager (PDM) to join the Americas Alliances & Channels team. This is a partner relationship and revenue-generating role, reporting to Americas Alliances & Channels leadership.

You’ll cultivate and maintain relationships with executives and sales teams at Stripe and partner organizations. You’ll secure new business, negotiate and close strategic partnerships, and help accelerate Stripe’s business across the region with systems integrators, consulting firms, and development agencies. You’ll also execute Stripe’s global partner programs, marketing, enablement, and co-selling initiatives across the region, driving partner participation and engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Build deep relationships across sales, and marketing, and partner leadership teams.
  • Develop a revenue-generating joint go-to-market plan for assigned partners, including joint activities such as events and webinars, engagement with partner account executives through enablement and co-selling plans, and solution development.
  • Develop and execute Stripe’s partner strategy with assigned partners, aligned with Stripe’s regional business and global partner strategy
  • Advocate for partners and identify partnership growth opportunities
  • Report weekly, monthly, and quarterly to key stakeholders, using a strong analytical approach and clear communication
  • Work with program, marketing, and sales teams to execute partner programs, events, and sales engagement
  • Build playbooks and collateral that help partners sell effectively

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of partnerships or sales experience in technology, financial services, or a similarly complex B2B environment
  • Experience owning and growing strategic partnerships that generated measurable commercial outcomes, such as sourced pipeline, closed revenue, partner engaged revenue, partner-sourced opportunities, or joint go-to-market activity
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market plans with external partners and internal sales, marketing, and program stakeholders
  • Experience negotiating commercial agreements and influencing senior executive stakeholders
  • Ability to travel as required for partner meetings, events, and internal collaboration

Preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or advanced degree
  • Experience in payments, financial infrastructure, or financial services
  • Experience working with systems integrators, consulting firms, development agencies, or other ecosystem partners
  • Experience building partner enablement programs, co-selling motions, events, playbooks, or sales collateral
  • Experience using data to assess partner performance, identify growth opportunities, and communicate results to senior stakeholders
  • Sound business judgment, strong analytical skills, and a proven track record of taking ownership, leading data-driven analyses, and influencing results

jobs.title: System Engineer Linux-Infrastruktur & Virtualisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Standort: Remote (deutschlandweit) oder Hybrid – Office Bad Lippspringe, 10 Min.
jobs.description:
Standort: Remote (deutschlandweit) oder Hybrid – Office Bad Lippspringe, 10 Min. von Paderborn
Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit, unbefristet
Start: ab sofort – wir warten nicht auf das nächste Quartal

Über reisewitz

reisewitz entwickelt seit 1984 intelligente Planungssoftware und ist europaweit für seine Kunden im Einsatz. Mit adelo® (Tourenplanung & Workforce Management), optaflow® (mobile Zählerkommunikation) und aures (automatische Disposition) steuern über 150 Kunden ihre Serviceteams – darunter Hardeck, BoConcept, Wiener Netze und zahlreiche Stadtwerke. Wir sind ISO 27001 zertifiziert und wurden 2024 mit dem Sust-Award für nachhaltige Routenplanung ausgezeichnet.

Unsere Software liefern wir nicht als Datenträger aus, sondern als Service — wir hosten sie selbst.

Deine Mission

Du betreust unser Hosting-Geschäft — als die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt, mit klar abgegrenztem Verantwortungsbereich und direktem Draht zum CIO. Die Plattform, auf der unsere Kunden täglich ihre Touren planen und ihre Monteure steuern, läuft auf Infrastruktur, die du verantwortest: eine wachsende Hetzner-VPS-Landschaft, unsere Virtualisierungsumgebungen samt Firewall sowie die dazugehörigen Netz-, Storage- und Backup-Schichten.

Dabei stehst du nicht vor einer fertigen Landschaft: Die Migration von VMware auf Proxmox VE ist beschlossen und startet gerade — du begleitest sie mit und übernimmst danach den operativen Betrieb des Clusters. Wie die Zielplattform im Detail aussieht (Storage, HA, Backup-Domäne, Automatisierung), prägst du fachlich mit.

Wenn du Lust darauf hast, wächst die Rolle mittelfristig um eine Beratungs-Komponente: Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei deren eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Vorhaben — Architektur, Migration, Schulung.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Das erste halbe Jahr — Übernahme

  • Übernahme des laufenden Betriebs unserer Hetzner-VPS-Infrastruktur: Provisionierung, Patching, Härtung, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle.

  • Belastbarer Überblick über Virtualisierung, Storage, Netz und Firewall — inklusive Dokumentation dessen, was heute nur in Köpfen existiert.

  • Ehrliche Bestandsaufnahme der Backup-Lage: Was ist wirklich wiederherstellbar? Der erste echte Restore-Test ist dein Projekt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle für den Infrastrukturbetrieb — der Eskalationspfad läuft ab dann über dich, nicht mehr über den CIO.

Danach — Migration & Ausbau

  • Begleitung der VMware→Proxmox-Migration und nach Abschluss operative Verantwortung für den Cluster: Pflege, Updates, Storage- und Netzwerkkonfiguration.

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Umgebungen, in denen unsere SaaS-Plattform für über 150 Kunden läuft: Kapazitätsplanung, Performance, Verfügbarkeit.

  • Aufsetzen neuer Kundenumgebungen und deren Lifecycle — vom Onboarding bis zur Stilllegung.

  • Aufbau einer Infrastructure-as-Code-Basis (Terraform für Provisionierung, Ansible für Konfiguration) — weg von handgepflegten Servern, hin zu versionierten Umgebungen.

  • Aufbau einer ernsthaften Backup- und Restore-Disziplin: Konzepte, regelmäßige Restore-Tests, unveränderliche Backups, saubere Trennung der Backup-Domäne. Ransomware-Resilienz ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Auftrag.

  • Härtung und Absicherung der Systeme im Rahmen unserer ISO-27001-Anforderungen; Pflege von Betriebshandbüchern, Runbooks und Notfall-Dokumentation.

  • Mitgestaltung unserer DevOps-Umgebung: Deployments, Container, Monitoring und Logging.

  • Mitbetreuung der bestehenden Windows-Server-Landschaft und Mitarbeit an deren schrittweiser Modernisierung.

  • Mitwirkung im 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support bei komplexen Server- und Applikationsthemen.

Perspektive (optional, wenn du Lust darauf hast)

  • Beratung unserer Kunden bei Planung und Architektur ihrer eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Umgebungen: HA- und Storage-Konzepte (Ceph, ZFS), Migrationen aus VMware oder Hyper-V, Konzeptpapiere und Schulungen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gehalt: 58.000 – 72.000 € brutto/Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Tiefe — deine Einordnung besprechen wir offen und transparent im Bewerbungsgespräch.

  • Volle Verantwortung ab Tag eins und direkter Draht zum CIO. Kurze Wege, keine Eskalationsstufen, keine Gremien.

  • Echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeit: Du baust die Proxmox- und Hosting-Plattform mit auf, statt fertige Strukturen zu verwalten. Die Architektur-Entscheidungen der nächsten Jahre triffst du mit.

  • Voll remote oder hybrid mit Office in Bad Lippspringe — du entscheidest, was zu deinem Leben passt.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Gleitzeit, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen.

  • Modernes Equipment deiner Wahl.

  • Begleite und gestalte die KI-Transformation unseres Unternehmens aktiv mit.

  • Weiterbildungsbudget und Zertifizierungen — inklusive Entwicklungspfad in eine Beratungsrolle.

  • Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Vertrag in einem etablierten Unternehmen (seit 1984), 25 Mitarbeitende, ausgezeichnet als familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber im Kreis Paderborn.

  • Extras: Sportnavi (Firmenfitness), Corporate Benefits, Getränke im Büro, 1x pro Woche gemeinsames Mittagessen.

Klingt das nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung — Lebenslauf reicht, kein Anschreiben-Roman. Schreib uns nur zwei Dinge dazu:

  1. Welche Infrastruktur du zuletzt verantwortet hast.

  2. Ab wann du starten könntest.

Wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden und führen das Erstgespräch per Video — unkompliziert und ohne Assessment-Center.

Requirements

Das brauchen wir wirklich:

  • Linux ist deine Heimat. Mehrjährige Erfahrung im produktiven Betrieb von Linux-Servern (Debian/Ubuntu) — Troubleshooting auf Systemebene, nicht nur Paketinstallation.

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungs-Hypervisoren im produktiven Betrieb — welcher Anbieter, ist zweitrangig. Wichtig ist das Verständnis von Compute, Storage und Netz unter dem Hypervisor, nicht das Produktlabel.

  • Erfahrung im Betrieb von öffentlich erreichbarer Infrastruktur: Netz, Firewall, TLS, Reverse Proxy (Traefik/NGINX), DNS, Härtung.

  • Bash-Scripting sitzt, und du automatisierst mit Ansible.

  • Erfahrung mit Backup und Restore — und die Haltung, dass ein Backup erst zählt, wenn der Restore getestet ist.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten. Du brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben zuteilt, und erkennst selbst, was zuerst dran ist.

  • Du nutzt KI weit über Chatbots hinaus — als Werkzeug im täglichen Betrieb, im Scripting und in der Analyse.

  • Deutsch C1, Englisch B2.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: saubere Übergaben, verständliche Tickets, klare Statusberichte.

Schön wäre außerdem — aber kein Ausschlusskriterium:

  • Praxis mit Proxmox VE und/oder Proxmox Backup Server — der direkteste Hebel in unserer Migrationsphase.

  • Erfahrung mit VMware (besonders wertvoll für die Migration) oder Hyper-V.

  • Tiefe in einem Storage-Bereich: Ceph, ZFS oder SAN/NAS.

  • Infrastructure-as-Code mit Terraform (oder OpenTofu, Pulumi) im echten Einsatz.

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-/VPS-Hostern wie Hetzner — inklusive Kostenkontrolle.

  • Cluster-Management und Hochverfügbarkeit, Performance-Optimierung, Kapazitätsplanung.

  • Erfahrung mit Docker / Containern, Kubernetes und CI/CD.

  • Erfahrung in einer gemischten Windows-/Linux-Landschaft (AD, PowerShell) — bei uns läuft beides.

  • Betrieb von Datenbanken (MS SQL, PostgreSQL) und Verständnis für API-/Web-Stacks.

  • Erfahrung in Beratung oder Schulung — der Hebel für die Beratungs-Perspektive.

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im IT-Bereich — wenn du es stattdessen praktisch gelernt hast, zählt das bei uns genauso.

Highlights

Du übernimmst unser Hosting: Hetzner-VPS, VMware→Proxmox-Migration, Backup & IaC. Volle Ownership, direkter Draht zum CIO. Remote oder hybrid.

jobs.description:
Digital Marketing Specialist (Google Ads, SEO & Social Media) – Remote

Google Ads | SEO | Social Media | PPC | Digital Marketing

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and optimize paid advertising, search engine optimization (SEO), and social media initiatives that drive measurable business growth.

This is a hands-on execution role where you’ll own campaign performance across Google Ads, SEO, and social media channels. You’ll be responsible for increasing website traffic, improving search rankings, generating qualified leads, growing online engagement, and maximizing return on advertising spend (ROAS).

You’ll work closely with marketing leadership to develop, execute, and continuously optimize digital campaigns using data-driven insights and best practices.

If you enjoy analyzing performance, testing new ideas, optimizing campaigns, and delivering measurable marketing results, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Google Ads & Paid Search (Primary Focus)

  • Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across:
    • Search
    • Display
    • Remarketing
  • Conduct keyword research and organize campaign structures.
  • Write and optimize high-converting ad copy.
  • Manage:
    • Bidding strategies
    • Audience targeting
    • Budget allocation
    • Campaign pacing
  • Continuously improve:
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Cost Per Click (CPC)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Conversion Rate
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Perform A/B testing on ads, landing pages, and targeting strategies.

SEO & Organic Growth

  • Conduct keyword research using tools such as:
    • SEMrush
    • Ahrefs
    • Google Keyword Planner
  • Optimize:
    • Meta titles
    • Meta descriptions
    • Headers
    • Internal linking
    • On-page content
  • Support technical SEO improvements.
  • Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, and search visibility.
  • Identify new content opportunities and keyword gaps to improve organic performance.

Social Media Management

  • Manage engagement across:
    • LinkedIn
    • Facebook
    • Instagram
  • Schedule and optimize social media content.
  • Respond to comments, direct messages, and audience inquiries.
  • Monitor engagement trends and audience growth.
  • Recommend strategies to improve reach, engagement, and brand awareness.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Track campaign performance using:
    • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
    • Google Ads
    • Social media insights
  • Monitor KPIs including:
    • Traffic
    • Conversions
    • Engagement
    • ROAS
  • Prepare performance reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Document campaign changes and optimization activities.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.
  • 3+ years of experience managing social media platforms and engagement.
  • Proven SEO experience using:
    • SEMrush
    • Ahrefs
    • Similar SEO tools

Core Skills

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Google Ads
    • PPC optimization
    • Keyword research
    • Audience targeting
    • Bid strategies
  • Experience with:
    • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
    • Google Search Console
  • Strong understanding of:
    • CTR
    • CPC
    • CPA
    • ROAS
    • Conversion optimization
  • Excellent written English and copywriting skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Background in:
    • SaaS
    • B2B
    • E-commerce
  • Experience with:
    • A/B testing
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
    • Marketing automation platforms
  • Familiarity with content marketing workflows.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly analytical and data-driven.
  • Passionate about optimizing campaign performance.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable balancing paid advertising, SEO, and social media management.
  • Curious and proactive in testing new marketing strategies.
  • Excellent communicator with strong organizational skills.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign dashboards and performance metrics.
  • Optimize Google Ads campaigns and bidding strategies.
  • Conduct keyword research and implement SEO improvements.
  • Monitor and respond to social media engagement.
  • Analyze campaign performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Prepare reports and performance recommendations.
  • Collaborate with leadership on growth initiatives.

In short: You drive traffic, improve search visibility, grow audience engagement, and maximize marketing performance across paid and organic digital channels.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Improved Google Ads performance (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS).
  • Increased website traffic and qualified lead generation.
  • Growth in organic keyword rankings and SEO performance.
  • Higher social media engagement and audience growth.
  • Accurate and actionable marketing reports.
  • Continuous campaign optimization and measurable business impact.

Why Join Us?

  • Own and optimize multiple digital marketing channels.
  • Work in a performance-driven environment where results matter.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise across PPC, SEO, analytics, and social media.
  • Collaborate with experienced marketing leaders.
  • Fully remote work environment with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Growth Marketing Manager
    • Digital Marketing Lead
    • Marketing Manager

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Final Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a Digital Marketing Specialist who enjoys optimizing Google Ads, improving SEO performance, growing social media engagement, and using data to drive better marketing results, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build high-performing digital marketing campaigns that deliver measurable business growth.

jobs.excerpt: About usEdpuzzle is a leading edtech company with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona and over 12 years of history helping teachers find and create exciting, interactive learning experiences.
jobs.description:
About us

Edpuzzle is a leading edtech company with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona and over 12 years of history helping teachers find and create exciting, interactive learning experiences. We're a software company built by teachers, for teachers, committed to empowering educators with intuitive software to engage students all in one place, from video learning and beyond.

Millions of teachers and students around the world are already using Edpuzzle to make education more equitable and engaging. If you’re passionate about making an impact and find joy in learning, you’ll feel right at home with us. Check out the job details below to see if Edpuzzle could be the right fit for you!

About working at Edpuzzle

Working at Edpuzzle means joining a global team dedicated to enhancing education for all. Picture a place where you can connect with your teammates, whether remotely or in person, whenever you need support. A place where one day you're helping shape one of the biggest edtech platforms in the world, and the next day you're doing a teambuilding activity with your coworkers. A place where everyone has been selected because they're the best at what they do, and where your manager and team trust your decisions fully.

We value work-life harmony, which is why we’ve embraced a “remote-first” approach that emphasizes flexibility and choice while fostering meaningful engagement. It's no surprise that in our latest employee satisfaction survey, Work-Life Balance (92%), Leadership (85%), and Employee Engagement (84%) were highlighted as our top drivers, because we genuinely care about creating an environment where people can thrive, feel supported, and do their best work. A place where you're encouraged to learn and grow, because education is the cornerstone of everything we do.

About the process

The goal of our interview process is to learn about each other. Each step is structured to help us understand your unique talents and contributions, while offering you insight into our team and culture.

For a detailed breakdown of our recruitment process, please refer to our Selection Process Guide which outlines every step of our candidate journey. A dedicated member of our team will support you through each step, and you'll have the opportunity to meet various Edpuzzlers along the way.

About the role

    We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Product team in Spain and help us build thoughtful, reliable experiences for teachers and students. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving real user problems, works with initiative, and is motivated by learning and growing in a highly collaborative environment.

    In this role, you’ll contribute across the stack, partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to understand problems, shape solutions, build features, and improve the product with user impact always in mind. You’ll bring your own perspective, question assumptions, and take ownership from problem understanding through implementation, helping drive better technical and product decisions along the way. You’ll also continuously learn with the aim of taking on problems of increasing complexity over time, including the possibility of leading projects with technical complexity, product complexity, or both.

    Technically speaking, we use React and Redux for our frontend and Node and Express applying DDD and hexagonal architecture in the backend. We use MongoDB for our database and are fully hosted on AWS which we also use to store, encode and stream our own pool of videos. Our Engineering team also has access to Claude Code as part of a modern development environment that supports learning, experimentation, and day-to-day work. We work with testing, trunk based development, CI/CD, and we follow engineering best practices without compromising on code quality or reliability.

About our team

    We’re a deeply product-focused team. Engineers at Edpuzzle are expected to think beyond implementation: understanding the user problem, challenging assumptions, making thoughtful trade-offs, and contributing to better product decisions that elevate the experience for our users.

    We work in cross-functional, rotational teams, fostering close partnerships between Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and other key areas such as Design, Data, QA, and Security. This gives Engineers broad exposure across the product and creates opportunities to develop both technical depth and strong product judgment over time.

    At our core is an environment where every voice is heard and valued, and where each team member plays a role in shaping project strategies, not just execution. We value proactiveness and curiosity to understand the bigger picture. Engineers are not just encouraged but expected to think critically, form their own opinions, make thoughtful use of modern tools, propose solutions, and take ownership. We’ve built a culture where ideas are shared openly and assumptions are challenged in service of building a better product for our users.

    Browse our library of talks to learn more about the Product team and Engineering culture at Edpuzzle: 🎥Edpuzzle Talks

About the job

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand user needs, explore solutions, and contribute to product and technical discussions with your own perspective.

  • Take ownership of the problems you work on by understanding why they matter to users, doing your own research, proposing solutions, and driving implementation with support from teammates when needed.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teammates to keep projects moving with efficiency and focus, while also delivering the best possible outcome on time.

  • Develop pixel perfect designs in partnership with the Design team.

  • Build simple, clean, testable, and reliable code across the stack.

  • Continuously learn how different parts of Edpuzzle’s software work, why they were built that way, where they can be improved, and how to use the tools available to you to keep growing.

  • Make effective use of the tools available to you, including AI where appropriate, to learn faster, work more effectively, and move problems forward, while maintaining strong judgment and high standards.

  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade software.

  • Write technical documentation that helps others understand decisions, systems, and implementation details.

  • Contribute wherever needed to help the team deliver meaningful outcomes.

About you

  • 3 to 5 years professional experience in frontend, backend, or full-stack development.

  • You have experience writing well-tested JavaScript/TypeScript code and have delivered features end-to-end in real-world systems.

  • You have strong experience building complex interactive UIs in React and developing backend systems in Node.js, ideally in high-traffic environments.

  • You are comfortable working across the stack. If you’re not already full-stack, you’re aiming to get there.

  • You are product-oriented: you make technical decisions with the final user in mind, and you care about solving the right problems, not just building things right.

  • You are pragmatic with technology: you understand that tech is a means to solve product problems, never the end goal.

  • You use AI and other modern tools responsibly to support and improve your work, never as a substitute for the understanding, judgment, or ownership of your output.

  • You are an avid learner who turns curiosity into action. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and proactively look for better ways to solve the right problems.

  • You work with ownership and autonomy, manage your time well, and are flexible when priorities or context change.

  • You communicate your ideas clearly and adapt your message to your audience.

  • You feel comfortable in spoken Spanish and written English, as they are the main language of our engineers’ day-to-day operations.

  • You are based in Spain and have a work permit to work in Spain.

Bonus skills

  • Experience working in startup or scaleup environments and in cross-functional teams

  • Experience navigating ambiguous environments and contributing beyond pure implementation

  • Experience with Redux for client state management

  • Experience with Express.js and MongoDB

  • Experience with complex backend architectures such as Hexagonal Architecture and Domain Driven Design (DDD)

  • … or another amazing skill you bring to the table that we haven’t thought of yet!

What we offer

  • 💰 Salary between €‎38K – €‎50K based on your professional experience
  • 🧑‍💻 Remote-first within Spain, with our Barcelona office to come as much or as little as you'd like
  • 🌴 24 days’ paid holidays plus December 24th and 31st
  • ⏳ Flexible working hours and reduced working time on Fridays to support work-life balance
  • ❤️‍🩹 Access to Wellhub to support physical and emotional well-being
  • 🥣 €2000 annual allowance for meals with Cobee
  • 🚀 $1,200 per year in professional development reimbursement as well as CodelyTV subscription
  • 🏥 Private health insurance policy with AXA
  • 👶 Flexible remuneration for childcare
  • 🚌 Flexible remuneration for public transport
  • 🩺 Flexible remuneration for health insurance of immediate family members (spouse and/or children)
  • ☕ Fully stocked pantry with a variety of snacks and drinks in the Barcelona office
  • 🙌 Team-building events during working hours to connect, learn, and create lasting bonds with passionate colleagues

Edpuzzle maintains a drug-free workplace and is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Edpuzzle makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

Please be aware of potential scams involving fake job offers using Edpuzzle’s name. Official communications will always originate from the @edpuzzle.com domain, not external domains like Gmail. Edpuzzle will never request payments or skip formal interviews during the hiring process, nor request sensitive personal information without a valid reason. To verify any communication, please contact

from previous employers will be requested from candidates during the selection process. If you’d like to be considered for this position, please apply below. We look forward to hearing from you!

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Web Designer, your focus will be on marketing pages, landing experiences, and conversion-driven layouts. jobs.description:
About Ceribell

Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point-of-care electroencephalography (“EEG”) platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. Our entire team is driven by a shared commitment to transforming the landscape of critical care through our rapid seizure detection technology, come join the movement!

The Medical Director will be a key member of the management team, providing medical oversight, expertise, and leadership to support Ceribell’s strategy to expand clinical indications, develop new products, and implement clinical trials to continue to build evidence to support market adoption. The Medical Director will be a visible advocate for driving education and awareness on how neurological patients in the ICU and the floor are monitored and diagnosed, helping healthcare providers monitor and reduce time from ordering an EEG to set-up from an average of 4 hours to under 10 minutes. They will be an important spokesperson, including providing guidance on neuro-critical health-related matters with key opinion leaders at scientific conferences and advisory boards defining global standards of care for patients. S/he will have the credibility, experience, and relationships to drive initiatives and results.

What You Will Do

Strategy

  • Lead medical strategy and planning
  • Support clinical, marketing, and product strategy

Execution

  • Peer-to-peer engagement through sales (~70% time)
    • Working with sales to directly engage customers from pre-PO sales process, through hospital executive engagements, to workflow discussions
    • Educating the sales team on how to better engage customers (1-on-1 and directly working with sales trainer and sales leadership)
    • Developing other physician advocates for Ceribell so that these advocates can engage and present our products to more physicians
  • Peer-to-peer engagement through marketing (10%)
    • Support marketing in engaging different societies
    • Support advisory board
    • Give talks and webinars representing Ceribell
  • Evidence generation - support evidence generation and publications (10%)
    • Partner with clinical and marketing teams on post-market evidence:
      • Publication strategy and execution
      • Retrospective study strategy, design, and execution
      • Investigator-initiated study management and support
    • Identify and develop KOL and physician relationships:
      • To select appropriate partners for sponsored clinical trials and studies
      • To develop a network or fellows or residents who can assist with research and writing for Ceribell
    • Regulatory trials – support clinical/reg/R&D/Product team to design trials for data collection or approval by providing the medical expertise
    • Keep the organization updated with the latest literature
      • Identify key evidence or medical opportunities for the company
  • Provide medical expertise for cross-functional teams (10%)
    • To Product and R&D teams on future product development
    • To Regulatory and Reimbursement teams by interfacing with FDA and payers

What You Bring

  • MD, DO or MD/PhD degree required
  • An experienced Neurologist or Intensivist with at least 10 years of experience in industry or as an attending physician. The Company is open to having a full-time Neurologist or Intensivist with direct experience in industry as or alternatively, an attending Neurologist or Intensivist who can spend 50% of his/her time with Ceribell and 50% with their practice.
  • Critical care experience required
  • Experience with the Ceribell platform
  • Experience and strong knowledge of neurological assessment and acute care workflow – highly desired.
  • Analytical and strategic thinking capabilities along with good judgment and decision-making skills balanced with high degree of EQ and well-balanced ego.
  • A dedication to integrity, transparency and honesty is a must; an informal, direct personal style and a flexible approach are highly desirable attributes.
  • Data driven mindset with the capability to envision the application of new technologies in novel ways to solve complex patient needs.
  • A commercially oriented mindset is important. S/he should have a strong understanding of the product commercialization pathway and be able to add value to general business strategy.
  • Expertise in presenting breakthrough products and new technologies to physicians.
  • Highly developed understanding of the external marketplace and medical literature to serve as a valuable key member of the executive team with the ability to bring medical and/or clinical knowledge to the analysis of the Company’s future commercial opportunities.
  • Excellent written, verbal communication, influence/leadership, and presentation skills to various audiences, particularly neurologists and intensivists as well as the ICU and other hospital administrators.
  • Ability to make reasonable tradeoffs and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, data driven entrepreneurial environment.
  • Creative and critical intellect with a 'what if' openness to new ideas and "thinks large". Generates ideas/opportunities and turns them into successful results. Flexible about implementation while being inflexible about the quality and timeliness of results.
  • A results-oriented executive who conveys a sense of urgency and drives for closure. Able to execute and prioritize multiple, competing tasks and demands. Recognizes and executes critical details.
  • Effective collaborative interpersonal skills: persuasive, generates enthusiasm, credible at all levels of the organization.
  • Comfortable and productive with rapidly changing organizational needs and adept at managing in a start-up resource environment.
  • Assist in formulating a process that adds a business and market component to prioritizing research projects.
  • Ability to interface effectively with all levels and functions within the organization, as well as the Company’s Board of Directors.
  • Experience as a respected senior clinical/medical leader with an excellent working relationship with the FDA including a successful history of effective collaboration through clinical studies, market release and post- marketing activities.
  • Significant experience in relating to marketing and business issues with a focus on clinical and medical support of commercial assets.
  • Broad contacts in academic medical centers, major practice centers, and the medical device industry
  • Location: Remote (US-Based)
  • Travel required: Up to 40% travel required (typically 2 days per week)

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Compensation Range
$300,000—$309,000 USD

A candidate’s final salary offer will be based on their skills, education, work location and experience, and thus it may differ from the posted range. Compensation may also include bonuses consistent with Ceribell’s corporate compensation plan. Note, the above description is not all-encompassing and Ceribell reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time.

In addition to your base compensation, Ceribell offers eligible employees the following:

With over 400 open source projects and collaborations including Open VSX, Adoptium, Jakarta EE, Eclipse IDE, and OpenHW, we serve a global community of millions of developers and more than 300 member organisations. We are seeking a versatile Marketing Specialist to contribute across a broad range of marketing activities, including campaigns, content, systems, and reporting. This is a hands-on role focused on execution and enablement, helping ensure that marketing initiatives are well coordinated, measurable, and able to scale across a global, community-driven organisation. The successful candidate will be comfortable shifting between planned initiatives and emerging needs, managing several workstreams at different stages, and delivering accurate, high-quality work within agreed timelines.
