About MakeUseOf

MakeUseOf is one of the largest online technology publications on the web today. We equip millions of readers—from everyday consumers to seasoned tech enthusiasts—with practical guides, explainers, product recommendations, and deep feature analysis to help them make the most of their technology.

While we cover everything from desktop operating systems to smart home tech, we are actively looking for specialized writers who can turn complex technical subjects, hands-on builds, and practical home tech into clear, engaging features.

Priority Coverage Areas:

  • Home Automation & Practical DIY Tech: Smart home sensors (motion, occupancy, contact), smart hubs/protocols (Matter, Zigbee, Z-Wave), power tool ecosystems (Ryobi, Milwaukee, DeWalt), and AV/networking cabling infrastructure (Cat 6/6a, Ethernet drops, HDMI standards).
  • AI & Local Language Models: Writers with dedicated hardware rigs excited to test, benchmark, and write about open-source local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio), local AI workflows, custom agents, and practical consumer AI applications.
  • Homelab & Advanced Networking: Deep knowledge of home networking infrastructure, Proxmox, NAS builds, self-hosting, network management tools, routers, radio networks, and home network security.
  • PC Hardware & Linux: Hands-on experience with CPUs, GPUs, benchmarking, custom PC building, hardware testing, and the Linux ecosystem.
  • Maker Projects & Hardware Hacking: Smart home automation, Raspberry Pi, ESP32 microcontrollers, DIY hardware builds, and practical workshop tech.
  • Core Operating Systems & Software: Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, security/privacy tools, productivity software, and web utilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively pitch creative, original feature ideas while regularly claiming assigned topics from the editorial board.
  • Write clear, engaging, and structurally sound feature articles that simplify complex technical concepts.
  • Test software, hardware, or workflows hands-on to provide authentic, step-by-step guidance and technical analysis.
  • Input, format, and structure articles inside our in-house CMS according to style guidelines (including screenshots, formatting, and link insertion).
  • Work collaboratively with section editors to refine pitches and incorporate feedback.

Application Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Track record writing technical guides, hardware deep-dives, or software features in English.
  • Access to the physical hardware, custom rigs, microcontrollers, homelab environments, or testing setups required for your primary coverage areas.
  • Strong drive to consistently pitch fresh, relevant article ideas that match current tech trends.
  • Ability to break down technical jargon into accessible, practical advice for tech enthusiasts and everyday readers alike.

How to Apply:

Please submit the following materials in your application:

  1. Your CV / Resume
  2. A Cover Letter addressing: Which specific topics/verticals above match your hands-on expertise, and what setups/gear (e.g., home networks, tool ecosystems, test rigs) do you currently use?
  3. 2–3 published writing samples (preferably long-form tech features, explainers, homelab guides, or hardware breakdowns).

We will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you'd make a solid addition to the team.

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic and consultative Account Manager to drive the SaaS and programmatic success across a portfolio of strategic supply-side clients in EMEA. In this role, you will serve as a trusted Business and Strategic Consultant to supply-side clients, including Out-of-Home Media Owners and Retail Media Networks. You will move beyond transactional support to help clients maximize yield, optimize holistic revenue across direct and programmatic channels, and drive adoption of the Broadsign Platform.

What to Expect

Strategic Client Advisory & Yield Optimization

Act as the primary, strategic point of contact for media owners, driving data-driven discussions around yield management and holistic revenue growth through the use of our platform. You will develop and execute joint, revenue-focused annual business plans with top-tier clients. Additionally, you will advise clients on inventory optimization, programmatic pricing, and monetization strategies across digital, static, and video assets, leveraging dashboards to guide proactive yield management.

Revenue Growth & Account Expansion

Identify and execute cross-sell and upsell opportunities to drive broader adoption of the Broadsign Platform, maintaining end-to-end commercial ownership of your accounts across all renewals and expansion efforts while partnering with the Sales team in a co-pilot model when navigating larger, complex deals to maximize revenue growth, retention, and platform usage.

Knowledge Leadership & Specialized Advisory

Serve as a trusted industry expert, sharing market trends, media insights, and advanced platform capabilities with media owners. You will guide clients in adopting sophisticated adserving, programmatic, and audience-targeting solutions to maximize overall inventory value. For Retail Media clients, you will offer strategic guidance on specialized omnichannel integrations, data commercialization, and emerging trade strategies.

What we are looking for Key requirements for this position

  • 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Yield Management, or Strategic Consulting within AdTech, Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH), Supply-Side Platforms (SSPs), or Retail Media Networks (RMNs).
  • Strong technical and industry understanding of adserving logic, supply-side programmatic trading, yield optimization, and inventory management.
  • Proven track record of executing a consultative mindset, shifting client relationships from operational support to high-level strategic business advisory.
  • Solid commercial acumen with the ability to spot growth opportunities, build business cases, and handle renewals or upsells.
  • Data-driven approach with experience leveraging analytics and performance dashboards to guide strategy.
  • Fluency in French and English to effectively manage client relationships and collaborate across global teams.

What we bring to the table

  • Wellness & Mental Health: €500 annual Wellness fund for mental/physical health and office-related expenses, plus unlimited online mental health support through BetterHelp for you and your family.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous vacation package, 5 floater days, and two paid volunteer days.
  • Work Flexibility: Fully remote work options across Europe
  • Family & Growth Support: Parental leave salary supplement, statutory location benefits, and professional development opportunities supported by a dedicated yearly training budget.

jobs.title: Paralegal Contractor
jobs.excerpt: TL;DR We're hiring a part-time Paralegal (US, remote; Idaho a plus) to support Kelvin's legal team on an ongoing, non-caseload basis, think contract templates, playbooks, and NDA/MSA review, not litigation.
jobs.description:
TL;DR

We're hiring a part-time Paralegal (US, remote; Idaho a plus) to support Kelvin's legal team on an ongoing, non-caseload basis, think contract templates, playbooks, and NDA/MSA review, not litigation. This is a flat-rate contractor role: $2,500–$4,000/month regardless of hours worked, with the workload estimated around 20 hours a week on average, though it'll vary week to week. Reports to Meredith Gittings, Director of Legal.

The Role

Kelvin is a Series B, fast-moving technology company, and our legal team is looking for a part-time paralegal to support our internal legal operations. This isn't a caseload-driven role; it's ongoing legal support: keeping our contract templates and playbooks current, reviewing incoming NDAs and other legal documents, and helping keep our legal files and internal policies organized and up to date. Like everyone here, you may be expected to work cross-functionally rather than staying inside a narrowly defined legal lane. Kelvin builds software that lets industrial operations, in mining, energy, manufacturing, and other continuous-process industries, act on their own real-time data through the control systems they already run, with guardrails and human oversight built in.

What You'll Do

  • Review and update Kelvin's contract templates to keep them accurate, consistent, and aligned with current legal and business requirements and changes.
  • Create and maintain playbooks that document how common contract types and clauses should be negotiated and reviewed and keep track of commercial decisions from leadership.
  • Review NDAs, MSAs, and other incoming legal documents from clients and prospective partners, including running redline comparisons between versions and flagging deviations from Kelvin's standard positions.
  • Clean up and organize internal legal files and folders so documents are easy to find and version control stays clear.
  • Review and help update internal policies, ensuring they're current and consistently formatted.
  • Take on related ad hoc legal-administrative requests as they come up during the engagement.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of paralegal experience, ideally in a corporate/in-house or transactional setting rather than litigation.
  • Prior experience working at or with a B2B SaaS/technology company, comfortable operating in a fast-moving, cloud-based environment.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing and redlining NDAs and other commercial contracts.
  • Strong organizational skills: comfortable building and maintaining templates, playbooks, and a clean filing system.
  • Clear, precise written communication and careful attention to detail.
  • Able to work independently, prioritize a variable workload, and turn around requests reliably without daily oversight.
  • Proactive and comfortable working cross-functionally: you'll partner closely with sales and tech, and should feel empowered to reach out directly to those teams when something comes up rather than waiting to be told.
  • Availability to occasionally help with time-sensitive matters from our Australian office is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.
  • Professional experience with efficient and effective AI tool use in daily workflow (e.g., Claude) to speed up drafting, review, and research.
  • Very strong contract and document-management tool experience (e.g., Word/Google Docs redlining, shared drives, DocuSign).
  • Paralegal certificate or equivalent practical experience a bonus.
  • Experience with large industrial customers is a plus.

How This Engagement Works

This is a part-time contractor role with a fixed monthly rate rather than hourly billing. Compensation ranges from $2,500 to $4,000 per month, depending on experience and profile, and covers availability and delivery across the responsibilities outlined above. We expect the workload to average around 20 hours per week, although this may vary depending on current priorities, with some weeks being lighter and others busier. We'll check in regularly to align on upcoming work and priorities, so expectations and workload remain clear and predictable on both sides. This role reports to Meredith Gittings, Director of Legal.

Next Steps

Along with your application, please include a short example of a time you stepped in to support an in-house attorney or team in a small, fast-moving tech environment, what the situation was, and how you helped. A cover letter is optional; include one if you'd like, but it's not required.

jobs.excerpt: [English, French to follow]GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles.
jobs.description:
[English, French to follow]

GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice

Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for an Environment Artist / Generalist with strong hands-on art skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both creating high-quality 3D art and helping teams work more clearly, consistently, and efficiently. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to asset creation, world building, scene assembly, feedback, task breakdowns, workflow documentation, quality reviews, and cross-studio collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable artist with a strong art eye, a practical production mindset, and the ability to help translate creative direction into actionable work for other artists.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support team alignment, mentor other artists, improve workflows, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

This role offers flexible work options, including remote, hybrid or in-office arrangements.

Responsibilities

  • Create high-quality 3D environment art, props, modular assets, materials, set dressing, and world-building content across a variety of visual styles.
  • Work from concept art, reference, style guides, blockouts, client direction, or incomplete/vague creative briefs to produce clear and polished results.
  • Build, assemble, and integrate assets and environments in Unreal Engine, with attention to composition, readability, performance, and technical requirements.
  • Support the full environment art pipeline, including modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, material creation, optimization, engine integration, and final polish.
  • Review artwork from internal teammates, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help translate broad client or project feedback into specific tasks, priorities, notes, and acceptance criteria that artists can execute against.
  • Assist with maintaining visual consistency across assets, scenes, and artists by helping define quality bars, style expectations, and review standards.
  • Collaborate with art directors, leads, producers, technical artists, designers, engineers, and artists across multiple studios and time zones.
  • Help identify production risks early, including unclear direction, workflow gaps, quality issues, technical constraints, or schedule concerns.
  • Contribute to workflow and pipeline improvements that help the team work more efficiently and consistently.
  • Document processes, best practices, feedback, and workflow guidance when needed using tools such as Confluence, Miro, or Jira.
  • Balance visual quality, production efficiency, and performance requirements while supporting the needs of each project.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a 3D Environment Artist, Generalist, World Artist, or similar role in games or real-time production.
  • At least one shipped game or comparable real-time interactive project.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality environment art, world building, prop creation, materials, and/or scene assembly.
  • Strong artistic eye for form, composition, lighting, material definition, scale, visual hierarchy, and style consistency.
  • Ability to work across different visual styles, from realistic to stylized, depending on project needs.
  • Experience creating both individual assets and assembled environments/scenes.
  • Solid understanding of the full environment art pipeline, including modeling, UV layout, baking, texturing, materials, optimization, and engine implementation.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine.
  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Photoshop.
  • Practical understanding of real-time performance considerations, including LODs, draw calls, texel density, texture memory, collision, lightmaps, shaders/material complexity, scene organization, and asset budgets.
  • Strong communication skills, especially when giving feedback, clarifying direction, documenting decisions, or breaking down complex problems.
  • Ability to take vague or high-level direction and turn it into clear, actionable work.
  • Comfortable collaborating with artists, leads, producers, and cross-discipline partners.
  • Able to give and receive feedback professionally, clearly, and constructively.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience mentoring artists, reviewing work, or informally supporting lead-level responsibilities.
  • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience providing feedback through written notes, paintovers, drawovers, video reviews, live calls, or structured review documents.
  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
  • Experience helping define style guides, quality bars, workflow documentation, or art review standards.
  • Experience breaking down client feedback into Jira tasks, art notes, production plans, or acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with procedural workflows, Houdini, Blueprint, Python, scripting, or tool-assisted content creation.
  • Experience with optimization passes, performance profiling, memory budgets, or platform-specific art constraints.
  • Experience with both realistic and stylized production art.
  • Experience in multiple engines or real-time pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with clients or helping support client-facing reviews.

Portfolio Requirements

Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your environment art and/or generalist capabilities.

Strong portfolios should include:

  • Finished 3D environments, scenes, props, or world-building examples.
  • Examples rendered or captured in a real-time engine, preferably Unreal Engine.
  • Breakdowns showing your process, including blockout, modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, materials, set dressing, lighting, and final integration where applicable.
  • Examples that show your ability to work across different visual styles.
  • Examples of modular kits, reusable asset systems, material workflows, or production-friendly environment pipelines.
  • Any examples that show technical problem solving, optimization, performance-aware decisions, or efficient workflows.
  • If showing team-created work, please clearly explain what you personally contributed.
  • Nice to have: examples of feedback, mentorship, documentation, workflow improvements, style matching, or before/after improvements you helped guide.
  • Nice to have: written context explaining the goal of the work, constraints, tools used, your role, and any production challenges you helped solve.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is not just a strong artist, but someone who naturally thinks about how the whole team succeeds.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Care about making great-looking art and making the process better for the team.
  • Enjoy solving production problems, not just completing assigned assets.
  • Can look at a scene or asset and identify what is working, what is not, and how to improve it.
  • Communicate feedback in a way that is clear, respectful, and useful.
  • Can help artists understand not just what to change, but why it matters.
  • Are comfortable adapting to different clients, art styles, pipelines, and project needs.
  • Have the judgment to balance quality, speed, technical constraints, and team bandwidth.
  • Are interested in growing toward lead responsibilities while remaining hands-on in production.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

This position is currently open to candidates residing in the following Canada Provinces: Ontario, Quebec, or British Columbia.

Salary Range: $65,000 CAD to $70,000 CAD

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunity to work on different projects
  • 3 weeks of paid leave
  • Benefits package including medical, dental and vision
  • Sick Leave
  • Disability Coverage
  • Corporate holidays
  • Professional Development

GameSim is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, and alignment with the role.

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

GameSim est un studio de développement vidéoludique qui collabore avec des clients afin de créer des jeux aux styles artistiques variés, que ce soit sur PC ou sur console. Nous avons à cœur le savoir-faire, la collaboration et la livraison de produits auxquels nous sommes fiers d’être associés. Notre siège social est situé à Orlando, en Floride!

Avis d’offre d’emploi (vivier de talents)

Notez que cette offre d’emploi n’est pas associée à un poste actuellement vacant. Nous étoffons de manière proactive un vivier de candidat(e)s qualifié(e)s afin d’anticiper les embauches nécessaires au cours des mois à venir. Les candidatures seront analysées, conservées et considérées lorsque les occasions se présenteront.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) artiste/généraliste en environnements avec de solides compétences artistiques manuelles, un jugement technique solide et le potentiel d’évoluer vers des responsabilités de direction plus importantes au fil du temps.

Ce rôle est idéal pour une personne adorant créer de l’art 3D de haute qualité et aider les équipes à travailler de manière plus claire, cohérence et efficace. En fonction du projet, cette personne pourrait contribuer directement à la création de ressources, à la construction de mondes, à l’assemblage de scènes, aux commentaires, à la décomposition des tâches, à la documentation des flux des travaux, aux contrôles de qualité et à la collaboration entre les studios.

Nos projets peuvent varier considérablement en termes de style, d’envergure, de plateforme et de besoins des clients. Ainsi, nous recherchons un artiste polyvalent doté d’un oeil artistique aiguisé, d’un esprit pratique en matière de production et capable d’aider à traduire la direction créative en travail concret pour les autres artistes.

Il s’agit d’un rôle de production pratique offrant des opportunités de soutenir l’alignement de l’équipe, d’encadrer d’autres artistes, d’améliorer des flux des travaux et de se développer vers des responsabilités de gestionnaires.

Ce rôle offre des options de travail flexibles, incluant des aménagements à distance, hybrides ou au bureau.

Responsabilités

  • Créer des environnements 3D de haute qualité, des accessoires, des ressources modulaires, des matériaux, des décors et du contenu de création de monde dans une variété de styles visuels.
  • Travailler à partir de concepts artistiques, de références, de guides de style, de maquettes, de directives client ou de briefs créatifs incomplets ou vagues pour produire des résultats clairs et peaufinés.
  • Créer, assembler et intégrer des ressources et des environnements dans Unreal Engine, en accordant une attention particulière à la composition, à la lisibilité, aux performances et aux exigences techniques.
  • Prendre en charge l’intégralité du processus de création artistique des environnements, incluant la modélisation, les UV, le « baking », la texturation, la création de matériaux, l’optimisation, l’intégration dans le moteur et le peaufinage final.
  • Passer en revue les œuvres des collègues internes, des studios partenaires ou des fournisseurs externes, et fournir des commentaires clairs, constructifs et constructifs.
  • Aider à traduire les commentaires généraux des clients ou des projets en tâches, priorités, notes et critères d’acceptation spécifiques que les artistes peuvent appliquer.
  • Aider à maintenir la cohérence visuelle entre les ressources, les scènes et les artistes en aidant à définir les seuils de qualité, les attentes en matière de style et les normes de révision.
  • Collaborer avec des directeurs artistiques, des chefs d'équipe, des producteurs, des artistes techniques, des concepteurs, des ingénieurs et des artistes issus de différents studios et fuseaux horaires.
  • Aider à identifier les risques de production tôt dans le processus, incluant les directives imprécises, les lacunes dans les flux des travaux, les problèmes de qualité, les contraintes techniques ou les préoccupations en matière d’échéancier.
  • Aider à améliorer les flux des travaux et les processus pour que l’équipe travaille de manière plus efficace et cohérente.
  • Documenter les processus, les meilleures pratiques, les commentaires et les directives relatives aux flux des travaux selon les besoins à l’aide d'outils tels que Confluence, Miro ou Jira.
  • Équilibrer la qualité visuelle, l’efficacité de la production et les exigences en matière de performance, tout en répondant aux besoins de chaque projet.

Exigences

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant qu’artiste en environnements 3D, généraliste, artiste des mondes ou dans un rôle similaire dans les jeux vidéo ou la production en temps réel.
  • Au moins un titre livré ou un projet interactif comparable en temps réel.
  • Solide portfolio démontrant un travail de haute qualité dans la création d’environnements, d’univers, d’accessoires, de matériaux et/ou d’assemblage de scènes.
  • Un sens artistique aigu pour la forme, la composition, l’éclairage, la définition des matériaux, l’échelle, la hiérarchie visuelle et la cohérence du style.
  • Capacité à travailler avec différents styles visuels, du réaliste au stylisé, selon les besoins du projet.
  • Expérience dans la création de ressources individuelles et d’environnements ou de scènes assemblés.
  • Solide compréhension de l’ensemble du processus de création artistique des environnements, incluant la modélisation, la configuration des UV, le « baking », la texturation, les matériaux, l’optimisation et l’implémentation dans le moteur.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec Unreal Engine.
  • Maîtrise des outils de production courants tels que Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Substance Designer et Photoshop.
  • Compréhension pratique des considérations de performance en temps réel, incluant les niveaux de détails (LODs), les appels de rendu, la densité de texels, la mémoire de texture, les collisions, les cartes d’éclairage, la complexité des ombrages ou des matériaux, l’organisation des scènes et les budgets des ressources.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, surtout pour fournir des commentaires, clarifier les directives, documenter les décisions ou décomposer les problèmes complexes.
  • Capacité à transformer des instructions vagues ou de haut niveau en tâches claires et concrètes.
  • Aisance à collaborer avec des artistes, des chefs d’équipe, des producteurs et des partenaires interdisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à fournir et à recevoir des commentaires de manière professionnelle, claire et constructive.
  • Grand sens des responsabilités, rigueur d’exécution et capacité à résoudre les problèmes.
  • Intérêt pour évoluer vers des responsabilités de gestion plus larges avec le temps.

Atouts

  • Expérience préalable en mentorat d’artistes, en évaluation du travail ou en assistance informelle aux responsabilités des chefs d’équipe.
  • Expérience de travail avec des fournisseurs externes, des codéveloppements, des studios partenaires ou des fournisseurs externes.
  • Expérience à collaborer avec des équipes issues de différents pays, cultures et fuseaux horaires.
  • Expérience à fournir des commentaires au moyen de notes écrites, de retouches de repeinture, de dessins de correction, d’examens vidéo, d’appels en direct ou de documents d’examen structurés.
  • Maîtrise des outils de production courants tels que Perforce, Jira, Miro et Confluence.
  • Expérience pour définir des guides de style, des seuils de qualité, de la documentation relative aux flux des travaux ou des normes de révision artistique.
  • Expérience dans la décomposition des commentaires des clients en tâches Jira, en notes artistiques, en plans de production ou en critères d’acceptation.
  • Expérience avec les flux des travaux procéduraux, Houdini, Blueprint, Python, le scriptage ou la création de contenu assistée par outils.
  • Expérience avec les passes d’optimisation, le profilage des performances, la gestion de la mémoire ou les contraintes artistiques propres aux plateformes.
  • Expérience dans la production d’œuvres réalistes et stylisées.
  • Expérience avec différents moteurs ou processus en temps réel.
  • Expérience pour travailler directement avec les clients ou pour aider avec les évaluations destinées aux clients.

Exigences du portfolio

Veuillez inclure un portfolio qui démontre clairement vos compétences en création des environnements et/ou vos aptitudes généralistes.

Les portefolios convaincants devraient inclure :

  • Exemples d’environnements, de scènes, d’accessoires ou de création d’univers 3D finalisés;
  • Exemples rendus ou capturés dans un moteur en temps réel, de préférence Unreal Engine;
  • Décomposition du processus, incluant le blocage, la modélisation, les UV, le « baking », la texturation, les matériaux, la mise en scène, l’éclairage et l’intégration finale, le cas échéant;
  • Exemples qui démontrent votre capacité à travailler avec différents styles visuels;
  • Exemples de kits modulaires, de systèmes de ressources réutilisables, de flux des travaux de matériaux ou de processus d’environnements adaptés à la production;
  • Tout exemple démontrant la résolution de problèmes techniques, l’optimisation, les décisions axées sur les performances ou les flux des travaux efficaces.
  • Si vous présentez un travail qui a été réalisé en équipe, veuillez expliquer clairement votre contribution personnelle.
  • Compléments intéressants : exemples de commentaires, mentorat, documentation, améliorations des flux des travaux, harmonisation des styles, ou améliorations avant/après que vous avez aidé à instaurer.
  • Compléments intéressants : contexte écrit expliquant l’objectif du travail, les contraintes, les outils utilisés, votre rôle et tous les défis de production que vous avez aidé à résoudre.

Profil du candidat ou de la candidate

Le candidat ou la candidate idéal(e) n’est pas qu’un artiste de talent, mais une personne qui est naturellement tournée vers la réussite de l’équipe.

Vous pourriez parfaitement convenir si vous :

  • vous souciez de créer des œuvres visuellement remarquables tout en améliorant le processus pour l’équipe;
  • aimez résoudre les problèmes de production, et pas seulement à faire les tâches qui vous sont assignées;
  • pouvez regarder une scène ou un élément et identifier ce qui fonctionne, ce qui ne fonctionne pas et comment l’améliorer;
  • communiquez vos commentaires de manière claire, respectueuse et utile;
  • pouvez aider les artistes à comprendre non seulement ce qu’il faut changer, mais aussi donner un sens aux changements;
  • êtes à l’aise à vous adapter à différents clients, styles artistiques, processus et besoins de projets;
  • savez équilibrer qualité, vitesse, contraintes techniques et charge d’équipe;

Comment poser votre candidature

  • Un curriculum vitae et un lien vers votre portfolio sont nécessaires.

Ce poste est actuellement ouvert seulement aux candidats et candidates résidant dans les provinces canadiennes suivantes : Ontario, Québec ou Colombie-Britannique.

Magna Legal Services is seeking an experienced proposal professional to independently manage our end-to-end RFP response process, from initial intake and planning through final submission. You will support opportunities across Magna’s full range of service lines and client types, including law firms, corporate legal departments, insurance carriers, and government agencies.

RFP volume naturally fluctuates. During active periods, you may manage several concurrent proposals spanning different service lines and buyer types. Outside of active submissions, you will own the infrastructure that makes future responses faster and stronger, including our content and credential libraries, case studies, templates, competitive insights, and proposal processes.

This is an established, full-time area of ownership rather than an entry-level or rotational assignment. You will report directly to the Director of Sales Operations and work with significant autonomy while coordinating closely with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, HR, and subject-matter experts across the business.

Primary Responsibilities

    Proposal Development and Submission

  • Independently manage standard proposal content, including company overviews, service descriptions, staff biographies and credentials, case studies, implementation approaches, and past-performance examples.
  • Manage document formatting, version control, review cycles, and submission logistics.
  • Ensure every response complies with stated requirements, including page limits, required forms, attachments, certifications, and portal-submission instructions.
  • Maintain accurate records of proposal activity, deadlines, submissions, outcomes, and client feedback.

    • Content and Credential Management

  • Build and maintain a centralized, searchable library of approved proposal content.
  • Interview consultants and service-line leaders following significant matters to develop compelling case studies and past-performance examples.
  • Maintain current biographies, credentials, certifications, and relevant experience for employees and consultants featured in proposals.
  • Review and refresh company overviews, service descriptions, methodologies, and differentiators on a regular schedule.

  • Build and maintain reusable templates by client type, service line, and solicitation type.
  • Standardize the intake and subject-matter-expert interview processes to improve response speed and content quality.
  • Document a repeatable intake-to-submission playbook that supports consistency and backup coverage.

    • Performance and Market Insights

    • Adjacent Commercial Content

  • Experience independently managing multiple concurrent proposals from intake through submission.

jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

The VP, Clinical Service Operations owns the operational engine driving Twin Health's virtual practice. This leader ensures clinical supply reliably meets member demand, builds and governs the practice infrastructure that powers efficient care-team workflows, and holds full operational and financial accountability for daily practice operations.

A core part of the role is providing the Care Team Services that enrollment depends on, including but not limited to, reliably completing onboarding visits, staffing on-demand sensor support, and standing up the human backup that steps in when automated steps fail. Additionally this role must own the supply–demand forecasting that ensures enough care-team capacity for onboarding visits and other enrollment requirements. The Enrollment leader owns enrollment performance and its metrics; this role supports that leader by guaranteeing the care-team supply and service conditions enrollment requires.

This is the counterpart to Care Team Operations: Care Team Operations defines what the clinical workforce must deliver and owns care quality, care efficiency, care service level agreements, and outcomes; Clinical Service Operations makes sure the conditions for that delivery are in place — the right supply, in the right shape, at the right cost, on infrastructure that works. As the strategic operational counterpart to Care Team Operations—which defines clinical standards, care quality, service levels, and health outcomes—Clinical Service Operations ensures the foundational conditions for delivery are met: the right supply, in the right structure, at the right cost, on robust infrastructure. The VP partners closely with Care Team Operations, HR, Finance, and Product/Analytics, and manages the team responsible for practice operations and capacity readiness for new partner launches.

Responsibilities

Supply Meets Demand

Own the balance of clinical supply to member demand, holding utilization within a healthy 90–110% band — enough capacity to serve members reliably without costly idle time. Build and run the supply–demand model, forecast demand, and adjust staffing and scheduling to keep the system in balance as volume shifts.

Care Team Services for Enrollment

Own the Care Team Services that enrollment depends on — the supply and the operational delivery — while the Enrollment leader owns enrollment performance and its metrics. This role supports that leader; it does not own the enrollment metric.

  • Enrollment supply & demand. Own supply–demand forecasting for enrollment: project onboarding-visit demand and the other care-team requirements enrollment generates, and ensure enough supply — onboarding-visit slots, staffing, and coverage — is in place to meet it, so enrollment is never constrained by a lack of care-team capacity.
  • Onboarding-visit completion. Ensure the care team reliably completes scheduled onboarding visits through staffing, scheduling, backfill, and rapid recovery of missed or failed visits.
  • On-demand sensor support. Ensure on-demand sensor support is staffed and available so members can be helped through sensor setup and issues during onboarding.
  • Human backup to agents. Ensure human coverage is in place behind automated/agentic steps, ready to step in when an agent fails or cannot complete a key enrollment step — checklist, intake call, or medication reconciliation — so no member stalls at those steps.

Licensing and Credentialing Supply. Ensure human care team members have appropriate credentialing and licensing for each pod to support pod structure enrollment numbers seamlessly.

Clinical Supply Structuring

Ensure the structure of clinical supply — not just the headcount, but the mix of roles, skills, languages, licensure, and availability — meets the attributes Care Team Operations specifies. This includes maintaining active multi-state clinical licensure and credentialing compliance. Plan and flex that structure across four demand drivers:

  • Contractual — staffing and coverage that satisfy client contract terms, licensing, credentialing, SLAs, and performance guarantees.
  • Population-based — capacity tailored to the acuity, conditions, and needs of the member populations served.
  • Client growth — capacity planned and stood up ahead of new client and contract launches so growth never outruns supply.
  • Innovation — agile capacity allocation supporting pilots, new programs, and care-model changes.

Workforce Reliability (in Partnership with HR)

Partner with HR to monitor and manage care-team absenteeism and coverage, translating workforce reliability into the capacity model so that real-world availability — not just headcount on paper — is what drives supply planning.

Practice Infrastructure

Own the operational infrastructure the care organization runs on: scheduling templates, visit types, and practice reporting. Govern how visits are defined, sized, and scheduled; maintain these as a versioned, single source of truth; and deliver operational dashboards to manage the practice by metrics. Own all licensing and credentialing support for the team to ensure we have the correct licensing and credentialing supply for providers and nursing.

Service Reliability

Keep the operation dependable at the point of care, holding the daily virtual-visit loss rate under 20% — minimizing no-shows, late cancellations, and technical or workflow failures that cost a scheduled visit — through better scheduling, automated reminders, proactive backfill, and rapid resolution.

Financial Stewardship

Own operational finance for the care organization: budget planning, cost of goods sold (COGS), and headcount approval. Deliver COGS and finance reporting, manage the operation to budget, and serve as the approval gate for care-team headcount so growth stays tied to demand and unit economics.

How Success Is Measured

  • Supply-to-demand utilization sustained at 90–110% weekly.
  • Enrollment supply forecast and staffed to demand — enough onboarding-visit capacity and other care-team coverage that enrollment is never constrained by supply.
  • Onboarding visits reliably completed by the care team, with missed or failed visits backfilled and recovered.
  • On-demand sensor support staffed and available throughout onboarding.
  • Human backup to agents in place so failed or incomplete automated steps — checklist, intake call, medication reconciliation — are caught and completed by a person.
  • Supports the Enrollment leader on enrollment performance; accountable for the care-team supply and service conditions behind it, not the enrollment metric itself.
  • Supply structure meets Care Team Operations' specified attributes across contractual, population, growth, and innovation needs.
  • Takes in monthly demand forecasts from Care Team Operations and converts that into a monthly headcount forecast, delivering "on time" supply to meet demand. (Covers provider, coach, RN, MA, MEA, L1.)
  • Daily virtual-visit loss rate held below 20%.
  • Tracks COGS and hiring plan with Finance and HR, and continuously adapts based on demand fluctuations.
  • Absenteeism monitored and factored into capacity, with coverage maintained; escalates to the Care Team Lead and HR when out of established standard for corrective actions.
  • Practice infrastructure (scheduling templates, visit types, reporting) is complete, governed, and trusted, with continuous visibility of performance metrics and detection and correction when variance falls outside expected SLAs.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in healthcare operations, including significant experience leading virtual/telehealth or multi-site clinical operations at scale.
  • Deep workforce-management and capacity-planning expertise — supply–demand modeling, forecasting, scheduling, and staffing ratios.
  • Experience forecasting demand and delivering the care-team capacity behind an onboarding or enrollment function (onboarding visits, member/sensor support, and human coverage for automated steps), ideally in virtual care, digital health, or consumer health.
  • Track record owning an operational budget/COGS and headcount planning, with fluency in unit economics.
  • Experience building and governing practice infrastructure — scheduling systems, visit-type/appointment design, and operational reporting or dashboards.
  • Strong data fluency; runs the operation by metrics and partners effectively with analytics.
  • Comfort partnering with a growth or enrollment owner — supplying the operational capacity and service coverage they need while they own the conversion metric.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership across clinical, HR, finance, and product/technology.
  • Experience scaling operations for growth (new client/contract launches) and standing up capacity for innovation and new programs.
  • Excellent people leadership; experience managing multi-layer operational teams.
  • Ability to build independently with Claude is a plus.

Preferred

  • Experience in value-based care, chronic or metabolic care, or digital health.
  • Familiarity with clinical workforce tooling and telehealth delivery platforms.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $250,000 - $270,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan

jobs.description:
About the Company:

We operate at the intersection of live events, branding, and experiential delivery, supporting some of the most recognized brands and properties in sports, entertainment, and live experiences. Our team specializes in branding and signage, custom fabrication, and event execution, delivering high-quality solutions for complex, high-profile projects.

Role Overview:

The Graphic Designer supports the development and execution of creative design projects from initial concept through production-ready artwork. The role works closely with 3D render artists, project managers, account teams, producers, and production teams to create small- and large-format branding and signage for live events, creative mockups, and sales and marketing materials.

The role also prepares, adjusts, and troubleshoots artwork for print production, ensuring files meet required technical specifications including bleeds, color profiles, image resolution, and other production standards. This position requires strong design fundamentals, technical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Duties / Responsibilities:

Graphic Design and Event Branding

  • Create and generate graphic design concepts and/or individual components as needed for events and projects, including small- and large-format branding and signage
  • Create 2D elements, designs, and textures for the design team to incorporate into 3D renderings and space layouts
  • Create high-quality designs while adhering to brand objectives and guidelines provided by clients
  • Develop original creative concepts for well-established brands when requested

Production Artwork and Prepress

  • Set up files for print production according to established processes and standards, including required print marks and bleed lines
  • Review and correct customer-provided artwork for errors related to fonts, images, resolution, color profiles, and production readiness
  • Prepare, adjust, and troubleshoot artwork to ensure files meet technical print-production specifications

Templates and Technical Design Support

  • Create templates for assets and fabricated builds that will be provided to clients for artwork development
  • Measure fabricated elements or physical assets to create accurate design templates
  • Interpret and pull dimensions from 3D programs such as SketchUp or Fusion, as well as CAD drawings

Project and Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with project managers to create custom mockups and designs based on client requests and specifications
  • Collaborate with account teams, producers, project managers, designers, and production teams to ensure high-quality and efficient product output
  • Provide creative direction and feedback to project managers, clients, and other graphic designers as appropriate
  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously with overlapping due dates in a fast-paced environment

Sales and Marketing Design Support

  • Create templates and design elements for client business proposals and marketing materials
  • Complete full proposal layouts when requested

Required Skills / Abilities:

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, and Acrobat
  • Experience with print production and large-scale environments
  • Clear understanding of scale, materials, and production constraints
  • Strong knowledge and application of graphic design principles
  • Ability to use and read a tape measure accurately
  • Excellent time-management skills and ability to work quickly under pressure to meet tight deadlines
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently on large projects as well as collaboratively within a team
  • Ability to take direction from project managers, clients, and creative services team members
  • Ability to provide creative direction and constructive feedback to project managers, clients, and other graphic designers
  • Ability to adhere to brand guidelines while also developing original creative concepts
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and cross-culturally
  • Experience with 3D design software preferred

Education and Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional graphic design experience
  • Demonstrated experience creating production-ready artwork for print and large-format applications
  • Experience supporting live events, experiential environments, signage, large-format graphics, or a related production environment preferred

jobs.excerpt: Client Success AssociateFull-time | Remote Who We ArePrepory is a premier college admissions counseling company.
jobs.description:
Client Success Associate

Full-time | Remote

Who We Are

Prepory is a premier college admissions counseling company. Our innovative, holistic approach is reshaping how students apply to college, find their fit, and earn admission to their dream schools. We've guided more than 20,000 students across 80+ countries, and we routinely help our students earn admission to the nation's most selective colleges and universities.

Through our college admissions practice, we work one-on-one with students from as early as 8th grade, helping them build an intentional extracurricular profile, craft compelling essays, and navigate every step of the application process. We hold ourselves to an excellent record of success by gearing our services to genuinely counsel the students, families, and institutions we serve.

About This Role

The Client Success Associate is the person our parents hear from most. You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.

This is a client-facing, relationship-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team.

What You'll Do

Own the family relationship

  • Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
  • Run parent check-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
  • Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
  • Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
  • Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions-oriented attitude.

Support and protect the coaching relationship

  • Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
  • Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
  • Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

Grow the relationship

  • Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
  • Own re-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
  • Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

Coach a cohort of up to 15 students

  • Conduct regular one-on-one advising sessions with your students, from profile building through final decisions.
  • Advise students through the writing process for personal statements, supplemental essays, and résumés, providing meaningful, actionable feedback.
  • Track each student's deadlines and assign tasks between sessions to keep them on pace.
  • Help students research and build a balanced college list that reflects their academic and professional interests.

What You Bring

  • Admissions knowledge you can draw on in real time. You'll be on live calls with families who ask hard, specific questions. You need to answer most of them with confidence, and recognize the rest quickly enough to say you'll follow up rather than guess.
  • Composure with any family in the room. Orientations and check-ins put you in front of every kind of parent, from the entirely hands-off to the deeply anxious.
  • Real comfort with the commercial side of the work. We are looking for someone who is excited when a conversation turns to renewals, add-on programming, or enrolling a second child, and who treats it as the natural extension of a relationship they've earned.
  • Availability to work at least one evening per week and 12 Saturdays or Sundays per year.
  • Impeccable listening, speaking, writing, and grammar skills, along with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment, including peak season, when orientations, check-ins, and application deadlines all land at once.

Qualifications of Our Ideal Candidate

  • Graduated from a selective or highly-selective college or university (top-50 national university or top-20 liberal arts college preferred).
  • Three or more years of experience in college admissions, admissions consulting, or a closely related field. Experience inside an admissions office is a strong plus.
  • Detailed, current knowledge of the U.S. college admissions process, and a willingness to stay current as it changes.
  • Experience in customer success, client engagement, account management, or consultative sales.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or developing other people, formally or informally.
  • Extremely detail- and goal-oriented, with the ability to work independently in a high-velocity, unstructured environment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Starting annual base salary: $58,679.51
  • This role is commission-eligible. Earning 4% commission on new enrollments, re-enrollments, and add-on programming.
  • Unlimited paid time off.
  • 11 paid holidays: Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve, and New Year's Day
  • Prepory pays $285.22 per month towards your company PPO health insurance plan.
  • Prepory pays 100% towards our company dental, vision, and life insurance plans.
  • Performance-based holiday bonuses each year.
  • Two employee annual retreats with opportunities to travel to various locations and participate in team building activities.

jobs.excerpt: Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues.
jobs.description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.

Stand Together is building an internal Agile practice to sustain meaningful delivery improvements made over the last year. As a Scrum Master embedded across multiple teams, you will be the person those teams rely on to run great ceremonies, maintain a healthy backlog, and create the trust and psychological safety that makes honest retrospectives and real improvement possible.

You will support multiple teams at different stages of Agile maturity, so you must be comfortable adapting your approach while striving to execute to a consistent standard. You will report to the Agile Practice Lead, who establishes the standards and frameworks you operate within. You will work closely with Product and Engineering Leads on each of your teams.

How You Will Contribute

    • Facilitate Agile ceremonies: standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and reviews with preparation, clear time-boxing, and a consistent bias toward outcomes over process.

    • Build the trust and psychological safety that makes retrospectives honest and improvement actions credible.

    • Shift sprint planning from in-meeting discovery to in-meeting alignment by doing the administrative and readiness work, including ticket review, agenda setting, and Jira cleanup.

    • Maintain backlog health: ensure work is properly categorized, sized, structured, and ready for commitment before it enters a sprint.

    • Apply and reinforce standardized ticket structures: consistent issue types, field usage, user story and acceptance criteria formats, spike success criteria, bug reproduction steps.

    • Track, analyze, and communicate sprint metrics including velocity, rollover trends, and estimated versus actual effort; surface patterns that improve planning accuracy over time.

    • Facilitate root-cause analysis of blockers and rollover; ensure carryover discussions result in specific, corrective actions.

    • Identify and actively pursue impediments that cross team boundaries, escalating to the Agile Practice Lead when resolution requires broader organizational action.

    • Contribute to overall delivery standards by sharing what is working, flagging what is not, and helping build the playbooks and templates that benefit all teams.

What You Will Bring

    • Prior experience as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery lead supporting cross-functional product or technology teams.

    • The interpersonal skills to build trust quickly on teams that may be skeptical, fatigued, or in conflict. You know that facilitation is only as effective as the relationships beneath it.

    • Strong Jira skills: backlog management, workflow configuration, automation, dashboard and reporting development, and the discipline to keep data clean and meaningful.

    • Comfort operating across multiple teams simultaneously, including managing schedule complexity and adapting your approach to teams at different maturity levels.

    • A diagnostic mindset: you notice patterns, ask good questions, and distinguish between a team problem, a process problem, and an organizational problem before deciding how to respond.

    • Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect.

Standout Candidates Will Bring

    • Experience standing up or scaling Agile practices in maturing organizations.

    • Experience supporting technology, data, or platform teams where delivery involves significant cross-team dependencies and technical complexity.

    • Demonstrated ability to create durable templates, guides, and operating standards.

    • Experience working within a structured Agile practice under a practice lead or within a center of excellence, where craft standards are set at a level above the individual team.

What We Offer

    • Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace.
    • A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,300 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges.
    • Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents.
    • Competitive compensation: Our approach rewards the value you create through competitive salaries and bonus opportunities, allowing you to share in the success you help drive.
Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.
