Customer Success Manager – HVAC & Plumbing | Inbound Sales & Scheduling | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager with hands-on HVAC and/or plumbing industry experience to manage inbound customer calls, convert service inquiries into booked appointments, coordinate scheduling, and deliver an excellent customer experience.

This is not a passive customer support role. Your performance will directly impact appointment bookings, revenue, membership sales, and customer retention.

As the first point of contact for customers needing HVAC or plumbing services, you’ll quickly understand their needs, communicate appropriate options, create confidence and urgency when necessary, and get the right service scheduled.

If you understand the home services industry and know how to turn inbound calls into booked appointments without sacrificing customer experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Calls & Appointment Booking

  • Handle high-volume inbound HVAC and plumbing service calls
  • Convert customer inquiries into confirmed service appointments
  • Assist customers with:
    • Emergency service requests
    • Repairs and maintenance
    • Scheduling inquiries
    • General service questions
  • Ask effective questions to understand customer needs and service urgency
  • Build appropriate urgency and confidence to maximize booking rates
  • Guide customers toward clear next steps
  • Maintain a professional, helpful, and solutions-focused experience on every call

Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

  • Schedule service appointments accurately based on customer needs and technician availability
  • Coordinate with dispatch and field teams to maintain an efficient schedule
  • Categorize service requests correctly
  • Capture complete customer, property, and appointment information
  • Follow scheduling and dispatch procedures consistently
  • Help minimize scheduling conflicts and missed opportunities
  • Communicate schedule-related updates clearly to customers and internal teams

Membership Sales & Upselling

  • Introduce HVAC and plumbing maintenance memberships when appropriate
  • Recommend relevant additional services based on customer needs
  • Clearly explain membership features and benefits
  • Handle common sales objections professionally
  • Identify opportunities to increase customer value without being overly aggressive
  • Contribute toward membership, booking, and conversion targets

Customer Experience & Retention

  • Provide empathetic, solutions-focused customer service
  • Handle frustrated or concerned customers calmly and professionally
  • Ensure customers feel heard, informed, and supported
  • Resolve routine concerns while escalating more complex issues appropriately
  • Follow up on open customer requests when necessary
  • Help create an experience that encourages repeat business and long-term loyalty
  • Take ownership of customer interactions through resolution

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of:
    • Customer information
    • Service requests
    • Appointment details
    • Call notes
    • Follow-up requirements
  • Keep CRM and scheduling records complete and current
  • Follow established call scripts, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Ensure accurate information is available to dispatch, technicians, and operations teams

Requirements

  • Previous HVAC and/or plumbing customer service experience is required
  • Proven experience converting inbound calls into booked service appointments
  • Strong phone communication and active listening skills
  • Experience with CRM, scheduling, dispatch, or customer service systems
  • Strong appointment scheduling and coordination skills
  • Experience with upselling or membership/service-plan sales
  • Confident objection-handling ability
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable handling high-volume inbound customer interactions
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to work reliably during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience working directly with a U.S.-based HVAC or plumbing company
  • Experience in broader home services environments
  • Familiarity with HVAC maintenance plans or service memberships
  • Experience coordinating with technicians and dispatch teams
  • Experience working in a KPI-driven call center or customer service environment
  • Experience tracking booking, conversion, and membership sales performance

Tools & Technology

CRM Systems | Scheduling Platforms | Dispatch Systems | Customer Service Software | VOIP/Phone Systems | Digital Communication Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Understand how HVAC and plumbing service calls work
  • Are comfortable handling a high volume of inbound calls
  • Can confidently guide customers toward booking
  • Are persuasive without sounding scripted or pushy
  • Stay calm when customers have urgent service problems
  • Balance excellent customer service with sales and conversion goals
  • Are comfortable introducing memberships and additional services
  • Work quickly while maintaining accurate records
  • Follow up consistently and take ownership through resolution
  • Understand that every customer interaction can impact both retention and revenue

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing open customer requests, scheduled appointments, and any follow-ups requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll answer inbound HVAC and plumbing calls, identify customer needs and urgency, convert inquiries into booked appointments, and coordinate technician availability with dispatch.

You’ll also introduce maintenance memberships and relevant services, handle customer objections or concerns, update CRM records, and coordinate with operations teams to keep service requests moving.

You may finish by reviewing outstanding requests and monitoring booking and conversion performance.

In short: you turn inbound service inquiries into booked appointments, satisfied customers, and recurring revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Call-to-booking conversion rate
  • Total appointments booked
  • Membership sales and close rate
  • Customer satisfaction and call quality
  • Scheduling accuracy and efficiency
  • CRM documentation accuracy
  • Response and call-handling times
  • Customer retention and repeat-service opportunities
  • Follow-up completion rates

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on both customer experience and company revenue
  • High-ownership role with clear, measurable performance goals
  • Opportunity to combine customer service, inbound sales, scheduling, and home services operations
  • Stable full-time remote position
  • Exposure to fast-paced U.S. HVAC and plumbing operations
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Customer Service Team Lead
    • Senior Customer Success Manager
    • Dispatch / Scheduling Lead
    • Home Services Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have HVAC or plumbing customer service experience, know how to convert inbound calls into appointments, and enjoy balancing customer care with sales performance, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take direct ownership of bookings, membership sales, customer experience, and revenue performance within a fast-paced U.S. home services environment.

The role requires deep expertise in model compression, quantization, and hardware-aware optimization, along with strong systems engineering skills to ship reliable AI capabilities outside the data center. jobs.description:
Job Description: Chief Controls Officer (CCO – Controls)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Job Summary

The Chief Controls Officer (CCO – Controls) is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the organization's internal control framework to ensure effective risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, and operational integrity. This role ensures that controls across financial, operational, and compliance processes are robust, consistent, and aligned with organizational risk appetite.

The CCO (Controls) plays a critical role in strengthening governance, preventing control failures, and enhancing transparency across all business functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Controls Framework

Develop and maintain enterprise-wide internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO)

Ensure controls are effectively designed, documented, and implemented

Standardize control practices across business units

Continuously improve control effectiveness and maturity

2. Control Monitoring & Testing

Oversee control testing, monitoring, and validation processes

Implement continuous control monitoring systems

Identify control gaps and weaknesses

Ensure timely remediation of control deficiencies

3. Risk & Compliance Integration

Align internal controls with enterprise risk management (ERM) frameworks

Collaborate with risk, compliance, and audit teams

Ensure controls support regulatory compliance requirements

Monitor emerging risks and adapt control frameworks accordingly

4. Financial & Operational Controls

Oversee financial controls, including reporting, reconciliation, and revenue controls

Ensure operational controls across processes, systems, and workflows

Strengthen fraud prevention and detection mechanisms

Ensure consistency in control execution

5. Governance & Policy Management

Develop and maintain control-related policies and procedures

Ensure documentation, audit trails, and governance standards are maintained

Support governance committees and reporting requirements

Enhance transparency and accountability

6. Technology & Controls Automation

Leverage technology and automation to enhance control effectiveness

Implement control tools, dashboards, and monitoring systems

Collaborate with IT on system controls and cybersecurity frameworks

Drive digital transformation in control environments

7. Stakeholder Engagement

Provide control insights and reporting to executive leadership and Board

Collaborate with regulators, auditors, and external stakeholders

Support internal and external audits

Promote awareness of control responsibilities across the organization

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop internal controls and governance teams

Establish performance standards and accountability

Foster a culture of control awareness and discipline

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in internal controls, audit, risk, or compliance roles

Proven experience in senior leadership roles (e.g., Chief Controls Officer, Head of Internal Controls)

Strong background in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO)

Strong understanding of risk management and regulatory compliance

Expertise in financial and operational controls

Analytical and problem-solving skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High attention to detail and governance mindset

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Effectiveness of internal control framework

Number and severity of control deficiencies

Timeliness of remediation actions

Compliance with regulatory and audit requirements

Reduction in control failures and operational risks

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Exposure to IT controls, cybersecurity, and automation tools

Strong collaboration with risk, compliance, and audit functions

Ability to lead enterprise-wide control transformation initiatives

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

jobs.title: Director of Engineering- Integrated Sensor Team
jobs.excerpt: GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence.
jobs.description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM

The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.

Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.

ABOUT THE JOB

As Director of Engineering for GenLogs’ Integrated Sensor team, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling the hardware and software systems at the heart of our sensing network.

This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and cloud/software platforms. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.

You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Lead & Develop the Engineering Organization

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and software engineering.
  • Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
  • Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
  • Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
  • Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.

Set Technical Direction

  • Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the Integrated Sensor product line across hardware, edge, and cloud systems.
  • Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
  • Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
  • Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
  • Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.

Drive Product Delivery

  • Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
  • Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
  • Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
  • Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
  • Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.

Build Reliable, Scalable Systems

  • Ensure the Integrated Sensor platform is designed for reliability in demanding, real-world field environments.
  • Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
  • Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
  • Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
  • Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
  • Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.

Collaborate Across the Company

  • Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for the Integrated Sensor product line.
  • Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
  • Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
  • Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
  • 5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
  • Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
  • Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
  • Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering talent.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • High effectiveness and communication working in a remote and distributed team.
  • English proficiency is required.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • You are a builder and a leader. You enjoy developing people and organizations while remaining technically engaged enough to understand complex systems and make sound technical decisions.
  • You think across the entire system. You can connect hardware, embedded software, edge systems, cloud infrastructure, and data into a cohesive product architecture.
  • You prioritize impact. You understand that engineering exists to solve meaningful customer and business problems, and you focus teams on delivering measurable outcomes.
  • You operate with urgency and ownership. You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, removing obstacles, and driving issues to resolution.
  • You raise the bar. You establish clear standards for engineering quality, reliability, execution, and accountability—and consistently hold yourself and your team to them.
  • You develop people. You invest in coaching, feedback, career development, and creating opportunities for engineers to take on greater responsibility.
  • You balance speed with durability. You know when to move quickly, when to invest in foundational work, and how to make pragmatic technical tradeoffs without accumulating unnecessary complexity.
  • You thrive in complexity. You are energized by systems that operate in the real world and understand that building reliable technology often requires solving problems across organizational and technical boundaries.
  • You communicate clearly. You can translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs for engineers, product leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
  • You value transparency and collaboration. You actively seek input, give direct feedback, and build trust through clear communication and accountability.
  • You are curious and adaptable. You continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and look for better ways to build both technology and teams.
  • You are comfortable in a remote environment. You create clarity, alignment, and accountability across distributed teams without relying on proximity.

WHY GENLOGS

At GenLogs, you have the opportunity to build technology that operates at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. Our Integrated Sensor platform is foundational to our vision of creating ubiquitous visibility into the movement of commercial vehicles across the United States.

You will have a direct impact on the technology, people, and systems required to scale that network—and the opportunity to build an engineering organization capable of supporting one of the most ambitious sensing and intelligence platforms in freight.

会社概要

2021年にMITとStanford大学院の卒業生が創業し、現在6年目を迎えています。創業以来黒字経営を続けており、2025年初頭までは完全自己資金で口コミを中心に成長してきました。現在は日本の5大法律事務所すべてを含む、国内外800社以上にご利用いただいており、韓国・シンガポール・米国・英国にも展開しています。

チームの約6割はソフトウェアエンジニアで、Microsoft、IBM、Yahoo!、NTT研究所などの出身者が在籍しています。

詳細はこちら: BoostDraft Company Deck

このポジションについて

BoostDraftは、大手企業や法律事務所のWord環境で動作するデスクトップアプリケーションです。導入先はセキュリティ要件の厳しいエンタープライズ環境が中心となり、プロキシ、セキュリティソフト、仮想環境（RDSH等）、社内ポリシーなど、お客様ごとに異なるIT環境でソフトウェアを確実に動かすことが、事業の生命線になっています。

このポジションは、その最前線に立つお客様の一次窓口です。導入時・利用時に発生する技術的なお問い合わせを受け止め、環境情報を聞き取り、原因の切り分けを行った上で、解決までをリードしていただきます。多くの案件はマニュアルとこれまでの対応履歴をもとにご自身で完結いただき、判断が難しい案件は開発チーム・ビジネスチームに相談しながら進めていただくことを想定しています。

扱うお問い合わせの例

  • インストールは完了したものの、Word上でBoostDraftのタブが表示されない
  • 社内のプロキシやセキュリティソフトの影響で、通信がうまくいかない
  • 仮想デスクトップ環境で利用したいが、どのように導入すればよいか分からない
  • 導入にあたり、セキュリティチェックシートへの回答がほしい

想定業務

  • 顧客環境での導入・動作トラブルの原因切り分けと解決（インストールエラー、アドイン不具合、プロキシ・ネットワーク起因の問題など）
  • お客様（法務部門・情報システム部門）との直接のコミュニケーション（メール中心、必要に応じてオンラインミーティングや訪問）
  • 開発チームとの連携（ログの収集・一次分析、再現条件の整理、調査依頼、修正版の顧客展開）
  • セキュリティチェックシートへの対応

Job Position: Blockchain Site Reliability Engineer

Location: Dallas, TX, USA (Remote Acceptable)

Company:
Contact:

About Company

InfStones is an advanced, enterprise-grade Platform as a Service (PaaS) blockchain infrastructure provider trusted by the top blockchain companies in the world. InfStones’ AI-based infrastructure provides developers worldwide with a rugged, powerful node management platform alongside an easy-to-use API. With over 20,000 nodes supported on over 80 blockchains, InfStones gives developers all the control they need - reliability, speed, efficiency, security, and scalability - for cross-chain DeFi, NFT, GameFi, and decentralized application development. InfStones is trusted by the biggest blockchain companies in the world including Binance, CoinList, BitGo, OKX, Chainlink, Polygon, Harmony, and KuCoin, among a hundred other customers. InfStones is dedicated to developing the next evolution of a better world through limitless Web3 innovation.
To date, InfStones has raised over $110 million in capital and is backed by Softbank, GGV Capital, Susquehanna International Group (SIG), Dragonfly Capital, Qiming Venture Partners, Plug and Play, and many renowned institutional investors.
If you enjoy being on the cutting edge of technology, we encourage you to apply!

Job Description

As a Blockchain Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of blockchain nodes and related infrastructure. You’ll monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents in production environments, while also building automation tools to improve efficiency and reduce operational risks.
This role requires strong Linux system expertise, solid on-call and incident response experience, and the ability to work under pressure to quickly restore services. You’ll also collaborate with protocol engineers and open-source communities to ensure smooth upgrades and long-term system stability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Deploy, monitor, and maintain blockchain nodes across multiple networks.
2. Ensure system reliability and uptime by actively managing incidents, troubleshooting, and resolving node failures.
3. Develop automation and maintenance tools (using Golang, Shell, Python, etc.) to streamline operations.
4. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to proactively detect and address issues.
5. Collaborate with engineering teams and solution architects on reliability improvements and incident prevention.
6. Participate in the on-call rotation to provide timely incident response and resolution.

Qualifications

1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
2. Strong Linux system administration skills (networking, performance tuning, debugging, security).
3. Expertise with at least one mainstream programming language such as Golang, Python, Javascript, Rust, etc., and have good programming skills and programming habits.
4. Experience with monitoring/alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).
5. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond quickly under pressure.
6. Solid technical documentation skills.

Prefers (Nice to have)

1. Hands-on experience with blockchain node deployment, maintenance, and upgrades.
2. Familiarity with mainstream blockchain protocols (e.g., Ethereum, Cosmos, Polkadot, Solana).
3. Experience with containerization/orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
4. Knowledge of smart contracts, Web3 RPC, or Solidity is a plus.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you’ll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area., with working hours in the Central or Eastern time zone. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

$165,200—$265,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Belonging at Samsara

jobs.excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTION The Scholars Strategy Network (SSN) is hiring a paid part-time Policy Intern (or Fellow if the applicant is a graduate student).
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

The Scholars Strategy Network (SSN) is hiring a paid part-time Policy Intern (or Fellow if the applicant is a graduate student). SSN is a nonpartisan, nonprofit organization that connects journalists, policymakers, and civic leaders to the 2,000+ university-based scholars who form a part of the SSN network. SSN also supports the work of 40 state-based chapters led by volunteer members. The Policy Intern, who reports to Sunnie Hodge, will be responsible for supporting the team’s everyday work of helping a broad array of scholars convey their research to policymakers and the public in ways that can improve policy and strengthen democracy.

The Policy Intern is a flexible part-time position with an hourly wage between $16-$18 per hour, commensurate with experience. The position requires a commitment of 10-20 hours per week. The position will end in December 2026 unless it is extended by mutual agreement. This is a fully remote position with the option to work in person in SSN’s Boston office.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a large organization with a small staff, SSN has a Policy team that supports our members and chapters across the country to influence public policy. Among other tasks, the Policy Intern will:

  • Assist with Policy Actor Outreach: The Intern will support the policy team to connect scholars and their research to local, state, and federal policymakers, civic organizations, and other policy actors to share SSN member research and help facilitate relationships. This will include helping policy team staff identify relevant policy actors, make initial outreach to those policy actors, assemble documents, prepare for meetings, and sit in on and document meetings between policy actors, staff, and scholars.
  • Edit and translate: The Intern will help scholars translate their academic writing into accessible language that is intelligible to broad public audiences and effectively communicative to policy actors. This translation process includes editing policy writing for content and style and advising on framing and messaging.
  • Track Policy Debates: The Intern will help the policy team track federal, state, and local legislation, regulations, and policy debates in several policy areas, including: education, health, voting and elections, taxes, and work-family policies. This will include research on federal, state, and local policy, processes, and ecosystems for both short- and long-term projects.
  • Mobilize Members. As policy opportunities arise, the Intern will help staff identify, reach out to, and support individuals or groups of SSN members to engage with that opportunity. Support for members includes: researching and sharing information on how to submit public comments or written testimony, help with editing and formatting written policy documents, and helping scholars practice oral testimony.
  • Manage Policy Project Data: The Intern will support Policy team members to use and maintain data in Salesforce and Asana to serve team and organizational goals.

OPPORTUNITIES FOR LEARNING

Applicants with an interest in organizing and research dissemination are strongly encouraged to apply. Interns will have the option to attend trainings for members on topics including how to write a policy brief and engage with your state legislature. Interns will also receive training on Salesforce, which will be an integral part of the role. Interns will be offered opportunities to meet with SSN staff, and potentially SSN members, to learn more about their roles.

QUALIFICATIONS

The successful candidate will be a self-starter with a deep interest in making research matter and improving public policy. Applicants with the below qualifications will be considered:

  • An advanced undergraduate or a graduate student
  • Familiar with, and eager to learn more about legislative and other policymaking processes
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Apps
  • Familiar with Salesforce and Asana or comfortable with and quickly able to learn new database and task management systems
  • An excellent writer and proofreader
  • Able to work on tasks independently in a remote work environment and communicate progress to team members
  • Committed to SSN’s mission, interested in evidence-based policy, and eager to learn more about when and how research is used in policymaking

SSN is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, class, color, disability, ethnicity, faith, gender, national origin, race, sexual orientation, or gender identity. People of color, people with disabilities, LGBTQ individuals, and women are strongly encouraged to apply. Candidates considering a career transition or whose skills and experience fulfill some, but not all of the qualifications above are encouraged to apply

Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care

  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Benefits

Time Zone & Schedule:

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture

Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
Philippians 4:6

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

The Case Coordinator I, EMS is responsible to support aspects of the Expert Medical Services (EMS) provided to TDOC members to ensure

quality and timely case completion. The coordinator supports the care team nurse and provider on a case. The Coordinator researches and

verifies physician referral information and is be a resource to the member and the members’ family for case updates.

  • documented processes.

Graphic Designer & Landing Page Developer (Conversion-Focused) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST Preferred)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Graphic Designer & Landing Page Developer to create high-performing marketing creatives and conversion-focused landing pages that drive measurable business results.

This is more than a traditional design role. You’ll own both the creative and technical execution of marketing campaigns by designing digital assets, building responsive landing pages, and continuously optimizing user experiences to improve lead generation and conversion rates.

If you enjoy combining creativity with performance marketing, understand user behavior, and can independently launch polished landing pages, this role is an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

Creative Design

  • Design high-converting marketing assets, including:
    • Paid ad creatives
    • Social media graphics
    • Display banners
    • Email graphics
    • Promotional visuals
  • Maintain brand consistency across all campaigns.
  • Translate campaign messaging into compelling, performance-focused creative.
  • Support marketing initiatives with engaging visual content.

Landing Page Design & Development

  • Design modern, responsive landing pages.
  • Build and launch pages using:
    • Webflow
    • Framer
    • Similar no-code/low-code platforms
  • Optimize pages for:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Independently manage projects from design through production.

UX/UI & Conversion Optimization

  • Improve layouts, user flows, and page structure to increase conversions.
  • Apply UX/UI best practices across:
    • Landing pages
    • Forms
    • Calls-to-action
    • Visual hierarchy
  • Support A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives.
  • Continuously improve pages based on user behavior and campaign performance.

Collaboration & Campaign Support

  • Partner closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Copywriters
    • Leadership
    • Campaign stakeholders
  • Execute creative requests while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Update and optimize existing landing pages and marketing assets.

What Success Looks Like

  • Landing pages launch quickly and accurately.
  • Marketing creatives improve engagement and campaign performance.
  • Pages are responsive, polished, and optimized for conversions.
  • Brand consistency is maintained across all deliverables.
  • Design work directly contributes to higher conversion rates and lead generation.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand how design influences user behavior and conversions.
  • You can independently design, build, and launch landing pages.
  • You think in terms of:
    • User journeys
    • Funnels
    • Engagement
    • Performance
  • You balance creativity with speed and execution.
  • You have exceptional attention to detail and design consistency.
  • You thrive in fast-paced marketing environments.

Required Experience & Skills

Design & Creative

  • Proficiency with one or more of:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • Landing pages
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • Digital marketing assets
    • Conversion-focused design
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX/UI principles
    • Responsive design
    • Visual hierarchy
    • User behavior

Landing Page Development

  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Webflow
    • Framer
    • Similar landing page builders
  • Ability to independently:
    • Design
    • Build
    • Launch
    • Optimize landing pages
  • Experience creating responsive, high-performing pages.

Execution & Collaboration

  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects independently.
  • Comfortable working remotely in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in:
    • Performance marketing
    • Growth marketing
    • Paid media environments
  • Knowledge of:
    • A/B testing
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
    • SEO best practices
  • Basic front-end skills:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • React
    • Next.js
  • Familiarity with:
    • Git/GitHub
    • Advanced prototyping
    • Motion graphics or animation

Tools & Platforms

  • Figma
  • Adobe XD
  • Sketch
  • Webflow
  • Framer
  • Canva
  • HTML/CSS
  • GitHub
  • Google Workspace

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Design marketing creatives for paid campaigns.
  • Build and launch responsive landing pages.
  • Optimize layouts and conversion flows.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams on campaign execution.
  • Update and improve existing landing pages.
  • Test usability across multiple devices.
  • Manage multiple creative and development projects simultaneously.

In short: You create visually compelling marketing assets and high-converting landing pages that directly improve campaign performance, lead generation, and user experience.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Landing page conversion rates.
  • Speed and accuracy of landing page launches.
  • Quality and consistency of creative assets.
  • Campaign performance improvements driven by design.
  • Efficient management of multiple projects.
  • Mobile responsiveness and user experience quality.

Why Join Us?

  • Own both design and landing page development.
  • Directly impact marketing performance and lead generation.
  • Work on:
    • Landing pages
    • Performance marketing campaigns
    • Conversion optimization
    • Digital brand experiences
  • Blend creative design with technical execution.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Designer
    • CRO Designer
    • Growth Designer
    • Creative Lead
    • Webflow/Framer Specialist

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about creating high-converting landing pages, designing marketing assets that drive measurable results, and combining creativity with performance marketing, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build digital experiences that increase engagement, conversions, and business growth.

jobs.description:
If you're energized by shaping the stories customers experience on ServiceNow's biggest stages, thrive in highly matrixed environments, and know how to balance strategy, storytelling, and operational excellence, this role was built for you.

Role Overview

Own content planning and delivery for ServiceNow's flagship events, including the AI Summit series and Knowledge. This role is accountable for whether the content is right: aligned to the current platform narrative, appropriate to the audience, and consistent across regions and formats. It owns the content standard across these moments, ensuring sessions connect to the broader platform story and deliver a cohesive experience regardless of region, audience, or format. Subject matter expertise sits with Product and Solutions Marketing content leads; this role ensures the sum of their work reads as one program. It also leads high-visibility special projects that shape how the team operates.

This role sits within Product and Solutions Marketing and partners closely with Strategic Events, Field Marketing, Brand, Communications, and other cross-functional teams in a highly matrixed environment. Success requires influencing stakeholders, driving alignment, and maintaining quality standards without direct authority.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Flagship Programs.

Why This Role Matters

ServiceNow's flagship events are where strategy becomes reality. They are the moments when customers, prospects, partners, analysts, and employees experience the power of the platform firsthand.

This role serves as the steward of that experience, ensuring content across Knowledge, AI Summits, and future flagship programs tells one connected story. By bringing together narrative strategy, content governance, and operational rigor, this role directly influences how the market understands ServiceNow's platform, innovations, and vision at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Event Content Strategy & Portfolio Management (25%)

  • Own the end-to-end content strategy and portfolio for AI Summits, Knowledge, and flagship event experiences, ensuring content priorities support business objectives, audience needs, and event outcomes.

  • Manage the governed Product and Solutions event content catalog, including versioning, refresh cycles, approvals, and distribution for field marketing and regional stakeholders.

  • Partner with regional stakeholders to ensure content meets local market needs without fragmenting the global story.

  • Drive speaker planning, identification, enablement, and content readiness activities in partnership with Product & Solutions Marketing, event teams, and executive stakeholders.

  • Maintain a consolidated view of content readiness and proactively surface risks before they impact delivery.

  • Maintain a holistic view of flagship event content across products, solutions, industries, and executive priorities to ensure a balanced, connected customer experience. 

  • Connect event content planning to broader product launches, marketing campaigns, and corporate narrative priorities, ensuring flagship programs reinforce ServiceNow's strategic business objectives.

  • Advocate for audience relevance and customer value, ensuring content experiences are tailored to target audiences while maintaining narrative consistency.

Narrative Stewardship & Content Governance (25%)

  • Identify content gaps, overlap, and fragmentation across portfolios and recommend solutions that improve audience understanding and business impact.

  • Establish content governance standards and decision frameworks that balance stakeholder needs with narrative consistency, quality standards, and audience relevance.

  • Partner with senior Product and Solutions Marketing leaders, executives, and content stakeholders to align event content priorities with strategic business objectives and executive communications needs.

Expo & Experiential Content (20%)

  • Own strategy, messaging, and content delivery for expo demos, demo headers, signage, and story pods (not demo development, technical implementation, or vendor management).

  • Partner with product and solution leads and expo program owners to ensure consistent storytelling across experiences and zones.

Program Insights, Communication, and Continuous Improvement (15%)

  • Run retrospectives, surveys, and feedback programs across major events and translate findings into actionable improvements.

  • Develop frameworks, dashboards, reporting, and planning tools that improve decision-making and program execution.

  • Establish operating rhythms, decision frameworks, status reporting, and governance mechanisms that reduce fragmentation and rework.

  • Produce executive-ready updates, recommendations, and decision-support materials.

  • Leverage AI to accelerate content planning, readiness reviews, audience analysis, executive reporting, and post-event insights. 

  • Identify opportunities to modernize content operations through AI-enabled workflows, automation, and scalable governance frameworks that reduce manual effort and improve content quality.

Special Projects (15%)

  • Lead high-visibility, cross-functional initiatives assigned by the Sr. Director, including governance programs, new event formats, executive deliverables, and operational improvements.

  • Create structure, alignment, and momentum working with ambiguity and under compressed timelines.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

  • Editorial judgment. Evaluates content against audience, narrative, and business priorities, not just completion status. Can provide constructive feedback and influence content quality across stakeholders.

  • Content governance mindset. Balances stakeholder needs with the responsibility to maintain narrative consistency, quality standards, and audience relevance.

  • AI proficiency. Uses AI tools to accelerate planning, analysis, content development, and operational execution.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. Creates clarity, structure, and progress where there are unknowns.

  • Raises the bar. Continuously improves programs, processes, and outputs rather than simply managing them.

  • Influence without authority. Builds trust, alignment, and drives positive outcomes across senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment.

  • Systems Thinking. Connects content, programs, stakeholders, and business priorities into a cohesive experience. Anticipates downstream impacts and identifies opportunities to improve consistency, scale, and effectiveness across flagship programs.

  • Builder Mentality. Creates scalable frameworks that reduce chaos and increase quality. Enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity and establishing repeatable ways of working that improve with every event.

jobs.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

We are building the agentic platform that powers Caseware's next generation of audit and accounting products, and applied science is how we measure and improve quality across our agents. This is a role for someone who thinks in experiments, has built evaluations for LLM-based systems, and wants to build the tools that other teams and our customers rely on to ship their own agents.

You will design and run experiments that turn ambiguous quality questions into measurable results, and own the evaluation methodology that internal teams and customers depend on. You will build the AI-based capabilities behind our end-to-end agent builder, including the synthetic data generation and eval builders that let teams and customers create, evaluate, and deploy their own agents. You will also work on something genuinely novel: self-learning, self-improving systems that get better both offline and online. A significant part of that is agentic memory: deciding what is worth remembering and validating the criteria that let agents compound useful knowledge on behalf of customers over time, while rigorously upholding the legal and contractual obligations owed to them and their clients. At the staff level, you will also influence technical direction and mentor others.

Location: This is a fully remote position located in Colombia.

The domain: financial audit

This role sits squarely in the financial audit domain, and that domain matters more than most people realize. Independent audit is one of the quiet foundations of the global economy. When investors, lenders, regulators, and the public can trust that a company's financial statements are accurate, capital can flow, markets can function, and organizations can be held accountable. That trust rests on the quality of audit and assurance work, which makes the tools that audit professionals use genuinely consequential.

You do not need prior knowledge of accounting or auditing to succeed here. What you will gain is deep, durable expertise in how audits are performed and where AI can make them faster, more reliable, and more insightful. You will learn the domain on the job alongside experienced domain experts, and that fluency will make you a stronger applied scientist. If you already bring that background, even better.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design and run experiments that measure and improve the quality of LLM-based applications and agents, turning ambiguous quality questions into measurable, reproducible results.
  • Build out and own the evaluation methodology in practice that internal teams and customers depend on: benchmarks, regression suites, scoring methods, acceptance thresholds across task success, faithfulness, safety, latency, and cost, and the scientific foundations for comparing offline and online performance, partnering with platform engineering on the automated infrastructure that runs those comparisons and alerts on drift or regression, and wiring the signals into release gates.
  • Build AI-based tools and capabilities that power the end-to-end agent builder developer experience used by other Caseware teams and by our customers.
  • Build the synthetic data generation and eval-builder capabilities that let internal teams and customers create, evaluate, and deploy their own agents.
  • Turn domain procedures into task-plus-verifier structures, drawing on deep intuition for how LLM-based systems fail.
  • Contribute to applied science on agentic memory: use statistical methods grounded in audit domain knowledge to surface which experiences are worth remembering, and define and validate the promotion and demotion criteria that let agents compound that knowledge over time, partnering with platform engineering on the infrastructure that executes it.
  • Advance self-learning, self-improving systems that get better both offline and online as they are used.
  • Help ensure memory promotion and demotion criteria uphold the legal and contractual obligations owed to customers and their clients, partnering with Security, Legal, and Domain SMEs.
  • Design experiments and evaluations that demonstrate agent quality improves the more customers use the platform.
  • Translate advances in GenAI (models, retrieval, agent frameworks, evaluation techniques) into practical, maintainable capabilities.
  • At the staff level, influence technical direction through RFCs and design reviews, and mentor other scientists and engineers.

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years (senior) to 8+ years (staff) of professional experience in applied science, machine learning, research, or data-intensive engineering. Staff-level candidates bring demonstrated impact beyond a single team.
  • 2+ years working on production GenAI or LLM-based systems (applications, agents, or the tooling and evaluation around them).
  • Proven experience designing and building evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM systems: metrics, benchmarks, scoring approaches, and rigorous experiment design.
  • A strong experimentation mindset. You form clear hypotheses, design sound experiments, and draw defensible conclusions from noisy, real-world data.
  • Ability to build and operate your own production tooling and services, ideally on AWS.
  • Strong understanding of GenAI system tradeoffs including quality, latency, cost, reliability, and safety.
  • A strong foundation in probability and statistics: experimental design, significance testing, and reasoning under uncertainty.
  • Strong English language communication and collaboration skills.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

Nice to have

  • PhD or MS in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or similar) preferred, though equivalent industry experience is welcome.
  • Prior machine learning experience (classical ML, model training, or MLOps).
  • Experience with AI guardrails, governance, or safety mechanisms.
  • Experience with distributed, SaaS, cloud-native, multi-tenant platforms at scale.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform).
  • Experience operating in regulated or compliance-heavy domains.
  • Familiarity with financial audit, accounting, or assurance workflows.

Tech stack you'll be working with

  • Backend & Platform: TypeScript, NestJS, Python
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS EKS, AWS Lambda, AWS Bedrock, AWS AgentCore
  • Search & Retrieval: AWS OpenSearch and S3 Vectors
  • Document & Data Processing: AWS Textract, DynamoDB, S3
  • AI Evaluation & Observability: LangFuse, LangSmith, LangChain, LangGraph
  • AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin
  • Developer Tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Nx Monorepo

Perks & Benefits

What's in it for you:
Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions. We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team. Work-life balance is important to us. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Position Summary

The Director of Strategic Pricing & Contracting Analytics is responsible for developing and leading the analytic, financial, and operational capabilities that support pricing and contracting decision-making across the organization.
