jobs.excerpt: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars.
jobs.description:
Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

This position is the ideal role for experienced talents in tech/services sales. With a self-driven resilient mindset, positive energy, and strong business acumen, you'll thrive in a fast paced environment. You will negotiate multi-year enterprise contracts, drive revenue and usage growth across our largest Fortune 500 accounts, and shape the long-term success of our most valued partnerships. Our top-performing Account Directors typically progress to sales leadership roles.

The Account Director role is key in our sales team and reports directly to the VP of Account Management. Following our Onomi launch, life sciences expansion pipeline is the #1 company objective, and driving revenue growth within existing customers is a key component.

As the account leader, you will be the primary point of contact for 7-15 key accounts with a total revenue of ~$3M and you will:

  • [40%] Identify and close expansion, upgrade and renewal opportunities
  • [10] Perform account research, mapping and planning (including capturing intelligence on organization design, strategic priorities, Onomi share of wallet, other vendors scope, integration, usage and investments for each of the use cases, understanding budget cycles, and partner mapping, and creating pricing benchmarks against other solutions)
  • [20%] Execute account retention and expansion plan (inserting Onomi into centers of excellence and delivery units, design operating procedure for flawless execution, coordinating implementation and key integrations, evangelizing buying centers, functions and geo/affiliates with workshops and webinars, partner engagement, briefing and certification)
  • [10%] Handle first-line account product, compliance and administrative
  • [5%] Report on sales activities (CRM updates, sales forecasts and pipeline calls)
  • [15%] Build relationships with key account stakeholders (engaging with new users, fostering trust-based relationships with champions and above event stakeholders (commercial excellence, medical, IT, procurement), establishing open lines of communication with economic buyers, influencing HQ-prescribed technology usage guidelines, facilitating introduction and exec touchpoints at director/VP level with a meaningful briefing, demonstrate value in absolute ROI terms, securing customer presence at customer advisory boards and 3rd party event/roundtables participation)

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first month, you will onboard, get hands-on with our product, become fluent in our industry, get up to speed with systems, get introduced to your customers, and understand your customer buying centers and use cases:

  • Learn our product by getting certified with our SpotMe Academy and by embedding yourself in a virtual event project, an onsite event project, by building your own demo event and by joining an in-person business review.
  • Become fluent with our industry personas, competitors, and our industry use cases by embedding yourself in customer projects and presentations.
  • Master our sales processes, sales materials, and systems (Salesforce, Google Suite, PowerPoint, Zoom, Gainsight, Gong) to be able to manage a sales lifecycle from customer request to contract expansion deals autonomously; successfully conduct an expansion mock scoping & demo call with sales leadership and pass your sales certification.
  • Get introduced to all customers in your portfolio and secure face time with 80% of them.

After 3 months, you have completed your phase 1 account research and planning, and kicked off on account plans including renewal strategy, budget insertion and revenue & usage growth; leading indicators (usage and number of opportunities) are improving after 2 quarters with 2 expansion levers unlocked for each account.

After 12 months, you will have further executed your account plans and achieved an aggregate 20% YoY revenue growth on your portfolio through services and/or software expansion.

What you need to be great at:

  • Account leadership: You are above all a true account leader in B2B SaaS or services/consulting - you have managed large accounts ($200K-$2M) in large companies (>500 employees) over time, and you are able to truly understand the decision-making process and buying centers, and establish and nurture relationships with key people to expand scope and volume. You know what it means to operate a global, large-scale account in a first-class fashion.
  • Industry expertise with business orientation: You bring SaaS experience selling into critical industries - pharma, financial services, professional services, or tech - with demonstrated experience working with the most demanding customers. Above all, you have a flair for spotting pain points, helping customers form business cases, and guiding them towards execution. Pharma HCP engagement expertise, with all its nuances (medical, commercial, marketing), is a plus but not a must.
  • Autonomy and resourcefulness: You make decisions with confidence and don't wait to be told what to do. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it - you are scrappy, creative, and solution-oriented by nature. You move fast and act proactively, even when there is no immediate commercial upside.
  • Commercial sharpness: You run numbers quickly, think several steps ahead in negotiations, and understand what truly drives your customers' business. You can build a solid business case that holds up in front of a C-suite or procurement team, and you are comfortable making decisions and forming working hypotheses even when you don't have all the facts.

SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Spate is the machine intelligence platform used by top industry beauty brands. We analyze over 20 billion search signals to spot the next big beauty trend and help brands develop their marketing/product strategies.

Spate is looking for a backend engineer to help us design and implement the next iteration of our data pipeline, storage, and API backing our SaaS platform.

This is a remote, full time contractor position in Eastern Europe.

Responsibilities:

This is a technical role with a high degree of autonomy expected.

  • Support customers and staff in understanding and exploiting the platform, data and tools
  • Ensure the availability of the platform, data and tools
  • Define and implement improvements for the platform, data and tools related to security, quality, testing, automation, documentation and new features
  • Contribute to sprint planning, backlog grooming, and task prioritization.
  • Estimate the effort required for development tasks and help create project timelines.
  • Track and report on progress, addressing any delays or roadblocks proactively.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience as a software engineer, working on backend and ETL for webapplications
  • Experience collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large data sets
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Project management skills and ability to handle multiple priorities at different timescales
  • Proven problem-solving skills using deductive reasoning, understanding hierarchical relationships, and identifying gaps in logic
  • Self-starter and ability to work independently
  • Located in Eastern Europe

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: Power Bi, Tableau, Google DataStudio
  • Excellent analytical and customer-facing skills with attention-to-detail
  • Experience working with AWS, GCP or Azure

Recruitment Process:

Our application process consists of a few stages, each of which is asynchronous. We respect your time, so we designed the process with efficiency in mind, including only the essential steps. The goal is to ensure it's a good fit for both you & Spate. Here's what the process entails:

  • Application
  • Video Interview (about 30 minutes)
  • Personality Assessment (35 mins)
  • Customized case study (2 hours)
  • First interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)
  • Final interview with broader team (30 mins)

Regardless, we will keep you informed about the status of your application throughout.

Benefits

Why Spate?

  • Join a well-funded company that is working with the top brands in consumer goods
  • Work directly with the founders to set the direction of the company
  • Compensation --> €60k to €80k, depending on experience
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Always be up-to-date on the latest trends!

We enjoy a casual atmosphere, but our culture is about getting things done. We are passionate yet pragmatic when it comes to solving problems in a fast-paced environment. Our standards are high, but we thrive on working with people we respect and can learn from. We’re flexible on work styles, as long as everyone is getting their work done - and getting it done well.

About Spate:

At Spate, we use data science to predict the next big consumer trend in beauty, personal care, wellness & functional food.

Spate was founded in 2018 by Yarden Horwitz & Olivier Zimmer, two ex-Googlers who led the trendspotting division at Google and uncovered trends such as turmeric, cold brew, and face masks. Spate has been funded by the prestigious Y Combinator incubator and Initialized Capital. We currently have ~90 clients in the U.S., mainly in the beauty space from direct-to-consumer brands to big names such as L’Oréal, Estée Lauder, Unilever, etc.

As two ex-Googlers with a passion for using data to spot new patterns in consumer behavior, and we have made it our mission to build the world’s greatest consumer trends prediction platform of all time. And not just because we want to be trendy, but because we want to help brands get better at giving consumers what they really want.

Brands waste over $200BN every year due to product launch failures and inventory waste. By spotting Turmeric, we were able to tell brands to stop wasting money on kale products and provide consumers with glorious golden milk lattes instead - because that’s what consumers want.

How do we do this? We tap into publicly available consumer data (anonymous and aggregated) to identify interesting shifts in consumer behavior.

  • Manage lifecycle channels: Own email and other lifecycle messaging channels, including in-app messaging, push, or SMS where appropriate.
  • Build segmentation: Develop audience segments based on product usage, engagement, lifecycle stage, billing status, and other behavioral signals to deliver more relevant experiences.
  • Support activation: Partner with Product and Growth teams to develop onboarding and activation programs that help new users reach meaningful product value and increase the likelihood of conversion.
  • Support retention and expansion: Work closely with Customer Success, Product, and other Marketing teams to develop programs that support engagement, retention, churn reduction, and expansion over time.
  • Test and optimize: Establish a structured testing approach across messaging, content, audiences, timing, and triggers, using results to continuously improve lifecycle performance.
  • Own lifecycle performance reporting: Track and report on key metrics including conversion, pipeline and revenue generated or influenced, engagement, activation, retention, and other lifecycle KPIs.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, growth, retention, or marketing automation, ideally in B2B SaaS or a product-led/self-serve environment.

  • Experience with audience segmentation and personalization using behavioral, product-usage, or customer data.
  • Strong copywriting skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences and stages of the customer journey.
  • Ambitious, curious, and coachable, with a desire to take on increasing ownership and grow into a broader revenue-generating lifecycle role.

  • Experience building in-app onboarding, tutorials, or product walkthroughs using Pendo, Appcues, or a similar platform.

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

Preferred

Job Title: Safeguarding Officer

Location: UK, Remote

Salary: £45k - £50k per annum, dependent on experience

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

Direct Reports: N/A

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Including but not limited to: donors, survivor support services in country, third parties, including community members, beneficiaries.

Job Purpose: To support the Global Safeguarding Lead (GSGL) to strengthen and embed safeguarding across all programmes and headquarters functions

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

About the role:

The Safeguarding Officer plays a key role in supporting the Global Safeguarding Lead (GSGL) to strengthen and embed safeguarding across all programmes and headquarters functions. The postholder will provide expert guidance and support to programme teams, help drive continuous improvement through safeguarding self-reviews and action plans, contribute to safeguarding case management and investigations, and support the design and delivery of safeguarding training and awareness initiatives across the organisation.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the monitoring and review of safeguarding self-reviews and action plans across programmes, providing practical support and guidance to ensure progress against agreed objectives. This may involve occasional international travel.
  • Lead or support safeguarding risk assessments across programmes and functions, ensuring mitigation measures are identified, implemented and reviewed to reduce the risk of harm.
  • Support programme teams to assess, strengthen and monitor safeguarding capacity within implementing partners, contractors and external stakeholders.
  • Support the GSGL in the design, development, and delivery of safeguarding training programmes, ensuring staff at all levels understand their safeguarding responsibilities and are equipped to apply them effectively.
  • Develop engaging safeguarding communications, awareness-raising resources, and training materials that are accessible, inclusive, and appropriate for diverse audiences and reinforce a speak up culture.
  • Support the development, implementation and monitoring of community-based safeguarding reporting and complaints mechanisms to ensure they are accessible, trusted and survivor-centred.
  • Support safeguarding case management processes, ensuring responses are survivor-centred, confidential, timely and aligned with organisational policies and international best practice.
  • Coordinate with HR, legal, security and programme teams on cases that involve employees, partners or contractors.
  • Work collaboratively with recruitment teams across regions and programmes to promote and strengthen safeguarding practices throughout the recruitment and onboarding process.
  • Coordinate and facilitate the safeguarding Community of Practice, bringing together safeguarding leads and focal points across the organisation to share learning, strengthen collaboration, and promote best practice.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of safeguarding systems, processes, and initiatives in response to organisational priorities and emerging needs.
  • Support statutory and donor reporting obligations, including serious incident reports to the Charity Commission and notifications to institutional donors.
  • Support Managers and safeguarding focal points in the field/country offices to apply policy consistently.
  • Monitor developments in sector standards and regulatory requirements and flag implications for policy or practice.

General:

  • Uphold HALO’s core values and standards, promoting its ethos and mission statement.
  • Ensure familiarity with and adherence to all HALO policies and procedures.
  • Carry out all duties in a manner that is sensitive to cultural contexts and compliant with local legal frameworks.
  • Champion and uphold safeguarding standards, acting with due care to protect anyone who comes into contact with HALO's work and reporting any concerns promptly and appropriately.
  • Fulfil responsibilities in line with HALO's health and safety policies and procedures.
  • Undertake any other duties reasonably required to support departmental objectives and operational requirements.

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional international travel required

Requirements

  • Demonstrable international experience, or strong awareness of cultural differences across diverse programme settings, with up to date knowledge of international safeguarding standards.
  • Demonstrable experience in safeguarding within an INGO.
  • Experience of supporting or leading safeguarding investigations.
  • Experience designing and/or delivering training and capacity-building activities.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in complex, fast paced, and evolving environments, demonstrating resilience and adaptability.
  • Level 2 of the Investigator Qualification Training Scheme (CHS Alliance), or equivalent
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and develop effective working relationships across programmes and functions.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and committed to promoting and strengthening safeguarding practice.
  • Ability to think analytically, draw conclusions and evidence analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience supporting the implementation of safeguarding systems, frameworks, or programmes.
  • Level 3 of the Investigator Qualification Training Scheme (CHS Alliance), or equivalent.
  • Experience working in the prevention of gender-based violence (GBV) or related protection programming.
  • Experience working in international development, humanitarian, or international operational settings.
  • Willingness and ability to undertake international travel when required.
  • Proficiency in another language.

Benefits

  • 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 statutory holidays
  • Non-contributory life assurance
  • Private medical insurance
  • Pension contributions matched by HALO up to 5%
  • Emergency medical insurance while travelling overseas
  • Flexible working policy

Please submit a CV (no more than 2 pages) and a cover letter (no more than 1 page) outlining how your experience matches the key skills and competencies required by 24th September 2026. Applications without a cover letter tailored to this position will not be considered.

We reserve the right to amend the closing date depending on the number of applications received.

The HALO Trust is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

The HALO Trust is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

The HALO Trust is committed to ensuring that it provides a safe and trusted environment which safeguards and promotes the welfare and wellbeing of anyone who comes into contact with, or is part of, the Charity, with a zero-tolerance approach to behaviours which challenge this.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer (f/m/d) - Remote in Germany
jobs.excerpt: Hundreds of engineering tools.  One platform to connect them to AI agents.
jobs.description:
Hundreds of engineering tools. One platform to connect them to AI agents. We need the designer who can.

Integrating a couple of software tools for mechanical engineers into an AI automation platform is hard. Integrating 100+ and making them accessible to both human engineers and AI agents? That's a design challenge. We're looking for someone who can translate tool-specific complexity into visual patterns that scale, unlock complex engineering tools for AI agents to work with, and help our users automate their day-to-day in days, not months.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for an experienced UI/UX Designer to shape how engineers interact with complex simulation and analysis tools through our automation platform, from visual programming interfaces to AI-powered workflow building.

As part of a tightly knit product trio with your Product Manager and Tech Lead in our most technical product team, you'll help define how we integrate engineering tools into our platform. You'll work on translating tool-specific details into abstracted, interchangeable nodes, evolving our 3D viewer to support growing engineering domains, and designing AI-based experiences that help engineers build valuable automations in days instead of months.

At Synera, design isn't a handoff. It's a core part of how we build. You'll bring structure to technical ambiguity, collaborate closely with developers, and ensure that what we ship at lightning pace is not just functional, but truly intuitive for engineering users.

You'll do discovery, map complex and highly technical user journeys, and see the design cycle through concept to high-fidelity prototype. As one of four Synera UI/UX designers, you'll get your hands dirty: From designing individual node interfaces and creating patterns that scale across multiple engineering domains to our AI-based workflow builder that helps users translate their expertise into reliable automations.

Working closely with our users from mechanical engineering, CFD, and optimization backgrounds, you'll get firsthand feedback and real use cases to continuously refine the user experience.

If you're eager to own design at the intersection of complex engineering tools and AI automation, and have a visible impact from day one, we'd love to meet you.

👉 Your responsibilities span the full design cycle:

📣 Drive discovery & feedback loops

You engage with real users (mostly engineers from the aerospace or automotive industries) to gather insights, test assumptions, and continuously improve the experience based on real-world use. You'll learn about their engineering workflows and tool requirements to inform design decisions.

✨ UX concepts and UI design

You organize and facilitate design sessions, uncover and define user journeys for technical workflows, collaborate with the other UI/UX designers on our product's information architecture and prototype ideas in close collaboration with developers. From early concepts to polished designs: you own the experience. This includes designing node interfaces for integrated engineering tools and patterns for tool interchangeability. Oh, and did we mention icons? Lot’s of icons…

🤝 Work in the Product Trio

As part of the product trio with your Product Manager and Tech Lead you shape the product vision, gather requirements, and turn complexity into clarity. You'll translate technical tool specifications into user-friendly abstractions and be the voice of the user in a team that values engineering precision and usability equally.

⏱ Deliver Value Quickly but with Quality

As a fast-growing start-up, it's all about speed for us. You balance creativity with pragmatism to ensure high-quality designs while meeting sprint goals. We ship iteratively, and your designs will have a fast, visible impact, helping users achieve valuable automations in days versus months.

🌱 Strengthen Our Design Culture

You'll actively participate in design critiques among designers and help raise the bar across the company. We believe in growing together and maintaining a consistent, intuitive design system across the product.

⚡In the first 6 months: You start to take ownership of the design for engineering integration projects, developing new building blocks for our automation platform.

⚡By 12 months: You will have design ownership of the mechanical engineering capabilities of our platform, working on abstraction of complex workflows as well as expanding our platforms features as we approach new domains like fluid dynamics or electrical engineering.

Find the other designers of Synera on the photo and join our next company event to connect, relax, and have fun together with other Synerians!

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary range is:

  • Intermediate Level: 50,800-67,200 EUR

  • Experienced Level: 65,500-84,100 EUR

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You actively contribute to shaping our products' look and feel as part of a multidisciplinary product team.

  • You see the impact of your work in every 4-month release.

  • You evaluate your designs with users from high-profile customers like BMW, NASA or Miele.

  • Enjoy true flexibility: work when and where it suits you, and swap public holidays to match your own values and beliefs (as long as you have residency in Germany).

  • Get home-office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Use your personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regional meet-ups, weekly virtual coffee breaks, and workshops. Plus, we come together as a whole company for our annual Summer Event! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have 4+ years of hands-on UI/UX design experience designing products in the mechanical engineering space.

  • You have a good understanding of engineering processes, specifically simulations like FEA or CFD.

  • You have experience with 3D interfaces or visualization tools.

  • You have a proven track record of end-to-end design ownership, from discovery research through shipped product.

  • You have strong visual design skills: You have a sharp eye for layout, typography, color, and can demonstrate polished UI work in your portfolio.

  • You have Figma proficiency at a level where you're pushing the tool's limits, not learning basics.

  • You have experience working in product trios or closely embedded with PMs and engineers in agile/iterative environments.

  • You can manage ambiguity: You've worked in early-stage products, pivots, or fast-moving teams where you had to define the path forward.

  • Your super English skills help you to work in an international environment.

    Bonus points - cherry on top 🍰

  • You're familiar with complex design systems or component libraries.

  • You have a background in visual programming tools, no-code/low-code platforms, or workflow automation.

  • You have an understanding of AI/ML product patterns (agentic systems, prompt interfaces, etc.).

  • You are based in Bremen or open to relocating. We do offer remote working within Germany; however, for key roles like UX, we’ve found that close in-person collaboration works best.

Synera is a place where everyone can grow and every voice is valued. So, however you identify yourself and whatever background you have, if this role excites you, please apply with your English CV (no photo and birth date needed :)) and portfolio. Tell us how your unique perspective will benefit our Design team.

Why Synera?

Synera is an AI automation platform for engineers that drastically accelerates product development, as proven by numerous customers in the automotive, aerospace and consumer goods industries such as Airbus, BMW, EDAG and Miele. We achieve this by integrating engineering tools, data, and expert knowledge into a low-code environment that helps engineers create digital coworkers and automate complex processes.

We change the way product development works and are looking for a UX Designer (f/m/d). Do you want to join?

In this role, you will build products that power the post-purchase experience for the biggest brands in the retail industry. As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, you will have a direct impact on our customer-facing products and work with modern technologies like Java, NodeJS, Python, React, and GraphQL to ship complex features that drive millions of views.

For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote.

Day-to-day

Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

  • Implement new product features & support/ extend existing ones
  • Build frontend platform components leveraged across our internal, external products and ecommerce storefronts like Shopify, Salesforce etc
  • Contribute to our overall architecture and maintain code quality standards by partnering with other senior engineers
  • Work with product and design teams to translate wireframes and mockups into functional UI components

Backend Development (Secondary Focus)

  • Contribute to development and maintenance of backend services using Golang, Node.js
  • Understanding of google cloud platform (GCP) , CI/CD and be able to deploy code and infrastructure components
  • Work with databases like postgres, spanner, bigquery
  • Understand and implement RESTful or GraphQL APIs

What we're looking for

  • You have a BS/MS in computer science, information systems, or equivalent
  • You have 10+ years of experience building reliable, scalable, and high-quality systems
  • Experience in building consumer facing applications with a frontend framework(s), such as React (preferable), Svelte Angular, Vue or Ember
  • Experience building well-designed software with NodeJS or Golang
  • Experience developing consumer facing applications consuming various APIs from a microservice backend system
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
  • Knowledge of full development life cycle and computer science fundamentals
  • Strong focus on code quality and code reviews
  • Experience with mentoring other engineers
  • Previous startup experience strongly preferred with growth and product engineering mindset

Why Narvar?

We're on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That's why we created Narvar - a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you've ever bought something online, there's a good chance you've used our platform!

From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, and Bangalore, we've served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages.

Pioneering the post-purchase movement means navigating into the unknown. Our team thrives on this sense of adventure while nurturing a mindset of innovation. We're a home for big hearts and we leave our egos at the door. We work hard but we always make time to celebrate professional wins, baby showers, birthday parties, and everything in between.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across Canada. Within the range, individual compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to, skill set, education and certifications, and work location.

jobs.title: Sr. Partner Sales Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Meet the Moment with AlteryxWe're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done.
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Senior Partner Sales Engineer

Public Sector and U.S. South | Partner-led Alteryx One outcomes

The opportunity

Data, automation and AI are reshaping how work gets done. Alteryx One brings data, analytics and AI together in a governed, accessible platform, enabling organizations to turn trusted workflows and business logic into repeatable, agent-driven outcomes.

The Senior Partner Sales Engineer is the technical and strategic lead for a focused portfolio of partners and partner-led opportunities. You will help global and regional systems integrators, solution providers, distributors and technology partners position, architect, prove, deliver and scale Alteryx One solutions. You will work across partner leadership, partner architects, Alteryx account teams, Product, Engineering and customer stakeholders to convert ecosystem potential into measurable customer outcomes.

This role has a specific mandate across Public Sector and the U.S. South. sales segment. It combines partner practice development with hands-on presales execution, including public sector account planning, mission-oriented use cases, secure hybrid architectures, technical evaluations and production adoption.

What success looks like

  • Priority partners can independently qualify, position, demonstrate, architect and deliver Alteryx One solutions.

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities advance through stronger discovery, technical validation and executive alignment.

  • Proofs of concept and Partner Acceleration Program investments start with a named customer, measurable outcome, delivery capacity and path to production.

  • Joint solutions become reusable offerings, reference architectures, demos and managed service patterns that partners can take to additional accounts.

  • Public Sector customers receive architectures and value cases aligned to mission outcomes, security, governance, auditability and responsible AI.

  • Technical outcomes are evidenced through milestones, technical win rate, POC-to-production conversion, active usage, partner readiness and contribution to pipeline, renewal and expansion.

What you will do

Own partner technical strategy and practice development | approx. 20%

  • Build technical account plans for assigned partners, aligned to their GTM priorities, industry strengths, delivery capacity, target accounts and services economics.

  • Establish trusted-advisor relationships with partner executives, practice leaders, solution architects and sales engineers.

  • Segment partners by readiness and potential, then focus investment on those able to sell, build, support and scale repeatable customer outcomes.

  • Align with Partner Alliance Managers and field leadership on joint priorities, coverage, account mapping and measurable success criteria.

Architect differentiated Alteryx One solutions | approx. 25%

  • Lead discovery and architecture workshops that connect business outcomes to AI-ready data, analytics, automation, governance and deployment requirements.

  • Design secure cloud, hybrid and on-premises patterns across Alteryx One, modern data platforms and enterprise applications.

  • Position governed business logic as the foundation for reliable agentic outcomes, with workflows that are visible, understandable, repeatable and auditable.

  • Guide partners on Agent Studio, Alteryx MCP Server, AI Tool Palette, Ask Alteryx, Live Query, Workspace Execution and relevant Designer capabilities, distinguishing released functionality from preview or roadmap items.

  • Develop joint architectures and integration patterns with Snowflake, Databricks, Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft and other strategic technologies without displacing partner or platform-native services.

Lead partner-led technical sales and proof execution | approx. 20%

  • Support qualified partner-led opportunities from discovery through technical close, including demonstrations, whiteboarding, solution design, objection handling, security review and executive presentations.

  • Structure POCs and Partner Acceleration Program engagements around a named sponsor, funded problem, baseline, acceptance criteria, partner capacity, production owner and repeatable 5-to-10-account thesis.

  • Drive clear qualify, design, prove and produce gates. Stop or reset activity when customer demand, product fit, security, partner economics, delivery ownership or production criteria are not credible.

  • Capture reusable evidence, including reference designs, demo assets, customer proof, lessons learned and delivery handoffs.

Advance Public Sector outcomes | approx. 15%

  • Partner with Public Sector AEs, alliance leaders and delivery partners to identify mission-critical workflows in cross-government operations, defense and intelligence, public health, finance and revenue, infrastructure, transportation, human services and public safety.

  • Translate agency priorities into measurable outcomes such as improved service delivery, stronger forecasting, resource optimization, faster disaster response, better data quality and auditable decision processes.

  • Address public sector requirements for secure data access, hybrid deployment, governance, lineage, regulatory compliance, accessibility and responsible AI in coordination with Alteryx specialists.

  • Support partner-led account planning, capture activity and technical responses for relevant procurement motions. Never overstate certifications, authorizations, product availability or customer evidence.

Enable partners to operate independently | approx. 10%

  • Create role-based enablement for partner sellers, presales teams, architects and delivery consultants, combining messaging, discovery, demos, architecture and implementation readiness.

  • Coach partner technical teams through hands-on builds, certification pathways, technical win plans and delivery quality reviews.

  • Build scalable assets such as demo environments, solution blueprints, reusable workflows, industry playbooks, competitive guidance and facilitator kits.

  • Measure enablement by observed capability and customer execution, not attendance or activity volume alone.

Represent the partner and operate with discipline | approx. 10%

  • Bring structured partner and customer feedback to Product and Engineering, influence priorities with evidence and close the loop with the ecosystem.

  • Maintain current knowledge of Alteryx One, data and AI market trends, competitors, partner roadmaps, security practices and commercial dependencies.

  • Track technical milestones, partner readiness, risks, outcomes and attribution in the relevant operating systems; provide concise MBR and QBR insight.

  • Represent Alteryx at partner events, executive briefings, technical communities and customer forums.

What we are looking for

Required experience and capability

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in enterprise presales, solution engineering, solution architecture or technical consulting across data, analytics, automation, AI or adjacent enterprise software.

  • At least 3 years working directly with partner ecosystems, including GSIs, regional SIs, solution providers, distributors, ISVs or hyperscalers.

  • Demonstrated success building partner technical capability and supporting partner-sourced or partner-led enterprise opportunities through technical close.

  • Hands-on ability to lead discovery, design architectures, build compelling demonstrations and define outcome-based POCs.

  • Working knowledge of data preparation, analytics, workflow automation, governance, AI/ML and agentic AI concepts, including APIs, OAuth, MCP, LLM integration and human oversight.

  • Experience with public cloud and modern data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake or Databricks, plus hybrid and on-premises integration patterns.

  • Practical proficiency with SQL and at least one relevant analytics or programming environment such as Alteryx, Python or R.

  • Executive presence and the ability to translate technical complexity into business, partner and mission outcomes for CxO, architecture, security, data and line-of-business audiences.

  • Strong commercial judgment, prioritization and written communication; willing to challenge weak qualification and ungrounded roadmap assumptions.

  • Ability to travel up to 40%, based on territory and business needs.

Preferred and differentiating experience

  • Experience supporting U.S. Public Sector agencies and the partner ecosystem that serves them, including mission, procurement, security and delivery stakeholders.

  • Alteryx experience or certification, with the ability to ramp rapidly across Alteryx One, Designer and cloud modules.

  • Applied experience with GenAI or agentic architectures, including RAG, MCP-based tool use, prompt and context design, evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.

  • Experience creating partner practices, packaged offerings, reference architectures, marketplace propositions or managed services.

  • Cloud, data platform, architecture, security or AI certifications relevant to the territory and partner portfolio.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

How performance will be measured

Goals will be set by territory and partner portfolio. The role will be assessed on verified outcomes, not raw activity counts.

Commercial contribution

Partner-sourced and influenced pipeline progression; technical win rate; renewal and expansion influence; marketplace or consumption impact where applicable.

Partner capability

Partners independently qualifying, demoing, architecting and delivering; readiness progression; quality of partner technical plans.

Proof to production

POC-to-production conversion; time to agreed technical decision; adoption owner and support handoff; active usage and customer evidence.

Reusable scale

Validated solutions, accelerators, reference architectures and 5-to-10-account activation plans adopted by partner teams.

Execution quality

HLD and technical close plan quality; risk and milestone hygiene; accurate product positioning; Product and Engineering feedback closure.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The base salary range for this role in the United States is $112,945–$123,879 with an On-Target Earnings (OTE) range of $161,350–$176,970..

In addition to base pay and commission eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:

  • A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses

  • An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off

  • Mental health support and wellness reimbursement

  • Career development and education assistance


Why Alteryx

At Alteryx, you will help partners and customers move from fragmented data work and AI experimentation to governed, production-scale outcomes. You will work at the intersection of business teams, IT, data platforms and AI ecosystems, turning trusted analytic workflows into systems that drive consistent decisions and action.

We value problem solvers, innovators and high performers who challenge the status quo, keep their commitments and help the whole team succeed. Candidates who meet many, but not every, requirement are encouraged to apply. Alteryx is committed to building an inclusive workplace with a wide range of backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Benefits & Perks:

Alteryx has amazing benefits for all Associates which can be viewed here.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Alteryx will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation. Our mission, grounded in democratizing education, is to create access for learners from every background and empower them to achieve their aspirations and advance their careers.

We are committed to delivering rigorous, flexible programs that are both personally fulfilling and professionally rewarding, while contributing to the betterment of society. Since 2004, Yorkville has been among Canada’s few private, for-profit, fully accredited degree-granting universities, with campuses in Ontario, British Columbia, and New Brunswick. Together with Toronto Film School, we offer creative and academic pathways at both the college and university levels, cultivating a multidisciplinary environment where innovation and the arts converge.

Our community is vibrant and diverse. Many of our learners are adults balancing education with careers and personal commitments. Every member of our team – whether in teaching, operations, or technology – is dedicated to removing barriers and expanding access. Together, we deliver flexible, industry-informed learning that leads to meaningful opportunities.

At our core is human connection – guiding people to reimagine their futures in a community defined by opportunity, creativity, and growth.

Who we need

Reporting to the Manager of Practicum Applications, we are hiring a Practicum Advisor to support students in the Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology program as they prepare for practicum. As our new Practicum Advisor, you will guide students through pre-practicum requirements, helping them understand what they need to complete and supporting their progression through each stage of the process. You will review applications and documentation, track student progress, and collaborate with university teams to help ensure students are prepared to move forward with their placements in accordance with university requirements.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada.

What's in it for you

Impact on a critical stage of the student journey. Practicum is an important milestone for Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology students as they move from academic learning toward applied professional experience. You will help students navigate the requirements leading up to this stage, providing the clarity, guidance, and follow-through they need to feel prepared and confident as they progress toward practicum.

Influence on student readiness and progression. You will play an important role in helping students successfully move through the pre-practicum process. By reviewing applications and documentation, clarifying requirements, tracking progress, and coordinating with students, potential supervisors, practicum sites, faculty, and university teams, you will help identify and resolve issues that could otherwise delay a student's progression. Your work will contribute to a well-coordinated experience and help ensure students are ready to move forward with their placements.

Specialized knowledge and career growth. You will build expertise in practicum processes, graduate education, student advising, and the requirements involved in preparing counselling psychology students for field training. Working across student services, faculty, practicum sites, and supervisors will give you broad exposure to the academic and administrative processes behind experiential learning while strengthening skills you can continue to build on within student services and post-secondary education.

How you will make an impact

  • Guide students through the pre-practicum process. You will provide clear, responsive support to Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology students as they prepare for practicum. You will answer questions, clarify requirements, and provide direction on the documentation and steps students need to complete.
  • Review and coordinate practicum applications. You will review practicum applications and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy, following established university requirements and processes. You will communicate with students when additional information or action is needed and help keep applications moving forward.
  • Track student progress. You will monitor students as they move through the different stages of the pre-practicum process, maintaining accurate and confidential electronic records. You will manage a high volume of information and follow up on outstanding requirements to help students stay on track.
  • Communicate and collaborate. You will correspond with students and work with practicum sites, potential supervisors, faculty, and university colleagues to support a well-coordinated practicum process. You will communicate professionally and thoughtfully, helping ensure everyone has the information they need.
  • Support continuous improvement. You will help maintain and update pre-practicum documents, resources, and presentations as requirements and processes evolve. You will contribute to the day-to-day effectiveness of the team and take on additional activities that support students and the practicum application process.

What you bring

  • The education. You have a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field, providing you with a strong foundation for understanding and supporting the needs of a diverse graduate student population.
  • The organizational skills. You are highly organized and comfortable managing a large volume of detailed and confidential information. You can work independently, prioritize competing needs, maintain accurate records, and contribute as a collaborative member of a team.
  • The technical skills. You are proficient with Microsoft Office, Adobe, and data management tools, and you are comfortable learning new systems and software. You can use technology effectively to organize information, maintain documentation, and support day-to-day processes.
  • The communication and relationship-building skills. You can build trusting relationships and communicate professionally with graduate students, prospective students, faculty, university staff, and other professionals. You know how to adapt your communication to different audiences, provide clear information, and navigate challenging conversations with diplomacy and sound judgment.
  • The ability to navigate complex situations. You bring strong conflict resolution and crisis management skills and can remain thoughtful and professional when situations are sensitive or challenging. You approach barriers with empathy, cultural sensitivity, and an understanding of the diverse experiences and needs of graduate students.

Why work at Yorkville University?

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising students, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on students, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their possible, while giving you the opportunity to realize yours.

Compensation philosophy

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, straightforward, and supportive of your growth. Our salary ranges reflect progression from learning in the role to excelling, with each offer based on skills, experience, and role complexity.

This position offers a minimum annual salary of $50,000, a midpoint of $53,500 and a maximum of $55,000. Position Title: J Street U Campus Fellowship

Looking to bring a pro-Israel, pro-Peace, pro-Democracy community to your campus? Apply to be a campus fellow today!

Program Description

J Street U is launching a paid fellowship program to establish and grow our presence on priority campuses nationwide. This fellowship serves as a catalyst for bringing J Street U to new campuses and to students who would benefit from being part of our community. Campus Fellows will receive $750 per semester to lead grassroots organizing efforts and establish J Street U programming on their campus. This role is designed for motivated students who can independently launch initiatives while working collaboratively with regional staff. Fellows will serve as the primary J Street U representative on campus, building community and connecting students to our broader movement.

About J Street

J Street is the political home for pro-Israel, pro-peace Americans working for the future of Israel as the democratic homeland of the Jewish people. The organization believes that preserving Israel’s Jewish and democratic character depends on achieving a two-state solution, resulting in a Palestinian state living alongside Israel in peace and security.

J Street focuses its work in three main areas: (1) Advocating and demonstrating support for pro-Israel, pro-peace policies in Congress, the media and the Jewish community; (2) Endorsing and raising money for federal candidates who share J Street’s agenda; and (3) Educating the public and raising awareness of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the two-state solution.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be an enrolled undergraduate student on a campus with no existing J Street U chapter or limited J Street U presence
  • Ineligible to apply for the Dounn Congressional Fellowship program during fellowship term

Time Commitment

  • 3-5 hours per week
  • Two semesters (full academic year commitment)

Responsibilities May Include:

  • Plan and execute 6 J Street U programs throughout the academic year (3 per semester)
  • Represent J Street U at campus orientation, information sessions, and activities fairs each semester to engage new students.
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with interested students to encourage deeper involvement
  • Develop and maintain relationships with campus Hillel and other relevant student organizations
  • Serve as primary campus liaison for J Street U activities and initiatives
  • Participate in bi-weekly check-in meetings with assigned regional coordinator
  • Attend monthly J Street U National calls

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Strong relational and interpersonal skills
  • Careful attention to detail
  • Interest in and/or knowledge of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict

Learn More about J Street’s Work

To Apply for the Position

We are excited to receive applications from a broad range of applicants as we grow our organization to better reflect the diversity of the communities that care about our mission. While we will prioritize applications from current J Street U students, all motivated pro-Israel pro-peace students are encouraged to apply. Applicants are considered on a rolling basis.

  1. Cover letter that explains why you are interested in this unique experience
  2. Resume

At J Street we value an inclusive, welcoming, and diverse workplace. jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-time

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity

About STERRY

At STERRY, we help ambitious brands scale through data-driven marketing strategies that deliver measurable results. Over the years, we've helped clients generate more than $100 million in trackable online revenue across crowdfunding, e-commerce, and growth-focused campaigns. We're currently supporting the growth of a logistics technology platform and are looking for a sharp, ambitious, and commercially minded Marketing Director to help scale the business globally.

The Role This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys owning both strategy and execution. As Marketing Director, you'll bridge the gap between B2B supply chain marketing and technology platform growth, building and optimizing the marketing engine that attracts, converts, and retains 3PL partners and platform users worldwide. Working directly with the CEO and collaborating with cross-functional teams, you'll be responsible for everything from high-level growth planning and market expansion initiatives to campaign execution, outreach strategy, funnel optimization, and performance analysis. We're looking for someone who understands the logistics landscape, knows how to market a B2B platform or marketplace, and enjoys rolling up their sleeves to make things happen.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Strategy & Growth
  • Own and execute the company's global marketing strategy, including brand positioning, demand generation, content marketing, SEO, paid media, email marketing, and product marketing.
  • Develop and optimize inbound and outbound marketing funnels that drive qualified 3PL partnerships and platform sign-ups.
  • Build scalable lead generation systems and nurturing programs across email, LinkedIn, and other acquisition channels.
  • Develop compelling messaging and positioning that resonates with 3PL providers, e-commerce merchants, and supply chain stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with the CEO to align marketing initiatives with business objectives, market expansion plans, and strategic partnerships.
  • Continuously evaluate growth opportunities, customer acquisition strategies, and market trends to support business growth.
3PL Research, Outreach & Partnership Development
  • Identify, research, and evaluate potential 3PL partners across global markets based on capabilities, geographic coverage, and strategic fit.
  • Build and maintain a structured database of prospective partners, including service offerings, contact information, engagement history, and partnership status.
  • Execute outreach campaigns through email, LinkedIn, and other channels to introduce the platform and generate partnership opportunities.
  • Conduct initial qualification and discovery conversations to assess partnership potential and business fit.
  • Prepare prospect profiles, competitive analyses, service gap assessments, and recommended engagement strategies.
  • Manage ongoing follow-up and relationship-building efforts throughout the partnership pipeline.
  • Monitor and respond to inbound partnership inquiries, emails, and direct messages in a timely and professional manner.
  • Support and oversee social media activities related to partner engagement and brand visibility.
  • Manage and mentor team members and virtual assistants responsible for 3PL sourcing and outreach initiatives.
Analytics, Platform Performance & Market Intelligence
  • Monitor website traffic, user behavior, order flows, conversion rates, and user journeys to identify growth opportunities and areas for optimization.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators including MQLs, sign-ups, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and campaign performance.
  • Analyze acquisition channels, user engagement metrics, and conversion paths to improve platform performance.
  • Review order activity and operational trends, escalating issues and identifying opportunities for process improvements.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly reports highlighting growth performance, outreach effectiveness, partnership pipeline status, and strategic recommendations.
  • Conduct ongoing competitor analysis and monitor logistics industry trends, pricing changes, market developments, and emerging opportunities.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Lead and mentor a growing cross-functional team supporting marketing, outreach, research, design, development, and growth initiatives.
  • Directly oversee the 3PL Searching & Outreach team, ensuring sourcing pipelines, outreach efforts, and engagement targets are achieved.
  • Collaborate with design, development, operations, and data teams to improve customer experience and optimize growth initiatives.
  • Establish clear goals, reporting structures, workflows, and performance expectations across the team.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.
Executive Partnership & Operational Support
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO on growth initiatives, partnership development, and market expansion opportunities.
  • Coordinate projects across multiple stakeholders, ensuring priorities remain aligned and execution stays on track.
  • Conduct ad hoc market research, competitive analysis, and business intelligence projects to support strategic decision-making.
  • Assist with scheduling, communications, meeting preparation, and executive follow-ups related to key initiatives.
  • Support meeting documentation, action-item tracking, and project coordination.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and logistics for partnership meetings, conferences, and industry events when required.
Team Structure This role will directly lead and collaborate with:
  • 3PL Searching Lead
  • 3PL Searching Assistant
What We're Looking For:

Logistics & 3PL Industry Expertise You have hands-on experience within the logistics, freight forwarding, fulfillment, supply chain, shipping, or 3PL technology ecosystem. You understand how logistics providers operate, the challenges they face, and how purchasing and partnership decisions are made.

Strategic Yet Hands-On You can confidently move between quarterly growth planning and day-to-day execution. Whether it's refining a go-to-market strategy, reviewing campaign performance, writing outreach messaging, or optimizing conversion funnels, you're comfortable owning the details.

Data-Driven Decision Maker You don't just look at traffic reports—you understand user behavior, conversion paths, acquisition performance, and growth metrics. You know how to turn data into actionable recommendations and work effectively with developers and technical teams to improve outcomes.

Strong Communicator & Relationship Builder You can confidently present performance updates and market insights to executive leadership while maintaining clear communication with partners, prospects, and internal teams. You build trust quickly and represent the company professionally across global markets.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or Communications, or related field is a plus— but what truly matters is what you can build. A standout portfolio or equivalent hands-on experience is just as valued.
  • 6–8+ years of experience in marketing, growth, business development, partnerships, or related leadership roles.
  • Proven success within a 3PL, logistics, freight forwarding, B2B supply chain technology, marketplace, or related environment.
  • Strong understanding of both inbound and outbound lead generation strategies.
  • Experience designing and executing outreach and nurturing sequences across email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
  • Deep understanding of global logistics markets, industry dynamics, pricing structures, and competitive landscapes.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and driving business growth initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using modern marketing and analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Hotjar, CRM systems, automation tools, and reporting platforms.
  • Shopify and broader e-commerce ecosystem experience is highly preferred.
  • Strong project management, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a remote, fast-paced, and growth-oriented environment
Why Join STERRY?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in building and scaling a growing global platform while working directly with leadership. You'll have the autonomy to shape strategy, influence business decisions, build meaningful partnerships, and create measurable impact within an industry undergoing rapid transformation.

About Regenified

Regenified was founded in 2022 by the pioneers of regenerative agriculture. Our founders are known and recognised as the leading figures and guardians for regenerative agriculture and its journey to mainstream agriculture.

Regenified’s purpose is to accelerate the adoption and impact of regenerative agriculture by translating data and intelligence into trusted, unified, and common enablers that power a regenerative economy. To date, our standards have been approved by the largest grocery chains in the world and we are actively verifying large acres of farmland producing cereals, beef, poultry, eggs and fresh produce.

The Role

We are seeking a Commercial Lead – Brands & Retail to drive growth across food, beverage, CPG, and retail partners. This is a senior, externally facing role responsible for originating, structuring, and closing strategic commercial partnerships across Regenified’s full service offering, including verification, procurement services, and certification.

This role is accountable for selling integrated and standalone solutions to both CPG brands and retail partners, helping them activate regenerative agriculture across their businesses, supplier networks, and product portfolios. You will work with partners to determine the right combination of verification, certified claims, and regenerative procurement pathways based on their business objectives, and sustainability commitments.

This is not a transactional sales role. You are a category builder and trusted advisor, supporting brands and retailers through the commercial and operational realities of regenerative sourcing. You will engage sustainability, procurement, innovation, and executive leadership teams to design partnerships that deliver measurable, verified impact while creating long-term commercial value.

Your mission is to grow Regenified’s brand and retail portfolio by converting interest into long-term, multi-service partnerships, while deepening and expanding existing relationships over time.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Revenue Growth Across Brands & Retail

    • Deliver revenue growth across CPG Brand & Retail partners by selling Regenified’s verification, procurement services, and certification.

    • Build and manage a high-quality enterprise pipeline, consistently converting inbound and outbound leads and opportunities into closed revenue that meets or exceeds annual targets.

  • Prospect, Pitch and Close Enterprise Partnerships

    • Identify, develop, and close new enterprise-level Brand and Retail partners, translating sustainability ambitions into contracted revenue.

    • Represent Regenified at brand- and retail-focused industry events, trade shows, and conferences to generate demand, pipeline, and business flow.

    • Clearly articulate Regenified’s end-to-end, value proposition, to a broad set of external stakeholders.

    • Lead the full commercial lifecycle, including executive-level pitching, solution design, proposal development, negotiation of all commercial terms, and contract execution.

    • Structure single-service and multi-service agreements that support scalability, multi-year commitments, and long-term revenue growth.

  • Drive Strategic Account Expansion (in partnership with Customer Success)

    • Grow revenue within existing accounts by expanding verification programs, procurement engagements, and certification adoption over time.

    • Maintain senior executive relationships and lead all commercial strategy, pricing, and negotiation for upsell and cross-sell opportunities, while Customer Success owns delivery, account health, and renewals.

  • Build Repeatable Commercial Infrastructure

    • Develop and contribute to sales playbooks, pricing frameworks, and commercial models that support predictable, repeatable revenue growth.

    • Ensure disciplined use of CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) to track pipeline health, deal velocity, close rates, and revenue performance.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven Enterprise Revenue Leadership

    • 7+ years of experience driving revenue in enterprise B2B sales, partnerships, or commercial leadership roles, with clear ownership of revenue targets and complex salescycles.

    • Demonstrated success closing and expanding multi-year, six- and seven-figure partnerships with CPG brands and/or retail partners.

  • End to End Deal Ownership

    • Deep experience owning the full commercial lifecycle, from prospecting and executive pitching through pricing strategy, negotiation, contract execution, and expansion.

    • Strong command of sales structuring across standalone and bundled service offerings, with the ability to design commercial models that scale over time.

  • Executive Presence & Market Credibility

    • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex value propositions to senior brand, retail, and sustainability leaders.

    • Confidence representing a company on stage, in executive boardrooms, and at industry events as a credible commercial and thought-leading partner.

  • Strategic & Challenger-Style Selling

    • Brings an insight-first, challenger mindset to enterprise selling — leading with perspective, not product. You can teach partners something new about regenerative sourcing, verification, risk, or market opportunity that reframes how they think about the problem.

    • Tailor messaging and solutions to different stakeholder priorities across sustainability, sourcing, commercial, and executive teams, aligning Regenified’s services to what matters most for each audience.

    • Comfortable taking control of the commercial process — guiding conversations, pushing back when needed, and driving toward clear decisions and outcomes in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

    • Able to sell into ambiguity by defining the problem to solve, not just responding to stated needs or RFPs.

  • Builder’s Mindset

    • Thrives in a fast-paced, early stage environment where processes, playbooks, and pricing models are still being built.

    • Comfortable creating structure where none exists and continuously improving how the organisation sells and scales.

  • Mission Alignment & Integrity

    • A deep interest in regenerative agriculture and the role of verification, certification, and procurement in driving systems change.

    • High integrity and comfort balancing commercial ambition with credibility, trust, and long-term partner success.

  • Operational & Commercial Rigor

    • Highly organised and data-driven, with strong pipeline management, forecasting, and KPI discipline.

    • Proficient in CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and comfortable using data to manage deal velocity and revenue performance.

  • Industry Fluency

    • Experience selling into food, beverage, agriculture, CPG, or retail sectors, particularly in sustainability, sourcing, or supply-chain-related offerings.

    • Familiarity with sustainability claims, certifications, or regenerative agriculture.

    • An existing network of potential customers with whom you have active relationships.

Success Measures

  • Revenue Performance: Consistent achievement (or outperformance) of annual revenue targets across CPG Brand and Retail partners — evidenced by sustained growth in contract value, verified acres, and adoption of verification, procurement services, and product certification within new and existing accounts.

  • Pipeline Health & Predictability: A robust, well-managed enterprise pipeline with clear sales progression, accurate forecasting, and strong conversion rates across all three services, enabled by disciplined use of CRM and commercial processes to track pipeline health, sales velocity, close rates, and revenue performance with accuracy and transparency.

  • Multi-Service Adoption: Measurable growth in the number and value of partners adopting multiple Regenified services, demonstrating effective solution selling and long-term partnership design.

  • Enterprise Deal Quality: Execution of well-structured, scalable, and renewable commercial agreements, including multi-year commitments and clear expansion pathways aligned with Regenified’s delivery capabilities.

Why You’ll Love it Here

  • Make a Difference: Your work will directly contribute to healing our landscapes and building a more resilient and equitable agricultural system.

  • Passionate Team: Work with a great, mission-driven team with shared, unwavering purpose and drive.

  • High-Impact Ownership: This is not a cog-in-a-wheel job. You will have a high degree of ownership and real scope for innovation.

  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive pay, unlimited PTO, and 100% premium coverage for medical/dental/vision (with partial coverage for dependants).

  • Career Growth: We invest in your professional development to help you grow with the company.
