Site Observability Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Site Observability Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
PositionType: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
ExperienceRequired: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Site Observability Engineer to design and operate the metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting platforms that give engineering teams confidence in the systems they run. The role spans the full observability stack — from collection agents and pipelines to long-term storage, dashboards, and alerting workflows — with a strong focus on usability, signal quality, and operational ROI. The ideal candidate has built and operated observability platforms at scale, understands the trade-offs between open-source and SaaS approaches, and can translate noisy telemetry into actionable insight for both engineers and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate enterprise-grade observability platforms covering metrics, logs, traces, events, and synthetic monitoring.
  • Architect Prometheus / Thanos / Mimir, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, and Datadog deployments for high availability and scale.
  • Develop standards for service instrumentation, including OpenTelemetry adoption, metric naming, label cardinality, and structured logging conventions.
  • Define and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets, and build the dashboards and alerts that operationalize them.
  • Build alerting strategies that minimize noise, surface actionable signals, and integrate cleanly with on-call workflows in PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or similar tools.
  • Operate large-scale time-series and log storage platforms, balancing retention, query performance, and cost.
  • Design distributed tracing pipelines and help teams use traces to diagnose latency and reliability issues.
  • Develop self-service tooling, paved-road libraries, and templates that make adoption of observability standards easy for product teams.
  • Drive cost management and label-cardinality discipline across the observability estate.
  • Lead incident response readiness improvements through better dashboards, alerting hygiene, and post-incident analysis tooling.
  • Partner with SRE and platform teams to integrate observability into deployment pipelines, canary analysis, and progressive delivery workflows.
  • Evaluate and recommend observability vendors and open-source tools based on cost, capability, and operational maturity.
  • Mentor engineering teams on observability fundamentals, debugging techniques, and SLO-driven operations.
  • Maintain documentation, onboarding guides, and runbooks for the observability platform.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in SRE, platform engineering, or observability roles.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and at least one major commercial observability platform such as Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk.
  • Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and structured logging.
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language such as Go, Python, or Java.
  • Experience operating high-cardinality, high-throughput metrics and log pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of SLOs, error budgets, and SRE principles.
  • Experience integrating observability with CI/CD and incident management tooling.
  • Solid grasp of Linux internals, networking, and container platforms.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Thanos, Mimir, Cortex, Loki, or Tempo at scale.
  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry or observability open-source projects.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based observability tooling.
  • Experience driving observability cost optimization initiatives.
  • Exposure to regulated environments with audit-grade logging requirements.

Senior Operations Data Analyst

About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 80 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

The HRBP works closely with business leaders to resolve workplace issues, manage employee relations concerns, and drive HR program performance. This role also manages day-to-day HR processes including leave of absence administration, ADA accommodation, onboarding and orientation, and the creation and maintenance of HR documentation. The HRBP partners with the Human Resources Manager and Sr. Human Resources Administrator to ensure a consistent, positive employee experience.

This position requires a strong technical foundation, attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate and timely results in areas where quality and compliance are critical. The ideal candidate approaches problem-solving using established systems and policies, communicates clearly and directly, and builds trust through clarity, accuracy and reliability.

A WORLD LEADER IN TESTING, INSPECTION & CERTIFICATION SERVICES

Bureau Veritas offers dynamic, exciting employment opportunities with an attractive salary/benefit package and an opportunity to play a vital role with a global organization. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are looking for an opportunity to become part of a stellar team of professionals, we invite you to apply online today.

Bureau Veritas is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other non-job-related characteristics.

This position is responsible to ensure equal opportunity in employment in that all persons are treated equally and on the basis of merit, in decisions regarding selection, placement, promotions, training, work assignments, transfers and other personnel actions.

City: Remote

State: Remote

Job Summary

The Industrial Maintenance and Operations Assessor will perform technical assessments, functional testing, and audits of material handling equipment (MHE), mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, and industrial facility infrastructure. This role will also conduct hands-on arc flash data gathering of electrical equipment and evaluate equipment condition, operational performance, and compliance with applicable industry standards.

The ideal candidate will possess experience with NFPA 70E requirements, Qualified Electrical Worker (QEW) practices per NFPA and OSHA standards, and a strong understanding of industrial maintenance, operations, and engineering best practices. Candidates should have experience in one or more of the following disciplines: industrial electrical systems, industrial mechanical systems, industrial controls systems, or material handling equipment.

This role requires advanced technical knowledge of industrial equipment and building systems, the ability to evaluate complex equipment interactions, and the consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion. Success in this position requires strong analytical skills, technical communication abilities, attention to safety, and the ability to adapt assessment methodologies to varying project conditions while supporting safe and efficient project execution.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Performs comprehensive technical audits, field assessments, and condition evaluations of industrial equipment, including material handling systems, mechanical systems, electrical infrastructure, controls systems, and related facility components.
  • Observes, tests, evaluates, and documents equipment operation and system performance to identify deficiencies, maintenance needs, operational concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Conducts assessments of major material handling and conveyance systems to verify installations align with design drawings, specifications, operational requirements, and industry standards.
  • Maintains a Safety-First mindset and complies with OSHA requirements, Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO) procedures, PPE requirements, site-specific safety protocols, and company safety standards.
  • Performs electrical data collection, including arc flash information gathering, equipment identification, nameplate verification, electrical ratings, and system documentation.
  • Evaluates electrical infrastructure and equipment up to 480 volts, applying knowledge of installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair practices, and safe operating procedures.
  • Assesses industrial mechanical systems, equipment components, and operational processes to evaluate performance, reliability, and maintenance requirements.
  • Reviews CMMS records, maintenance history, work orders, asset documentation, preventative maintenance programs, BAS controls systems, and operational data to support equipment evaluations.
  • Interprets architectural, mechanical, and electrical drawings, equipment documentation, inspection reports, certificates of occupancy, warranty information, and maintenance records to support field assessments.
  • Conducts interviews with facility personnel, contractors, vendors, and clients to gather operational insights, validate findings, and support assessment reports.
  • Documents field observations through detailed notes, photographs, equipment data collection, and electronic reporting platforms.
  • Prepares detailed technical reports summarizing equipment conditions, deficiencies, trends, findings, and recommendations.
  • Utilizes company platforms, electronic data collection tools, and reporting systems to ensure accurate and timely documentation.
  • Coordinates onsite activities with commissioning technicians, contractors, controls vendors, and facility operations teams to support project execution.
  • Communicates technical findings, corrective actions, testing requirements, project updates, and potential issues clearly with internal teams and clients.
  • Maintains regular communication with Lead and Senior Project Managers regarding project status, site access, schedule impacts, risks, and project concerns.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This job does not have specific supervisory responsibilities.

Skills:

Language Ability:
Ability to write technical reports, business correspondence, and standard operating procedures. Ability to effectively communicate findings and respond to questions from clients, contractors, peers, and technical field staff.

Reasoning Ability:
Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret technical documentation, drawings, specifications, and industry standards while addressing complex equipment and operational variables.

Technical Ability:
Ability to understand and evaluate industrial electrical, mechanical, controls, and material handling systems. Ability to apply maintenance principles, troubleshooting methods, safety practices, and engineering best practices to field assessments.

Technology Skills:
Proficiency operating computers, tablets, and electronic data collection tools. Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel. Experience utilizing CMMS platforms, BAS systems, cloud-based reporting tools, and electronic assessment applications preferred.

Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of industrial maintenance practices, equipment operation, and system performance evaluation.
  • Knowledge of OSHA safety standards, NFPA 70E requirements, Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO) procedures, PPE requirements, and electrical safety practices.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining project schedules and quality expectations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, contractors, facility personnel, and internal project teams.
  • Ability to work safely in industrial environments with energized equipment and mechanical systems.
  • Ability to successfully work remotely when not traveling.
  • Ability to meet the physical demands and travel requirements of the position.
  • Must have a cell phone and supply your own internet service.

Education, Certifications, and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required. Technical degree, trade school diploma, vocational training, or associate degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial maintenance, or related discipline preferred.

  • Journeyman credentials in mechanical or electrical disciplines preferred.
  • Five or more years of experience desired but not required performing equipment maintenance, building inspections of commercial, institutional, and industrial buildings.

  • Candidates with experience in electrical, mechanical, controls, or material handling systems are strongly preferred.

  • Valid driver’s license required, with a clean driving record and no significant MVA points or violations.

  • Industry-recognized certifications, active pursuit of certification, or equivalent professional credentialing such as CxA, CCP, BCxP, CEM, NICET, NFPA-related certifications, or active trade licensure relevant to the supported discipline.
  • Previously certified as a Qualified Electrical Worker (QEW) experience per NFPA 70E and OSHA standards.
  • Experience performing electrical work requiring arc flash PPE and electrical safety procedures.
  • Experience with Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO) procedures involving multiple energy systems.
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting material handling equipment, including preventative maintenance activities.
  • Experience with electrical infrastructure installation, maintenance, replacement, upgrades, and repairs up to 480 volts.
  • Experience using CMMS systems for asset management, maintenance documentation, and work order tracking.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification preferred.
  • Experience operating lifts and following proper fall protection procedures preferred.

Physical and Environmental Conditions:

  • Walk (material part of an 8-hour workday, up to 3 to 4 continuous hours at one time.)
  • Stand (material part of an 8-hour workday, up to 3 to 4 continuous hours at one time.)
  • Sit, Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl to observe basement and grade-level crawl spaces, and/or to read equipment data plates when necessary, and/or measurements (at least once for each building assessed)
  • Climb and balance Stairs (at least once for each building assessed)
  • Climb and balance various types of ladders to access flat roofs/hatch access (at least once for each building assessed)
  • Repetitive use of hands/fingers for keyboard interaction (frequently)
  • Reach with hands and arms
  • Talk and hear (communicate with onsite contact)
  • Vision (close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus)
  • Lift and or move (occasionally up to 40 pounds) (not applicable during ADA Assessments)
  • Operate an electronic tablet in the field for live data collection.
  • Operate a computer (up to 100% of workweek)
  • Operating a motor vehicle
  • Ability to successfully work from remote location.
  • Ability to travel by plane, motor vehicle, train to client/project sites across the U.S.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including night shifts and weekend assignments.
  • Work Environment: The employee is regularly exposed to outdoor weather conditions, moving mechanical components and assemblies, frequently exposed to work near energized electrical components and assemblies. The employee is occasionally exposed to work in high, precarious places, fumes or airborne particles, extreme cold, extreme heat, inclement weather conditions, and risk of electrical shock. The noise level at the project site is usually moderate.

Travel Requirements:

Travel (by Plane, Motor Vehicle, Train) is a significant component of this role, with approximately 75% of the time spent traveling to client/project sites across the U.S. A flexible schedule, including night shifts and weekend assignments, may be required based on project needs.

SENIOR ESOP ADMINISTRATOR

JOB TITLE: Senior ESOP Administrator

DEPARTMENT: ESOP Services

SUPERVISOR: Director of ESOP Services

About ESOP Partners, Inc.

ESOP Partners, Inc. is a third-party administration and consulting firm dedicated to providing a liquid business transition solution for owners of closely held businesses through the establishment, maintenance, and sustainability of Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). Our mission is to maximize the financial and cultural benefits of employee ownership by helping ESOP companies build strong, informed, and engaged employee ownership cultures.

We aspire to be nationally recognized as the leading ESOP firm in the country. We pursue this vision through our Core Values:

  • Seek to Understand – We identify the underlying reasons behind questions and actions and take ownership of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Manage Expectations – We proactively communicate clear, specific, and achievable objectives to create alignment and accountability.
  • Collaborate – We work together through constructive discussion and teamwork to achieve win-win outcomes.
  • Get Things Done – We prioritize, organize, and execute efficiently to deliver accurate and timely results.
  • Practice Professional Skepticism – We apply a questioning mindset to objectively analyze information for quality and accuracy.
  • Exhibit Mental Strength – We manage challenges with professionalism, resilience, and a solutions-oriented attitude.

Position Summary

The Senior ESOP Administrator is responsible for the overall administration, compliance, and client service delivery for Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring accurate plan recordkeeping, regulatory compliance, and timely completion of annual administration requirements. The Senior ESOP Administrator provides technical expertise related to ERISA, IRS, and DOL regulations, oversees plan allocations and distribution processing, reviews valuation reports, and prepares required filings and participant communications. This position also plays a key role in mentoring junior team members, improving internal processes, and supporting cross-functional collaboration with valuation, consulting, and compliance teams. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge of ESOP plan design and administration, exceptional attention to detail, client-focused communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Position Details

  • Location: Remote Eligible (WI, MI, GA, NC, IA)
    • Must be able to provide and maintain a distraction-free and professional work environment and meet our minimum high-speed internet connection standards.
  • Position Type: Full-time | Exempt
  • Work Schedule: This role has a seasonal workload and requires the ability to work more than 45 hours per week during the peak period of January through May annually.
  • Experience Level: Minimum of 7 years’ recent hands-on ESOP administration and record-keeping experience, including direct client management.
  • Travel:
    • Required travel to Appleton, WI for 2-3 weeks of orientation and training.
    • Ongoing travel to Appleton, WI for one full week each quarter.

Key Accountabilities

ESOP Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Contribute to overall ESOP Administration team production goals while maintaining high standards of accuracy, efficiency, and client service.
  • Oversee and execute critical ESOP administrative functions, ensuring junior staff complete assigned responsibilities in accordance with established quality control procedures.
  • Monitor completion of required reports and regulatory filings using internal ESOP timeline tools to ensure deadlines and client expectations are consistently met.
  • Determine participant eligibility in accordance with plan provisions and ensure accurate allocation of employer contributions.
  • Maintain and validate historical participant data to ensure accurate processing of forfeitures, vesting, diversification eligibility, and related plan events.
  • Track and report ESOP trust activity, including stock transactions, dividends, and share account activity, ensuring accurate attribution to participant accounts.
  • Prepare and distribute participant statements, required notices, and disclosures in compliance with ERISA and applicable regulations.
  • Administer participant distributions, including preparation of customized diversification elections and benefit election documentation.
  • Perform compliance testing to ensure plans adhere to ESOP-specific requirements as well as applicable IRS and DOL regulations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of ERISA-related regulatory reporting and annual filing requirements.

Quality Control & Process Improvement

  • Apply established quality control standards to all client deliverables and mentor junior administrators to strengthen technical accuracy and consistency.
  • Partner in the ongoing enhancement and testing of proprietary administration software (ESOP Revolution) to improve system functionality, reduce manual workarounds, and increase operational efficiency.

Client Consulting & Advisory Services

Provide ESOP administration and consulting services to new and existing clients, including but not limited to:

  • Repurchase Liability Studies
  • Distribution Policy consulting
  • ESOP Plan Design support
  • ESOP-related accounting guidance
  • Corporate governance advisory
  • ESOP culture and communication strategy
  • Participant education and training

Professional Development & Industry Engagement

  • Maintain and expand ESOP technical expertise through participation in industry conferences, seminars, and continuing education opportunities.

Qualifications

Knowledge and Skills

  • Advanced knowledge of Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) administration, including plan allocations, distributions, diversification, repurchase liability, and stock transaction tracking.
  • Strong understanding of ERISA, Internal Revenue Service (IRS), and Department of Labor (DOL) regulations applicable to qualified retirement plans and ESOPs.
  • Working knowledge of ESOP accounting principles and corporate governance considerations.
  • Ability to interpret plan documents and apply provisions accurately to participant data and compliance testing.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyze and reconcile complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple client engagements, prioritize competing deadlines, and meet production targets in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective client communication skills, including the ability to explain complex ESOP concepts clearly and professionally.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor junior staff and enforce quality control standards.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development within the ESOP industry.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years recent hands-on ESOP administration experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Math, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Basic Accounting knowledge.

Certifications / Licenses

  • QPA or QKA certification preferred or in progress
  • Remote Candidates: Valid Driver’s License

Physical and Cognitive Requirements

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and work at a computer
  • Ability to analyze complex information and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to maintain focus and accuracy in a deadline-driven environment

Performance Expectations

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

  • Accuracy, quality and timeliness of work product
  • Accountability and ownership of meeting production hours goals
  • Adherence to ESOP Partners’ Core Values
  • Effectiveness of professional communication and collaboration

jobs.title: Executive Client Partner
jobs.excerpt: At Stitch, we’re building something extraordinary.
jobs.description:
At Stitch, we’re building something extraordinary. As a fast-growing team of passionate marketing technologists, architects, and strategists, we bring together our diverse backgrounds and experiences to work towards one common goal: make marketers’ lives easier with Braze.

Customer engagement is becoming increasingly complex, but with the right technology, processes, and strategies in place, marketers can achieve great things. We're motivated to be drivers of what the future of martech looks like by building solutions that work.

We’re all in on Braze as the leading customer engagement platform and the cornerstone of the modern martech stack. As an Orbit-level certified Braze partner (the highest level of partnership), we work alongside marketers from some of the world’s most beloved brands to stitch together innovative solutions, better processes, and smarter strategies that make marketing magic happen in Braze.

About This Role

As an Executive Client Partner at Stitch, you’ll serve as one of the organization’s most senior commercial and people leaders, accountable for the performance and growth of an approximately $25M client portfolio. You’ll lead a team of Client Partners and Senior Client Partners who directly manage Stitch’s client relationships.

This role does not carry an individual Book of Business (BoB). Your impact comes from creating the structure, commercial discipline, executive connectivity, and team capability needed to deliver predictable growth across the portfolio. You’ll coach and hold your team accountable, maintain visibility across strategic accounts, serve as an executive sponsor, and step directly into client or commercial situations when senior leadership is needed.

You’ll collaborate closely with Delivery, Solutions, Sales, Strategy, and Marketing to protect client outcomes, shape growth strategies, commercialize new offerings, and strengthen Stitch’s capabilities. You’ll establish effective commercial rhythms, lead complex negotiations and escalations, and develop strong commercial operators and future leaders. Success requires someone who can be both strategic and hands-on—comfortable setting direction, creating structure, and helping a team translate plans into measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the overall commercial performance and profitable growth of an approximately $25M client portfolio managed through a team of Client Partners and Senior Client Partners.
  • Deliver disciplined account planning, pipeline development, and risk mitigation to ensure predictable, sustained portfolio growth and exceed Net Dollar Retention targets.
  • Lead or provide senior oversight for complex pricing, negotiations, renewals, expansions, and multi-year programs, ensuring sound deal economics and appropriate risk protection.
  • Establish clear growth strategies and accountabilities across the portfolio, ensuring plans are translated into action and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain portfolio-level forecasting accuracy and pacing visibility, proactively identifying emerging risks, gaps, and growth opportunities to deliver commercial predictability.
  • Serve as executive sponsor across the portfolio, building trusted relationships with key senior stakeholders while enabling Client Partners to deepen and own their client relationships.
  • Lead or support transformation-level conversations that shape client strategy, demonstrate business value, influence long-term investment, and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic, commercial, or delivery challenges, intervening directly when leadership is needed to protect client trust and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Delivery leadership to ensure portfolio-wide financial health, staffing alignment, delivery quality, and shared accountability for client outcomes.
  • Bring the right leaders and capabilities into each account while remaining close enough to the work to provide meaningful direction and support—without displacing the ownership of the Client Partners on your team.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Strategy, and Marketing to shape go-to-market strategy, develop new offerings, and strengthen organizational capabilities.
  • Facilitate portfolio-level cohesion and communication, elevating emerging risks and opportunities to maintain a seamless, unified client experience.
  • Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of Client Partners and Senior Client Partners, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for client, commercial, and leadership outcomes.
  • Establish and reinforce effective commercial rhythms—including pipeline reviews, account planning, forecasting, and performance reviews—that create sustained growth momentum.
  • Develop and scale training, playbooks, tools, and AI-enabled ways of working that strengthen the Client Partner organization.
  • Create operating structure and clarity across a complex portfolio, particularly when priorities, client conditions, or organizational needs are changing.
  • Deliver clear, candid feedback in a way that reinforces accountability, trust, and team engagement.
  • Contribute to enterprise initiatives and leadership-level planning that advance Stitch’s commercial strategy, operating model, and long-term growth.

What Does Success Look Like in This Role?

  • You produce portfolio outcomes through the performance of your team—not through ownership of an individual BoB.
  • You maintain sufficient strategic and commercial visibility across the portfolio to identify risks, guide growth, and provide meaningful executive sponsorship while preserving clear account ownership within your team.
  • You elevate your team by developing strong commercial operators, strategic advisors, and future leaders.
  • The Client Partners and Senior Client Partners on your team operate with accountability and commercial discipline and consistently deliver strong growth outcomes.
  • You confidently lead executive-level client and internal conversations, create clarity around decisions, draw out the right perspectives, and ensure every discussion results in clear ownership and next steps.
  • You create clear growth strategies across the portfolio and ensure they are executed with focus, accountability, and measurable business impact.
  • Your portfolio reflects disciplined commercial leadership, including strong Net Dollar Retention, a healthy expansion pipeline, accurate forecasting, and informed decision-making.
  • You create structure in ambiguous situations and consistently translate strategic direction into coordinated team action.
  • Your team experiences you as both a high-standard leader and a trusted coach. You address performance issues directly while communicating in a way that builds capability, confidence, and engagement.
  • You move fluidly between coaching, executive sponsorship, commercial leadership, and direct intervention when circumstances require it.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For:

  • 15+ years of experience in commercial leadership, client strategy, martech consulting, or enterprise account management.
  • Demonstrated success leading and growing a large, complex client portfolio—ideally $20M+—with accountability for retention, expansion, profitability, forecasting, and the performance of other client leaders.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presence, and influence, with demonstrated ability to lead complex client conversations, navigate conflict, negotiate favorable commercial terms, and build alignment among senior stakeholders.
  • Proven success building, coaching, and holding high-performing client-facing teams accountable for commercial outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of financial metrics, deal economics, and the effective management of portfolio-level profitability.
  • Strong martech and customer-engagement credibility, with the ability to connect client strategy, data, technology, delivery, and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level growth strategies, solution recommendations, and business cases that influence client investment and expansion decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to create operating structure, make decisions, and mobilize teams through ambiguity, competing priorities, organizational change, and complex client environments.
  • A hands-on leadership style combined with the judgment to coach and enable account leaders rather than take over their responsibilities.
  • A leadership approach that combines candor and high standards with respect, self-awareness, and the ability to build trust across different working styles.
  • Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to a rapidly changing and growing market.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Eligibility to work in the United States without visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Stitch is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid bereavement leave
  • Mental well-being support
  • In-person onboarding experience during your first week at our HQ in Indianapolis, Indiana

Senior Javascript Node Fullstack Engineer

jobs.description:
A B O U T B A N N E R S O L U T I O N S

Banner Solutions is a premier national wholesale distributor specializing in commercial door hardware, access control systems, and security hardware products across CSI Divisions 8, 10, and 28. As a leader in the commercial door and security hardware industry, we represent more than 260 manufacturers and deliver industry-leading service with a 98%+ same-day ship rate.

Our customers include Contract Hardware Dealers, Glass & Glazing Dealers, Building Material Suppliers, Electronic Access Integrators, Locksmiths, Institutional End Users, e-tailers, and retailers nationwide. Through our nationwide distribution network, deep product expertise, and strong manufacturer partnerships, we help customers secure and complete buildings across the country.

Banner Solutions is built on a culture of ownership, collaboration, and accountability. Our team members are empowered to make an impact while delivering the expertise, service, and reliability our customers depend on.

C O R E R E S P O N S I B I L I T I E S

The Senior Software Engineer — .NET / Integration / Automation will serve as a hands-on technical contributor within Banner Solutions' Chief Digital Officer organization, working directly with the Systems Architect to build and maintain the integrations, automation workflows, and AI-powered systems that run Banner's operations.

Reporting directly to the Systems Architect, this role is part of the CDO organization and operates across multiple platforms and business functions. The Senior Software Engineer will take architectural direction and independently carry substantial features or integrations through to completion.

This is not a ticket-driven role. The ideal candidate takes a well-framed problem, asks the right questions, makes the technical decisions that are theirs to make, and delivers working software — pulling the Systems Architect back in at the decision points that actually matter.

Integration & Systems Development

  • Build and maintain integration workflows connecting core platforms including P21 (ERP), Salesforce, Akeneo (PIM), Algolia, and Canals.ai — "make these three systems work together reliably" is a common problem here
  • Design and implement APIs, background jobs, and automation pipelines that handle real transactional volume reliably
  • Debug across system boundaries — trace problems through multiple systems rather than stopping at the code immediately in front of you
  • Ensure integrations perform well, fail gracefully, and are maintainable by the team over time
  • Write code with good testing instincts: how do we prove this works, what happens when it fails, and what edge cases are we missing?

AI-Augmented Development

  • Build integrations against LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar — to power Banner's automation initiatives in areas including order processing, customer communications, and purchasing operations
  • Apply AI development tools fluently as part of daily work: to move faster, explore approaches, and think more thoroughly — while applying independent engineering judgment to what the tools produce
  • Contribute to automation workflows that reduce manual labor and improve operational consistency across Banner's distribution business

Technical Ownership & Judgment

  • Receive architectural direction from the Systems Architect and independently drive significant features or integrations through to completion
  • When something unexpected surfaces: investigate it, determine root cause, make the call if it's yours to make, and bring a clear recommendation back if it's architectural or business-related
  • Make normal technical decisions without asking permission — and recognize when a decision has crossed into territory that needs a conversation
  • Take business problems that aren't perfectly specified and turn them into working software, asking the questions that matter rather than waiting for a complete ticket

Q U A L I F I C A T I O N S

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of professional software development in a production environment
  • Experience within distribution, supply chain, e-commerce, or similarly complex operational environments preferred
  • Strong C#/.NET — this is the core of what Banner builds
  • Solid SQL — read stored procedures, write good queries, and recognize performance problems at scale
  • Comfortable with Azure and cloud environments — Banner is actively moving workloads to the cloud
  • API design, background services, and multi-system integration development
  • Able to debug across system boundaries, not just the code immediately in front of you
  • Good testing instincts for real-world edge cases and failure modes
  • Already using AI development tools effectively as a genuine part of daily work

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience integrating against LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) — rate limits, error handling, cost management, and applying them to real business problems rather than just experimentation
  • Experience with Epicor Prophet21 (P21) or a similarly complex distribution/wholesale ERP
  • Familiarity with Akeneo, Algolia, Salesforce, Canals.ai, or similar platforms
  • Experience building AI or automation workflows — document processing, workflow orchestration, or intelligent routing
  • EDI or supply chain integration experience

We'd rather hire a strong engineer who can learn our systems than narrow the pool for someone who happens to already know our exact stack.

Cultural Fit & Attributes

  • When something breaks: investigate it, prove what's happening, propose a fix that preserves intended behavior, and escalate only if it's architectural or business-related — not every problem needs to come back up
  • Takes well-framed problems, asks useful questions, and delivers working software rather than waiting for a complete specification
  • Comfortable making technical decisions independently, and calibrated about when a decision has crossed into territory that needs a conversation
  • Embody Banner Solutions' values ofCourtesy, Respect, Quality, Professionalism, and Discipline
  • Genuinely collaborative — works well with the Systems Architect, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders
  • Balance speed and quality — moves fast without creating problems that slow the team down later
  • Comfortable across both backend and web code — not helpless when something crosses a layer

S U C C E S S M E T R I C S — F I R S T 1 2 M O N T H S

Success will be measured by the ability to take ownership of substantial work and deliver it independently, with technical judgment, engineering quality, and escalation calibration that earns the confidence of the Systems Architect.

The Senior Software Engineer will help ensure:

  • At least one significant integration or automation feature is delivered with minimal implementation-level direction
  • Problems are investigated and diagnosed rather than surfaced — escalations come with root cause analysis and a proposed solution
  • AI development tools are a measurable part of how this engineer works, accelerating delivery without compromising quality
  • The Systems Architect is confident handing a meaningful piece of the system to this engineer and trusting it will come back done
  • Technical decisions are made at the right level — autonomously when appropriate, escalated clearly when architectural or business-related
  • The team's codebase is left more maintainable, better tested, and more reliable as a result of this engineer's contributions

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.excerpt: About FlinksFlinks is the embedded finance platform that brings together connectivity, intelligence, and payments — giving businesses the infrastructure they need to build and deliver seamless financial experiences at scale.
jobs.description:
About Flinks

Flinks is the embedded finance platform that brings together connectivity, intelligence, and payments — giving businesses the infrastructure they need to build and deliver seamless financial experiences at scale.

As a leader in Open Finance in Canada, we’ve grown since 2016 into one of North America’s most trusted platforms for financial data access, enrichment, and money movement. We work with innovators across many industries, including lending, fintech, banking, insurance, and wealth management.

Today, our platform connects to 15,000+ financial institutions across North America and powers over 1M monthly connections. We also give our customers unprecedented visibility into 4,500+ real-time financial insights to support smarter decisioning. Companies rely on Flinks to streamline onboarding, verify income, assess credit risk, and power faster payment experiences.

We’re on a mission to drive financial innovation and help businesses build financial experiences that feel effortless, connected, and customer-first. That’s where you come in.


The Role

We're hiring Senior Full-Stack Developers to build and own the client-facing product experiences at Flinks. You'll work across the Angular/TypeScript front end and the C#/.NET back end, owning features end to end - from the interface a client touches to the API that powers it.

This is a true full-stack role - we're looking for real depth on both sides of the stack. The exact balance depends on the team you join: some of our product areas lean more front-end, others more back-end and we'll work out the best fit with you during the process. Flinks teams span Connect (bank-data aggregation), Pay (money movement), Enrich / Attributes (transaction enrichment), Upload (document processing), the client dashboard and Outbound (open banking) - so there's a surface to match most strengths.

We're not building software for software's sake. Our products only matter when a client can see, trust and act on what we ship - so this role is judged by the business outcomes your work moves: client adoption, faster integration and time-to-value, fewer support escalations, data clients can rely on. If you like owning a product surface from the component down to the API that feeds it, this is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own product features end to end - design, build, test, deploy, and support features across both the Angular front end and the C#/.NET back end, taking responsibility for the complete user experience.
  • Build exceptional client experiences - create performant, accessible, and intuitive interfaces that help customers confidently work with complex financial data, from dashboards and visualizations to onboarding and transaction workflows.
  • Design and evolve APIs - build reliable, well-documented REST APIs and data contracts that are secure, scalable, backwards compatible, and easy for internal and external consumers to integrate with.
  • Write production-quality software - contribute clean, maintainable, well-tested code while continuously improving architecture, performance, reliability, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate across disciplines - partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, QA, Data Science, and fellow engineers to translate business problems into technical solutions that deliver measurable customer value.
  • Own production outcomes - monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the systems you build using observability tools, testing, and continuous delivery practices to ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Raise the engineering bar - provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor other developers, share technical knowledge, and help improve engineering standards across the team.
  • Leverage AI as a force multiplier - use AI-assisted development to accelerate implementation while applying sound engineering judgment, thoughtful system design, and strong problem framing to deliver the right solutions.

What You'll Work On

Where you land depends on the team, but the kind of work spans Flinks' product surfaces:

  • Client-facing dashboards - the Angular apps where clients explore transactions, enrichment insights and attributes and export the data they run on.
  • Connect - the aggregation and connectivity flows that link financial institutions and bring data in.
  • Pay - money-movement experiences and the services behind them.
  • Enrich / Attributes - turning categorized and enriched data into the contracts and views clients consume.
  • Upload - the document-processing flow and the experience around it.
  • Outbound - open-banking client integration surfaces.

Our Stack

  • Front-end: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, Angular Material, Tailwind CSS
  • Back-end: C#/.NET 8+, REST APIs, Entity Framework Core
  • Data: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, Firestore
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Pub/Sub
  • Developer Tools: Azure DevOps, Git, Webpack
  • Testing & Observability: Cypress, Playwright, Grafana

You don't need experience with every technology listed above. Strong software engineering fundamentals matter more than familiarity with our exact stack. The non-negotiables are production experience with Angular, TypeScript, and C#/.NET, along with the ability to build and own features across the full application stack.

Why This Role

At Flinks, full-stack engineers don't simply implement tickets—they own customer outcomes.

You'll build software that powers financial experiences used by hundreds of businesses and millions of financial account connections every month. Your work will directly influence how customers onboard, integrate, move money, and make financial decisions.

What you'll enjoy about this role:

  • End-to-end ownership across the entire application stack—from Angular components to .NET APIs and production deployment.
  • Meaningful product impact, where success is measured by customer adoption, reliability, usability, and business outcomes—not lines of code.
  • Modern engineering environment built on Angular, .NET, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform, and AI-assisted development practices.
  • Collaborative engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, pragmatic decision-making, and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunities to grow across multiple product domains while helping shape the future of Open Finance in Canada.

Key Requirements

  • Experience: 6-8+ years building and shipping production full-stack web applications, with strong Angular/TypeScript front-end depth andhands-on C#/.NET API experience.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Non-Negotiables: production-grade Angular with TypeScriptandworking C#/.NET on a relational database - you can own a feature across the front-end and the API. A front-end-only or back-end-only profile won't meet the fullstack bar.
  • Work authorization: must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Compensation Range

For experienced and qualified hires located in Canada, of senior (IC4) level, the compensation range is between $120,000 to $160,000 CAD annually.

As part of the total rewards package, Flinks offers:

  • Health & Dental coverage as of Day 1
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (FTO)
  • Remote work environment with frequent in-person gatherings and activities.
  • Career development, learning opportunities and growth
  • And more

We are committed to providing accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

Flinks uses artificial intelligence (AI) during the recruitment process to assist in screening, assessing, or selecting applicants.

À propos de Flinks 🚀

Flinks est une plateforme de finance intégrée qui réunit la connectivité, l’intelligence financière et les paiements, offrant aux entreprises l’infrastructure nécessaire pour concevoir et déployer des expériences financières fluides à grande échelle.

Chef de file de la finance ouverte (Open Finance) au Canada, nous avons connu une croissance soutenue depuis 2016 pour devenir l’une des plateformes les plus fiables en Amérique du Nord en matière d’accès aux données financières, d’enrichissement des données et de mouvement de fonds. Nous collaborons avec des entreprises innovantes dans de nombreux secteurs, notamment le crédit, les technologies financières (fintech), les services bancaires, l’assurance et la gestion de patrimoine.

Aujourd’hui, notre plateforme est connectée à plus de 15 000 institutions financières à travers l’Amérique du Nord et soutient plus d’un million de connexions mensuelles. Nous offrons également à nos clients un accès à plus de 4 500 indicateurs financiers en temps réel afin de favoriser une prise de décision plus éclairée. Les entreprises s’appuient sur Flinks pour simplifier l’intégration de leurs utilisateurs, vérifier les revenus, évaluer le risque de crédit et offrir des expériences de paiement plus rapides.

Notre mission est d’accélérer l’innovation financière et d’aider les entreprises à créer des expériences financières simples, connectées et centrées sur leurs clients. C’est là que vous entrez en jeu.

Le poste

Nous sommes à la recherche de développeurs(-euses) Full-Stack senior pour concevoir, développer et faire évoluer les expériences produits destinées à nos clients chez Flinks. Vous travaillerez autant sur le front-end en Angular/TypeScript que sur le back-end en C#/.NET, en assumant la responsabilité complète des fonctionnalités, de l’interface utilisateur jusqu’aux API qui les alimentent.

Il s’agit d’un véritable rôle full-stack : nous recherchons une expertise approfondie des deux côtés de la pile technologique. L’équilibre exact dépendra de l’équipe que vous intégrerez : certains domaines produits sont davantage orientés front-end, tandis que d’autres sont davantage axés sur le back-end. Nous déterminerons ensemble le meilleur alignement durant le processus de recrutement. Les équipes de Flinks couvrent notamment Connect (agrégation de données bancaires), Pay (mouvement de fonds), Enrich / Attributes (enrichissement des transactions), Upload (traitement documentaire), le tableau de bord client ainsi qu’Outbound (open banking). Il y a donc un environnement qui correspondra à vos forces.

Chez Flinks, nous ne développons pas des logiciels pour le simple plaisir de coder. Nos produits n’ont de valeur que lorsque nos clients peuvent les utiliser, leur faire confiance et prendre des décisions grâce à eux. Votre succès sera donc mesuré par les résultats concrets générés par votre travail : adoption par les clients, intégrations plus rapides, réduction du temps avant d’obtenir de la valeur, diminution des demandes de soutien et fiabilité des données livrées. Si vous aimez prendre en charge un produit de bout en bout, du composant jusqu’à l’API qui l’alimente, ce rôle est pour vous.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Assumer la responsabilité complète des fonctionnalités — concevoir, développer, tester, déployer et maintenir des fonctionnalités à travers le front-end Angular et le back-end C#/.NET, tout en offrant une expérience utilisateur cohérente de bout en bout.
  • Créer des expériences client exceptionnelles — développer des interfaces performantes, accessibles et intuitives qui permettent aux utilisateurs de travailler efficacement avec des données financières complexes, qu’il s’agisse de tableaux de bord, de visualisations, de parcours d’intégration ou de flux transactionnels.
  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les API — développer des API REST fiables et bien documentées ainsi que des contrats de données sécuritaires, évolutifs, rétrocompatibles et faciles à intégrer pour les consommateurs internes et externes.
  • Développer des logiciels prêts pour la production — produire un code propre, maintenable et bien testé tout en améliorant continuellement l’architecture, les performances, la fiabilité et l’excellence opérationnelle.
  • Collaborer avec plusieurs disciplines — travailler étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produit, designers produit, équipes QA, scientifiques des données et autres développeurs afin de transformer les besoins d’affaires en solutions techniques créant une valeur tangible pour les clients.
  • Assurer la qualité des systèmes en production — surveiller, diagnostiquer et améliorer les solutions que vous développez grâce aux outils d’observabilité, aux tests et aux pratiques de livraison continue afin d’offrir une expérience fiable à nos clients.
  • Faire évoluer les pratiques d’ingénierie — réaliser des revues de code de qualité, accompagner d’autres développeurs, partager vos connaissances techniques et contribuer à l’amélioration des standards d’ingénierie de l’équipe.
  • Tirer parti de l’IA comme accélérateur — utiliser les outils de développement assistés par l’intelligence artificielle pour accélérer la livraison tout en faisant preuve d’un excellent jugement technique, d’une conception réfléchie des systèmes et d’une bonne capacité à définir les problèmes.

Ce sur quoi vous travaillerez

L’équipe que vous rejoindrez déterminera votre domaine principal, mais les projets couvrent l’ensemble des produits de Flinks :

  • Tableaux de bord clients — les applications Angular permettant aux clients d’explorer les transactions, les données enrichies, les attributs et d’exporter les données sur lesquelles ils s’appuient.
  • Connect — les flux d’agrégation et de connectivité reliant les institutions financières et permettant l’acquisition des données.
  • Pay — les expériences liées aux mouvements de fonds ainsi que les services qui les soutiennent.
  • Enrich / Attributes — la transformation des données catégorisées et enrichies en contrats de données et en vues consommées par les clients.
  • Upload — les flux de traitement documentaire et l’expérience utilisateur qui les accompagne.
  • Outbound — les interfaces d’intégration client liées à l’open banking.

Notre environnement technologique

Front-end : Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, Angular Material, Tailwind CSS

Back-end : C#/.NET 8+, API REST, Entity Framework Core

Données : PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, Firestore

Infonuagique et infrastructure : Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Pub/Sub

Outils de développement : Azure DevOps, Git, Webpack

Tests et observabilité : Cypress, Playwright, Grafana

Vous n’avez pas besoin de maîtriser toutes les technologies mentionnées ci-dessus. De solides bases en ingénierie logicielle sont plus importantes qu’une connaissance exhaustive de notre pile technologique. Les exigences incontournables sont une expérience en production avec Angular, TypeScript et C#/.NET, ainsi que la capacité de développer et d’assumer la responsabilité de fonctionnalités couvrant l’ensemble de la pile applicative.

Pourquoi ce rôle

Chez Flinks, les développeurs Full-Stack ne se contentent pas de réaliser des tâches techniques : ils sont responsables des résultats vécus par les clients.

Vous développerez des logiciels qui alimentent des expériences financières utilisées par des centaines d’entreprises et soutiennent des millions de connexions à des comptes financiers chaque mois. Votre travail aura un impact direct sur la façon dont les clients s’intègrent à notre plateforme, déplacent des fonds et prennent des décisions financières.

Ce que vous apprécierez dans ce rôle :

  • Une responsabilité de bout en bout sur l’ensemble de la pile applicative, des composants Angular jusqu’aux API .NET et au déploiement en production.
  • Un impact concret sur les produits, où le succès est mesuré par l’adoption, la fiabilité, la convivialité et les résultats d’affaires plutôt que par le nombre de lignes de code.
  • Un environnement d’ingénierie moderne reposant sur Angular, .NET, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform et des pratiques de développement assistées par l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Une culture d’ingénierie collaborative valorisant l’autonomie, la curiosité, les décisions pragmatiques et l’amélioration continue.
  • Des occasions d’évoluer à travers plusieurs domaines produits tout en contribuant à façonner l’avenir de l’open finance au Canada.

Exigences essentielles

Expérience : 6 à 8 ans ou plus d’expérience dans le développement et la livraison d’applications Web Full-Stack en production, avec une solide expertise du front-end Angular/TypeScript et une expérience pratique du développement d’API en C#/.NET.

Formation : Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

Exigences incontournables : Expérience en production avec Angular et TypeScript, ainsi qu’en développement C#/.NET utilisant une base de données relationnelle. Vous êtes en mesure de prendre en charge une fonctionnalité de bout en bout, du front-end jusqu’à l’API. Un profil exclusivement front-end ou exclusivement back-end ne répondra pas aux exigences de ce rôle Full-Stack.

Autorisation de travail : Vous devez être légalement autorisé(e) à travailler au Canada.

Fourchette salariale

Pour les candidats expérimentés et qualifiés résidant au Canada, au niveau principal (IC4), la fourchette salariale annuelle se situe entre 120 000 $ et 160 000 $ CAD.

Ce que Flinks offre

jobs.excerpt: Space Inch is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our engineering function within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.
jobs.description:
Space Inch is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our engineering function within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S. Partnering closely with our CTO, you'll be the most senior engineering leader on the account: owning day-to-day operational and people leadership, serving as the senior engineering point of contact for the client's stakeholders, and driving AI adoption across the team. This client operates in a highly regulated environment with work spanning many technical stacks, so we want someone who thrives in that variety and brings real operational excellence and care for engineers to an agency environment.

This is first and foremost a people-leadership and communication role. We're looking for an exceptional communicator who earns the trust of engineers and senior client stakeholders alike. You must come from an engineering background, current or former, but hands-on technical depth isn't the primary requirement.

We're also still building out this account's leadership structure, so there's no layer of Engineering Managers under this role yet. You'll lead individual contributors and team leads directly and stay hands-on with delivery yourself, at least for now, with the opportunity to develop engineers on your team into Engineering Managers over time.

Our Mission, Vision, and Values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

  • Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil.
  • Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats.
  • This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices.
  • We support work/life balance for our team.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in software development, with at least 5+ leading engineering teams, including technical delivery leadership (ideally in an agency, consultancy, or client-embedded environment). Distributed team experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional communicator and mediator who bridges client demands with team reality, builds real trust with engineers, and handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care. Strong across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication
  • Proactive problem solver who spots delivery, scope, budget, and process breakdowns early (from PTO coverage gaps to missing test data) and fixes them without waiting for permission
  • Hands-on, demonstrable fluency with AI as a working tool: You've personally driven AI adoption in an engineering team with measurable outcomes (tooling rolled out, productivity gains, initiatives delivered); your credibility comes from execution, not commentary
  • Enough technical fluency across modern architecture, SDLC, and common stacks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Python, Java, C#) to challenge assumptions, guide decisions, and turn vague client requests into execution plans alongside tech leads. You don't need to write production code
  • Experience coordinating multiple teams or workstreams in parallel, with strong stakeholder management on ambiguous or contentious topics, plus staffing, onboarding, interviewing, and resource planning
  • Strong commercial sensibility: translating technical work, operational fixes, and AI-driven gains into a value story clients understand and continue to invest in
  • A systems thinker: organized enough to hold many threads, decisive enough to act without waiting for permission, self-aware enough to loop in leadership after. Experience with internal developer platforms, MCP-style tooling, or prototype-to-production workflows is a plus

Key Responsibilities

  • People leadership, coaching, and retention: Build trust with engineers through regular 1:1s, candid feedback, and development support. Handle sensitive topics directly (compensation, disengagement, underperformance, burnout, departures) and resolve retention risks before they escalate.
  • Client stakeholder management and partnership: Be the senior point of contact for the client, building trust with senior stakeholders, managing shifting priorities, and turning ambiguous requests (a prototype, an HTML mockup, a new app idea) into practical execution plans.
  • Technical program coordination: Coordinate delivery across frontend, backend, DevOps, platform, and tooling workstreams; clarify ownership, align dependencies, and bridge communication gaps between internal teams and the client. Partner with tech leads on architecture and trade-offs.
  • Resourcing and operational ownership: Oversee hiring, onboarding, and staffing; keep engineers productive through client delays; spot and fix delivery, budget, and process breakdowns before they reach the client.
  • AI-driven team uplift: Lead a step-change in how the team uses AI (tooling, upskilling, workflow design) with standards tied to seniority and autonomy. Focus on measurable productivity and code-review quality, not adoption for its own sake.
  • Decisive action and commercial storytelling: Propose and execute fixes without waiting for permission, keeping the CTO informed of what you're doing and why. Translate delivery metrics, technical decisions, and AI gains into a value narrative for the client.

Typical Challenges You'll Be Solving

  • AI adoption that produces measurable outcomes, focused on actual productivity, code review quality, and autonomy.
  • Turning ambiguous client requests into execution plans across multiple workstreams.
  • Maintaining team morale and stability: keeping engineers motivated, engaged, and retention risk low through shifting client priorities, scope changes, or client access delays.
  • Creating clarity in messy space: stepping into situations where domain ownership is unclear, bridging fragmented cross-team conversations, and making sure everyone understands what needs to be done.
  • Balancing short-term delivery needs with longer-term team and technical health.

Qualities for Success

  • Exceptional communicator: empathetic, honest, and transparent. Engineers trust your guidance, feel supported in 1:1s, and follow your lead when priorities shift.
  • Credible in AI as a working tool, with practical experience to back it up.
  • A systems thinker who designs how work happens, quickly spots broken communication loops or process gaps, and fixes them before they escalate.
  • Comfortable making decisions and owning the outcome, even when the first attempt fails.
  • Adapts communication style across coaching, escalation, and client conversations.
  • Calm under client pressure, and doesn't pass that pressure to the team.

The Role Is Right for You If

  • You lead through trust, presence, and communication as much as technical depth, and you're just as comfortable mediating and coaching as you are talking architecture.
  • You're comfortable staying hands-on with delivery and team leadership while this account's structure is still being built out, rather than expecting a team of managers already in place.
  • You see leading AI adoption as one of the most important things a senior engineering leader can do right now, and you want to help engineers navigate a profession that's changing under their feet.
  • You enjoy turning ambiguity into action: spotting what isn't working, proposing a path, and trying it.
  • You're at home in messy situations between people, delivery, client communication, and operations, and take ownership without being asked.

The Role Is Not Right for You If

  • You want a primarily hands-on coding role.
  • You'd rather lead through technical authority than through relationships, trust, and communication.
  • You're looking for a role where a layer of managers already reports to you: that structure doesn't exist yet on this account.
  • You prefer leading through process and approval rather than presence and initiative.
  • You'd rather wait for direction than propose a way forward.

What's In It for You

  • Shape how AI shows up in this account's delivery: visible, measurable, tied directly to client value.
  • Partner with the CTO on engineering at scale.
  • Work across a range of high-impact initiatives within a long-standing client partnership.
  • Remote-friendly, collaborative, pragmatic culture.
  • Leadership team that values people-first thinking and technical excellence.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Monthly salary: $10,000-$13,000 for a full-time B2B collaboration (with flexibility for an exceptional candidate), based on experience and skills
  • Remote-first setup
  • Health & Wellbeing: PTO + 100% Paid sick leave + Annual health checkup
  • Stay active: Wellness subsidy
  • Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base.

Space Inch is not responsible for any job boards scraping this ad without showing the position as remote, but Brazil exclusive. Applicants from other countries will not be considered.

Space Inch is committed to providing an environment of equal employment opportunity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination. Space Inch believes in treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity, fostering a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.

jobs.description:
• Lead the technical design and architecture of a modern enterprise-scale data platform
  • Define scalable data flows from Iceberg-based event storage into analytical and operational data products
  • Evaluate and select technologies for orchestration, transformation, querying, serving, and storage
  • Design reusable canonical entities and data models across advertising, campaigns, inventory, billing, and customer domains
  • Establish scalable engineering patterns for batch and near-real-time processing
  • Build reliable and observable data pipelines for high-volume AdTech workloads
  • Implement data quality, lineage, observability, and reconciliation capabilities
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering teams to introduce CI-enforced data contracts and governance standards
  • Define tenant isolation, access control, and regional data boundary strategies
  • Establish standards for testing, deployment automation, schema evolution, and versioning
  • Optimize platform performance, scalability, and infrastructure costs
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering excellence across the team
  • Partner closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • 8+ years of experience designing and operating production-grade data platforms
  • Strong expertise in distributed data systems and high-volume event-driven architectures
  • Deep understanding of modern lakehouse architectures and Apache Iceberg
  • Advanced SQL skills and production experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
  • Experience with distributed processing and query technologies such as Spark, Flink, or Trino
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling, partitioning strategies, and performance optimization
  • Proven experience building batch and near-real-time data pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and production observability
  • Experience implementing data contracts, schema evolution, and data quality frameworks
  • Ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions in greenfield environments
  • Upper-Intermediate or higher English level
  • Strong communication and technical leadership skills

WILL BE A PLUS

  • Experience in AdTech or other high-volume event-processing domains
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS data architectures
  • Familiarity with semantic layer technologies
  • Experience supporting both analytics and ML/AI workloads
  • Understanding of privacy regulations and data residency requirements

What success looks like within your first six months:

  • The first production data foundation is running.
  • Clear architectural decisions have been made and documented.
  • Events entering the data platform have enforceable contracts.
  • Core canonical entities exist and are tested.
  • Data quality and lineage are observable.
  • Other engineers can contribute without needing to understand every implementation detail.

Join a greenfield initiative focused on building a next-generation AI-first data platform for a global AdTech ecosystem. We are looking for a Principal/Staff Data Platform Engineer who will drive architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and shape the foundation for scalable analytics and AI capabilities.

As part of Sigma Software, you will collaborate with experienced engineering teams and contribute to a platform designed around immutable event-driven architecture, governed data contracts, and modern lakehouse principles. This role is ideal for a Principal-level engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges and influencing platform strategy from day one.

We offer the opportunity to work on large-scale international products, collaborate with highly skilled professionals, and contribute to a technically ambitious environment with long-term growth potential.

CUSTOMER

Our Customer is a Sweden-based AdTech company specializing in advanced self-serve advertising platforms that automate direct transactions between advertisers and major global publishers. Their solutions improve transparency and operational efficiency in digital advertising and are trusted by globally recognized brands including TripAdvisor, Bloomberg, The Washington Post, Opera, and Dow Jones. The company processes millions of advertising transactions worldwide and is actively investing in AI-driven data capabilities.

PROJECT

The project focuses on building a modern data platform from the ground up with an emphasis on immutable event streams, governed canonical models, semantic layers, and scalable analytics infrastructure. The platform will support analytical workloads, operational data products, AI applications, and future customer-facing data experiences.

As a Principal / Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will own key architectural decisions, define scalable engineering standards, and help deliver the first production-ready version of the platform in a high-scale AdTech environment.

Key Technologies: Apache Iceberg, Spark, Flink, Trino, AWS, Python, Scala, Java, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code
